papers.abstract: Frontier video generation models work in a VAE latent space that compresses video in both space and time. This compression made training tractable, but now limits high-resolution, controllable, and interactive generation -- doubling resolution quadruples token count, conditions apply to groups of frames rather than individual ones, and each response must wait for the rest of its multi-frame block. We present PixVid, a simple yet effective method that lifts a pretrained latent video model to directly generate every frame in pixel space. PixVid keeps the diffusion transformer and replaces the VAE decoder with a convolutional head that renders its outputs into pixels. We find that predicting clean video rather than velocity, together with a larger noise shift, is key to quality. Finetuned from Wan2.1-14B, PixVid is competitive with the latent baseline within $\sim 1.3$M training clips. Working framewise in pixels, it generates at $2\times$ higher resolution with the same per-frame token count, keeps depth-conditioned video editing aligned under fast motion, and responds to each action at the next frame. Project page: https://chenshuo20.github.io/PixVid/

analysis.key_results: 在约130万训练片段上微调自Wan2.1-14B，PixVid与潜在基线具有竞争力；在相同每帧token数下以2倍分辨率生成；在快速运动下保持深度条件视频编辑对齐；对每个动作在下一帧作出响应。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PixVid，一种将预训练潜在视频模型提升为像素空间逐帧生成的方法，通过保留扩散Transformer并用卷积头替换VAE解码器，实现高分辨率可控交互生成。
analysis.method: 保留预训练扩散Transformer，替换VAE解码器为卷积头，直接渲染像素；预测干净视频而非速度，并使用更大的噪声偏移。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出PixVid方法，将预训练潜在视频扩散模型改造为直接在像素空间生成每一帧，以实现高分辨率、可控和交互式视频生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文关注视频生成模型的高分辨率、可控和交互式生成，属于世界模型（World Model）范畴，未直接涉及VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或机器人操作，但与机器人世界建模和交互式视频生成有方法论相关性。

papers.abstract: Remasking allows diffusion language models to revisit generated text, but effective correction requires knowing when and what to revise. Our diagnosis on Sudoku reveals two gaps. Hidden states contain error information that token confidence does not reliably expose, and remasking an isolated error usually reproduces it when the surrounding context remains fixed. These findings motivate DiVR , a verifier that predicts whether a partially generated sequence will reach a correct answer. Trained on the final correctness of the model's own trajectories, DiVR decides when to regenerate a block and which alternative to retain, while the generator itself stays unchanged. On five reasoning benchmarks with LLaDA-8B-Base, DiVR raises the average accuracy of the fine-tuned generator from 35.3\% to 43.4\% at $1.9$-$3.5\times$ the cost of greedy decoding, above search baselines that use $3.8$-$7.4\times$. It also complements post-training such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and generalizes to other generators, including Dream.

analysis.key_results: 在五个推理基准上，DiVR将微调后LLaDA-8B-Base的平均准确率从35.3%提高到43.4%，成本为贪婪解码的1.9-3.5倍；优于使用3.8-7.4倍成本的搜索基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出DiVR，一个验证器，通过预测部分生成序列是否会得到正确答案来决定何时重新生成文本块以及保留哪个替代方案。
analysis.method: 在模型自身轨迹的最终正确性上训练验证器，用于决定何时重新生成及选择替代方案，而生成器保持不变。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出DiVR，一个学习判断扩散语言模型何时应重新生成文本块以提高推理准确性的验证器。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于扩散语言模型的推理效率，未直接涉及VLA或WAM，但其验证器和重新生成机制与推测解码等高效推理方法相关。

papers.abstract: For robots to assist, serve, and collaborate with humans, they must not only interpret human requests conveyed through language and multimodal intentional cues, but also execute long-horizon tasks that interleave navigation and manipulation. In this paper, we introduce HEIR, a resource for studying how to Harness Egocentric Intent for Human-Robot Interaction. HEIR pairs human speech, measured gaze, and egocentric video with robot observations and teleoperated navigation-manipulation trajectories, while each session preserves successive episodes, with each request fulfilled through multiple execution subtasks. The captured data, together with human-authored annotations, support the study of intent grounding, execution planning, and task completion within a unified interaction setting. To demonstrate the value of HEIR, we conduct extensive offline experiments to evaluate how models benefit from additional human-centric context across these tasks, together with real-robot experiments that assess execution task completion. HEIR thus provides a valuable resource for studying user-centric robot interaction in naturalistic household environments. Our demo and dataset are available online.

analysis.key_results: 广泛的离线实验表明模型能从额外的人类中心上下文中受益，真机实验验证了执行任务完成度。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了 HEIR 数据集，将人类语言、注视、自我中心视频与机器人观测和遥操作导航-操作轨迹配对，用于研究意图基础、执行规划和任务完成。
analysis.method: 采集并配对多模态人类意图数据与机器人遥操作轨迹，并提供了人工注释，支持离线实验和真机实验。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: HEIR 是一个用于研究如何在人机交互中利用语言、注视和自我中心视频等多种模态意图线索执行长周期导航与操作任务的数据集。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: HEIR 数据集包含视觉、语言和机器人动作轨迹，可用于训练机器人学习模型，但与视觉语言动作（VLA）模型或世界动作模型（WAM）无直接关联。

papers.abstract: Embodied interaction requires an agent to integrate multimodal perception with verbal and nonverbal behaviors to effectively communicate its intentions, including speech, body motion, and facial expressions. We present XBot-Omni, a Thinker--Talker--Actor architecture that extends the Omni paradigm to robotic modalities, including body motion and facial expressions, with ``X'' representing the extensibility to robotic-specific modalities. The Thinker processes text, images, audio, and video to formulate contextually appropriate responses, which are then realized by the Talker and Actor through speech and coordinated bodily expressions, respectively. In this report, we innovatively introduce the concept of ``Actor'' as a dedicated component for embodied agents: a coordinated, streaming module that leverages the native representations of the Thinker and Talker within an end-to-end pipeline, introducing only modest latency overhead. This unified architecture enables multimodal generation conditioned on omni-modal inputs directly to prevent information loss in staged designs. We comprehensively evaluate XBot-Omni across seven benchmarks, demonstrating strong multimodal understanding capabilities on both general-domain and robot-centric videos, as well as high-quality, natural, and well-coordinated motion generation. Furthermore, our results validate its capability to generate embodied multimodal responses directly from omni inputs, meeting the diverse requirements of embodied interaction. XBot-Omni enables robots not only to perceive the omni world but also to express themselves through speech and bodily behaviors, extending Omni models from conversational interaction to embodied communication in physical environments.

analysis.key_results: 在七个基准上综合评估，展示了通用领域与机器人中心视频上的强多模态理解能力，以及高质量、自然、协调的动作生成；能直接从全模态输入生成具身多模态响应。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 XBot-Omni 架构，创新性地引入 Actor 组件，实现具身智能体在全模态输入下协调生成语音与身体动作，支持可扩展的机器人模态。
analysis.method: 采用 Thinker-Talker-Actor 三组件架构，在端到端流水线中利用 Thinker 和 Talker 的原生表示，由 Actor 流式协调生成身体动作和面部表情，仅引入少量延迟。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: XBot-Omni 提出一种 Thinker-Talker-Actor 架构，将全模态感知与语音、动作和面部表情生成集成到端到端机器人交互模型中。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接面向具身智能体的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）建模，将全模态理解与机器人动作/表达生成统一，对 VLA 架构和真实世界交互具有重要意义。

The three examples illustrate: (1) multimodal synchronization , coordinating speech, body motion, and facial expressions to convey shyness; (2) semantic motion , aligning directional gestures with spoken references; (3) visually grounded motion , generating referential gestures toward objects identified in the visual scene. Colored speech segments and corresponding robot behaviors highlight their semantic and temporal relationships.
figures.label: Figure 1

For motion generation, semantic control translates interaction context into gesture requirements, including spatial pointing targets. The facial expression pathway combines a chunk transformer with a flow-matching generator. Output illustrations are schematic.

papers.title: XBot-Omni: An Omni-Modal Model for Embodied Understanding and Interaction

papers.abstract: General-purpose language models are trained mostly on English: over open models we review, at most, non-English pretraining data makes up only a 12% share. Models built for European languages give them far more, but score well below general-purpose models of the same size. A common concern is that, in small models, languages compete for capacity. We present Lara Mini base, a model trained from scratch on 6T tokens in English and 44 other languages, which together cover all 24 official languages of the European Union. As training progresses, the 44 other languages together come to outweigh English. To give these languages enough capacity at low cost, Lara Mini base uses a mixture of experts architecture with 7.2B total and 0.6B active parameters. Among open base models with up to 2B active parameters, it achieves the highest average score across standard English, multilingual, math, and code benchmarks, ahead of models trained on 4 to 6 times as many tokens. Its margin is largest on multilingual benchmarks in the languages it supports and on math benchmarks. It supports contexts of up to 128k tokens. We find that our MoE architecture reduces capacity competition between languages. For a single user on one GPU, without quantization, it generates text at least 1.8 times faster than any model with a higher average score. We release the weights of Lara Mini base under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license. In addition, we will release T-HellaSwag, a higher-quality machine translation of the commonsense reasoning benchmark HellaSwag into 110 language variants.

analysis.key_results: 在活跃参数不超过2B的开放基座模型中，Lara Mini Base在标准英语、多语言、数学和代码基准上取得最高平均分；在支持语言的多语言基准和数学基准上领先幅度最大；支持128k上下文；单GPU无量化生成速度至少比任何平均分更高的模型快1.8倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Lara Mini Base，一个覆盖欧盟24种官方语言的MoE多语言模型，在参数效率和推理速度上优于同类模型，并验证MoE架构减少语言间容量竞争。
analysis.method: 使用混合专家（MoE）架构，总参数7.2B，活跃参数0.6B，从头训练6T多语言token；训练过程中44种非英语语言权重超过英语。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文介绍了一个从头训练的7.2B总参数、0.6B活跃参数的MoE多语言模型Lara Mini Base，在多达2B活跃参数的开放基座模型中取得最高平均分，并在单GPU无量化情况下以至少1.8倍速度生成文本。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于多语言语言模型的高效推理和容量分配，未涉及VLA、WAM或机器人学习，但其模型量化相关的效率讨论对边缘设备上的高效推理具有一定参考价值。

papers.title: Lara Mini Base: Language Diversity as a Resource, Not a Trade-off
papers.title_zh: Lara Mini Base：语言多样性作为资源而非权衡

papers.abstract: The growing volume of process data generated by screwdriving systems, combined with advancements in computing power, data storage, and algorithms, is facilitating the application of artificial intelligence in this field. Accurately detecting and classifying screwdriving errors is crucial for ensuring product quality, avoiding costly rework in manufacturing, and supporting sustainability by facilitating the maintenance, reuse, and recycling of screw-connected products. In this context, machine learning approaches offer a promising alternative to traditional monitoring techniques, such as window-based methods or envelope curves. This study examines the use of deep learning techniques for anomaly detection and error classification in screwdriving processes. The data corpus consists of multivariate time series capturing process parameters, such as torque and rotation angle. For anomaly detection, the embedding space of a vector quantized variational autoencoder was analyzed. In terms of error classification, four different model architectures were evaluated. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of anomaly detection and confirm that deep learning models can distinguish between multiple error categories beyond traditional binary classification. This extends the capabilities of conventional monitoring approaches, achieving accuracies of up to 100%. Additionally, real-world data material was examined in order to further demonstrate model robustness. Overall the results indicate strong generalization capability and highlight the practical potential of the developed models for use in industrial screwdriving processes, eliminating the need for expert knowledge in error identification and significantly reducing manual effort and analysis time.

analysis.key_results: 异常检测有效，深度学习模型能够区分多类错误，准确率高达100%，真实数据验证表明模型具有鲁棒性。
analysis.main_contribution: 开发并评估了基于深度学习的螺丝拧紧过程异常检测与错误分类方法，验证了模型在真实数据上的有效性。
analysis.method: 使用矢量量化变分自编码器进行异常检测，并比较了四种模型架构进行错误分类。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该研究利用深度学习对螺丝拧紧过程进行异常检测和错误分类，并采用矢量量化变分自编码器进行异常分析。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文不直接涉及VLA或WAM，但使用了矢量量化技术，与本站关注的模型量化主题有部分关联。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates text generation with large language models by letting a cheap draft model propose tokens that a large verifier checks in a single forward pass. We introduce Olifant, a draft model built on a memory-based classifier. It predicts the next token from a four-token window in under 0.3 ms on CPU, requiring no GPU, no backpropagation, and no accelerator memory. We measure throughput and energy under two verifier regimes on consumer hardware. Without a KV cache, drafting is nearly free: a domain-matched Olifant model reaches 38.1% acceptance on EU legal text, delivering 2.43x throughput and 2.51x lower energy per token than the neural verifier model alone. With a KV-cached verifier, itself a ~10x energy saver, drafting costs matter: a TinyLlama draft model halves throughput and triples energy despite high acceptance, whereas Olifant still yields 1.25x throughput and the lowest energy in the study (93 J per 100 tokens, 14x below the uncached baseline). We further show that KV caching decouples time from energy: verification of longer drafts raises power draw, shifting the energy-optimal draft length below the speed-optimal one. Speculative decoding is not dead in the age of fast verifiers, provided drafting is nearly free.

analysis.key_results: 在无 KV 缓存下，领域匹配的 Olifant 达到 38.1% 接受率，取得 2.43 倍吞吐和 2.51 倍的单位词元能耗降低；在 KV 缓存验证器下，仍获 1.25 倍吞吐和最低能耗（每 100 词元 93 J，比无缓存基线低 14 倍）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Olifant，一种基于内存的分类器草稿模型，无需 GPU、反向传播或加速器内存，且在 CPU 上单次预测延迟低于 0.3 ms。
analysis.method: 使用基于内存的分类器，从四词元窗口预测下一词元，并与大型验证模型配合进行推测解码。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出 Olifant，一种基于内存分类器的推测解码草稿模型，在 CPU 上以极低开销提升文本生成吞吐并降低能耗。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该文专注于独立推测解码效率问题，未涉及 VLA、世界模型或机器人动作建模，对本站议题无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Planning for a heterogeneous robot team from a scene image and an instruction involves two kinds of decisions. Some must be judged from the scene: which goals are already met, how the task splits, and which robot does what. Others follow from these and can be computed: prerequisite actions, handoffs between robots, and timing. We argue that each kind should go to the component suited to it: a small vision-language model learns the first, and a deterministic solver computes the second. In NSDL (Neuro-Symbolic Division of Labor), the trained model writes its judgments as a plan sketch, which lists the goals that still need action and the intended steps in order, each with a robot. The solver expands the sketch into an executable joint plan. The model calls two tools, a detector for evidence and the solver, and is trained with the solver in the loop. We evaluate on the public VIKI-L2 benchmark and on LOCUS-Bench, a new benchmark that grades the two kinds of difficulty separately. NSDL outperforms end-to-end planners and formalize-then-plan baselines on both benchmarks and with three backbones from 3B to 8B; the 7B model reaches 97.0% out-of-distribution accuracy on VIKI-L2. Ordering and scheduling errors nearly disappear once the solver writes the structure; the remaining failures are misjudged states, and most goals the model misses are ones it never lists. Code, model weights, and LOCUS-Bench are publicly available at https://github.com/Xincheng-Tan/NSDL.

analysis.key_results: 在VIKI-L2和LOCUS-Bench两个基准上超越端到端规划器和先形式化再规划的基线；7B模型在VIKI-L2上达到97.0%的分布外准确率；排序和调度误差在求解器生成结构后几乎消失。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未说明（可能剩余失败为错误判断的状态，模型遗漏的大多数目标从未被列出）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出NSDL（神经符号分工）框架，将场景判断与可计算推理分离：小型VLM生成计划草图，确定性求解器扩展为完整计划，实现高效的多机器人任务规划。
analysis.method: 训练小型视觉语言模型，利用检测器和求解器两个工具，在求解器参与下进行循环训练；模型输出计划草图（包含仍需行动的目标及有序步骤，每步指定机器人），由求解器扩展为可执行联合计划。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出NSDL框架，让小型视觉语言模型生成计划草图，由确定性求解器扩展为可执行的多机器人联合计划，在VIKI-L2和LOCUS-Bench上取得最佳性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文聚焦多机器人任务规划，核心是小规模视觉语言模型，属于视觉语言行动（VLA）在机器人规划中的应用，对本站主题具有直接相关性。

papers.abstract: Actions in expert demonstrations exhibit temporal structure. An ordered-versus-shuffled analysis across five environments confirms this dependence. We ask whether action proposals that better reflect expert continuity can improve visual world-model planning. Rather than imposing generic smoothness, we learn continuations from the temporal structure of demonstrated actions. Our locality-gated deep-kernel Gaussian-process prior, LG-DKGP, combines recent and longer-range executed action history, predicts a neural continuation, and learns a temporal Gaussian-process (GP) residual. A training-derived exploration scale initializes search around the corrected mean; a frozen world model evaluates progress toward the goal. Training first fits the neural mean, then jointly optimizes the prior with the GP residual using expert future actions. The resulting planner achieves 87.07\% macro success across five simulated tasks spanning native and fragment-level goal attainment, compared with 71.03\% for INTACT, 61.66\% for PRISM, and 58.66\% for LeWM. Component interventions and expert-relative action-structure comparisons support demonstration-informed continuations and reveal task-dependent effects of visual conditioning, history length, and planning horizon.

analysis.key_results: 在五个模拟任务上取得 87.07% 宏平均成功率，对比 INTACT 为 71.03%，PRISM 为 61.66%，LeWM 为 58.66%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 locality-gated deep-kernel Gaussian-process prior (LG-DKGP)，利用演示动作的时序结构学习动作连续性先验，从而提升世界模型规划的成功率。
analysis.method: LG-DKGP 结合最近和长程已执行动作历史，预测神经连续性，并学习时序高斯过程残差；训练过程先拟合神经均值，再联合优化先验与 GP 残差。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出一种基于演示动作时序结构的连续性感知先验，以改进视觉世界模型规划中的动作提议生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文聚焦于世界模型规划中的动作先验学习，通过利用演示动作的时序结构提升规划性能，属于视觉世界模型与机器人操作控制范畴，与 WAM（世界动作模型）密切相关，但未明确涉及 VLA（视觉-语言-动作）架构。

papers.abstract: Frontier models such as GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 can now plan and call tools, yet they still struggle to drive real robots through long-horizon, contact-rich manipulation, blind while the arm moves and while they think. We present Reins, a harness in which an off-the-shelf model operates a dual-arm robot with 3D perception tools and atomic actions that report contact and grip. The model chains actions in one call, each with a condition that must hold, stopping at the first that fails; a second instance, the narrator, watches the cameras continuously and reports what changed with every result. From images, Reins also builds a simulation-ready twin of the scene for continual policy learning. With natural-language prompts and no task-specific code, GPT-6.1 Sol succeeds in 88% of real episodes on five tasks; without the harness, it fails every shell game, taking 8 times as long. Three frontier models perform alike but differ in tracking a scene that changes while the actor thinks. Code will be released upon publication.

analysis.key_results: GPT-6.1 Sol在五个任务上的真实场景成功率达88%；无该框架时所有藏豆任务失败且耗时8倍；三个前沿模型表现相似，但场景跟踪能力因模型而异。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Reins框架，使现成的前沿模型无需任务特定代码即可操作真实双臂机器人，通过连续动作条件、观察者叙述和可仿真场景重建，显著提高了长程操作任务的成功率与效率。
analysis.method: 在单次调用中链接带条件的原子动作，失败即停；第二个实例作为叙述者持续观察摄像头并报告变化；从图像构建可仿真的场景孪生用于持续策略学习。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出了一种名为Reins的框架，利用现成的前沿多模态模型驱动真实双臂机器人，通过连续动作条件、观察者叙述和自动场景孪生，实现了长程接触丰富操作任务的零样本执行。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接利用视觉-语言模型驱动机器人操作，属于VLA在真实机器人长程操作任务中的实际应用，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning can teach vision-language models (VLMs) to decline harmful image-text requests, but how safe the result becomes is set indirectly, through reward weights found by trial runs. Stating safety as budgets on the rate of harmful assistance and the rate of over-refusal, enforced by Lagrange multipliers inside GRPO with an off-the-shelf scorer as the cost, is the natural fix, and it fails twice. The multiplier compares the scorer's mean with the budget, and scorers built for ranking get the mean wrong: a fixed-point analysis shows that the mean bias, not the budget, then decides whether the multiplier settles, saturates or switches off. And standard GRPO standardizes the penalized reward within each group, which cancels the multiplier before it reaches the gradient. Two-channel constrained GRPO repairs both: the base reward keeps the raw score for the within-group comparison, the penalty and the constraint estimate pass through a monotone map fitted on judge-labeled training responses, and the advantage keeps the multiplier. On a Qwen3-VL-2B policy with a training-free readout of an open 4B model as the scorer, held-out harm on 1,037 adversarial prompts falls from 8.9% under standard GRPO to 4.8%, lower in every seed, where the uncalibrated budget gives 7.6%; over-refusal stays at most 2% on 400 benign queries and MMBench is unchanged. The gain is largest where the intent sits in the image (10.1% -> 5.1%) and grows on the unseen HADES benchmark (28.9% -> 12.8%). Order-preserving distortions of the scores reproduce each predicted controller state in every seed, and the results hold under a map fitted on another judge's labels, an image-reading judge and a human audit.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3-VL-2B策略上，使用开源4B模型作为训练免费的评分器，1,037个对抗性提示上的有害响应率从标准GRPO的8.9%降至4.8%，过度拒绝率在400个良性查询上保持在2%以内，MMBench性能未变；在图像意图场景中从10.1%降至5.1%，未见HADES基准上从28.9%降至12.8%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出双通道约束GRPO，修复标准约束GRPO中均值偏差和组内标准化导致拉格朗日乘子失效的两个问题，实现安全预算的精确控制。
analysis.method: 双通道约束GRPO：基础奖励保持原始分数用于组内比较，惩罚和约束估计通过基于法官标注训练响应拟合的单调映射传递，优势函数保留拉格朗日乘子。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 针对视觉语言模型的安全微调，提出双通道约束GRPO方法，通过校准约束惩罚与优势函数，在降低有害响应率的同时控制过度拒绝。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于视觉语言模型的安全对齐与强化学习微调，并未涉及VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或WAM（世界-动作模型），与本站主题无直接关系；但其对约束强化学习中奖励校准和优势函数修正的方法，可能对机器人策略的安全约束学习具有潜在借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation often requires both spatial scene understanding and task history. However, many vision-language-action (VLA) policies rely primarily on current observations, without explicitly integrating spatial structure and task history. Appearance-based memories can be sensitive to occlusion and viewpoint changes, while spatial representations of the current scene alone do not preserve how the scene has changed during task execution. We introduce STVLA, a framework that incorporates features from a pretrained visual geometry foundation model into temporal memory alongside visual representations. This allows the policy to recall past scene structure as context for current action decisions. To select informative history, STVLA uses a mathematically grounded scoring rule that balances relevance to the current observation with complementary evidence from memory. Across evaluations on LIBERO, LIBERO-Mem, MIKASA-Robo, and SimplerEnv Bridge, STVLA achieves the highest average success rate among the compared methods on each benchmark. On real-world block stacking, object organization, and phone packaging, it improves success over $\pi_{0.5}$ by $58.33$, $30.00$, and $35.00$ percentage points, respectively. These results support integrating scene geometry into temporal memory to improve manipulation requiring both spatial precision and task history. Project website: \href{https://stvla.github.io/}{https://stvla.github.io/}

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Mem、MIKASA-Robo和SimplerEnv Bridge基准上，STVLA在所有对比方法中取得了最高的平均成功率；在真实世界的积木堆叠、物品整理和手机包装任务上，成功率分别比π0.5提高了58.33、30.00和35.00个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出STVLA框架，将预训练视觉几何基础模型的特征与视觉表示一起融入时序记忆，并引入一种基于数学规则的评分方法来选择对当前观察具有相关性和互补性的历史信息。
analysis.method: STVLA利用预训练视觉几何基础模型提取空间特征，将其与视觉表示结合存储为时序记忆；在决策时，根据当前观察与记忆中的证据，采用平衡相关性与互补性的评分规则选择历史信息。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: STVLA通过将预训练视觉几何基础模型的特征融入时序记忆，使VLA策略能够回忆过去场景结构并改进需要空间精度和任务历史的机器人操作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对VLA模型，通过引入空间感知的时序记忆来增强机器人操作中的空间精度和任务历史利用，属于VLA核心方法的改进。

papers.abstract: Photonic neural network accelerators have emerged as a promising solution for reducing the power consumption of deep neural network (DNN) inference by executing matrix multiplication on analog photonic hardware. However, their inference accuracy is limited by low-bit quantization required for photonic processing and by analog photonic noise. This paper proposes an approach for improving inference accuracy by exploiting the high similarity among activation vectors in DNNs. Specifically, our approach constructs a representative vector for each group of similar activation vectors, computes its inner product digitally with high precision, and offloads the residual inner products to the photonic accelerator. Since the activation vectors within each group are highly similar, the residual vectors have much smaller norms, thereby reducing the effects of quantization errors and analog photonic noise. Furthermore, our approach preserves the photonic inner-product computation pipeline, allowing seamless integration into existing and future photonic accelerators without hardware modification. Experimental results on six representative DNN models demonstrate that the proposed approach can improve inference accuracy across diverse network architectures and application domains.

analysis.key_results: 在六个代表性DNN模型上验证，方法能提升不同网络架构和应用领域的推理精度。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SPARC方法，利用激活向量的高相似性，通过数字高精度计算代表向量的内积，并将残差内积卸载到光子加速器，从而在无需硬件修改的情况下提高光子神经网络推理精度。
analysis.method: 构建相似激活向量的代表向量，数字计算代表向量内积，光子计算残差内积；利用残差向量范数小来降低量化误差和光子噪声影响。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种利用激活向量相似性减少量化误差和光子噪声的光子神经网络推理精度提升方法。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于光子加速器上的量化误差缓解，属于独立的模型量化技术，未直接涉及VLA或WAM。但其高效推理方法可能对资源受限的机器人模型部署有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Photonic neural accelerators offer ultra-low latency linear algebra, yet their usable numerical precision, sustainable throughput, and application accuracy remain tightly bounded by surrounding electro-optical interfaces and physical non-idealities. Pre-fabrication design-space exploration (DSE) requires a cross-layer electronic design automation (EDA) framework capable of evaluating disparate optical topologies under identical neural workloads and physical assumptions. We present \textbf{PISim}, a unified Photonic Inference Simulator that couples pretrained deep neural network execution with physics-based models of six accelerator architecture families, six electro-optic modulator technologies, four optical source organizations, and direct or coherent readout schemes. PISim embeds stage-resolved impairment operators---covering control and analog-to-digital quantization, finite extinction ratio, shot noise, correlated relative-intensity noise (RIN), thermal drift, propagation loss, and channel crosstalk---alongside an analytical cycle-level interface timing model to expose electronic-optical bottlenecks. Using simulated MNIST multilayer perceptron (MLP) benchmarks, we demonstrate how PISim identifies optimal precision operating points under multi-impairment stress (peaking at 6 bits for Mach--Zehnder and microring modulators), quantifies a 52.5 percentage-point accuracy gap between VCSEL-array and parallel-fanout laser architectures arising, under the modeled conditions, from power partitioning and correlated source noise, and models interface-limited throughput scaling across emitter-array widths from 32 to 128 channels. This comprehensive framework establishes an extensible, reproducible foundation for accuracy-constrained Pareto optimization prior to photonic tape-out.

analysis.key_results: 在模拟 MNIST MLP 基准上，识别出马赫-曾德尔和微环调制器的最佳精度工作点为 6 比特；发现 VCSEL 阵列与并行扇出激光器架构存在 52.5% 的精度差距；并模拟了发射阵列宽度从 32 到 128 通道的接口受限吞吐量扩展。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 PISim 统一光子推理模拟器，耦合预训练深度网络与六种加速器架构、调制器技术、光源组织及读出方案，嵌入多类型物理损伤和时序模型，支撑光子流片前的跨层设计空间探索。
analysis.method: 开发 PISim 模拟框架，集成阶段级损伤算子（控制/ADC 量化、有限消光比、散粒噪声、相对强度噪声、热漂移、传播损耗、串扰）和解析的周期级接口时序模型，用于评估光子神经网络加速器的精度和吞吐量。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PISim 是一个统一的光子推理模拟器，用于在物理非理想性和接口限制下评估神经网络的精度和吞吐量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于光子神经网络加速器的量化与设计空间探索，不涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人动作-世界建模；但与本站支持的模型量化主题有直接的方法学相关性，可作为硬件感知高效推理的参考。

papers.abstract: While quantization compresses LLMs and accelerates inference, outlier activations impede efficient low-bit representation. In particular, massive outliers cause substantial performance degradation. Although rotation-based methods that rely on randomized Hadamard transforms for online inference aim to mitigate this, they can produce fragmented distributions with empty bins when a massive outlier dominates a token's activation. This fragmentation severely undermines uniform quantization performance. Moreover, massive outliers concentrate in the down-projection input, where the preceding nonlinearity requires the rotation to be applied at inference time. This constraint prevents training-based approaches such as SpinQuant from learning the online rotation at this position, as a learned dense matrix cannot use the Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform and would require a full matrix multiplication during inference. To address this, we propose SignRot (Sign-adjusted Rotation), which identifies massive outlier channels and constructs a sign adjustment vector that unifies the signs of the corresponding Hadamard row, collapsing the bimodal distribution into a unimodal profile amenable to quantization. Since the aligned outlier shifts the activation mean away from zero, we pair SignRot with asymmetric activation quantization, whose zero-point absorbs this shift. As a lightweight, drop-in improvement compatible with any Hadamard-based quantization method, SignRot requires only a single calibration forward pass and adds only element-wise sign flips at inference, without an additional matrix multiplication. Applying SignRot to QuaRot achieves a WikiText2 perplexity of 5.88 and an average zero-shot reasoning accuracy of 72.73, surpassing SpinQuant on the LLaMA3-70B model. Code is available at https://github.com/HYU-ARK-Lab/SignRot.

analysis.key_results: 在LLaMA3-70B模型上，将SignRot应用于QuaRot，WikiText2困惑度达到5.88，平均零样本推理准确率达到72.73，超越了SpinQuant。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SignRot（Sign-adjusted Rotation），一种轻量级即插即用的改进方法，适用于任何基于Hadamard的量化方法，通过识别大规模离群通道并统一Hadamard行符号，将双峰分布折叠为单峰，并配合非对称激活量化吸收偏移，无需额外的矩阵乘法。
analysis.method: SignRot通过校准前向传播识别大规模离群通道，构造符号调整向量统一Hadamard行符号，并采用非对称激活量化处理均值偏移。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SignRot通过符号调整旋转，将离群值导致的双峰激活分布折叠为单峰，并在推理时仅增加逐元素符号翻转，以解决低比特量化中大规模离群值带来的性能下降问题。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文提出的SignRot是一种高效的模型量化技术，虽未直接涉及VLA或WAM，但作为提升LLM推理效率的方法，可潜在应用于基于LLM的机器人模型或世界模型中，以降低部署成本。

papers.abstract: Local language models often exist at several precisions, and quantization is known to change individual answers. This study asks whether the disagreement between two precisions of the same weights, an 8-bit copy that answers and a lower-precision copy that reads the same prompt, works as a per-question error score for abstention, escalation and re-asking. The cost is one extra forward pass over fewer bytes, with no sampling and no training. We simulate round-to-nearest quantization with per-group scales (3 to 6 bits, groups of 32 to 256) on Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B and score 8,398 multiple-choice questions from ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, MMLU and HellaSwag subsets. Error detection is measured by AUROC, risk-coverage curves and ECE on a held-out half, with paired bootstrap intervals over questions. For Qwen3-0.6B, the entropy of the 8-bit answer reaches AUROC 0.682; the best disagreement score, selected on a development half, reaches 0.684 (+0.001 [-0.009, +0.011]), and combining it with the confidence features adds +0.009 [+0.002, +0.015], mostly on ARC. On Qwen3-1.7B the selected score is -0.001 [-0.009, +0.006] from entropy and the combination +0.003 [-0.001, +0.006] on the test half. Gaussian weight noise at matched error energy is about as informative as rounding (0.6B only), so we find no evidence that the signal is specific to quantization, and shuffling the features within task and entropy cells removes the gain. One extra 8-bit pass that shifts the option order does better (+0.049 [+0.031, +0.067] over entropy) at about a third more weight traffic; routing to a larger model on free entropy beats both extra-pass scores at equal total traffic. After logistic recalibration the 0.6B confidences are calibrated within a few points of ECE. A deployment recipe and the cases where the method does not help are given.

analysis.key_results: Qwen3-0.6B的最佳分歧分数AUROC为0.684，与熵相比提升0.001；结合置信特征提升0.009（主要在ARC上）。Qwen3-1.7B上该方法无效。高斯权重噪声在匹配误差能量下与量化同样有效，表明信号不特定于量化。改变选项顺序的额外8位前向传播在AUROC上比熵提高0.049，优于分歧分数。
analysis.limitations: 该方法在Qwen3-1.7B上未能改进熵；信号不特定于量化；在特征按任务和熵单元打乱后增益消失；仅评估了有限规模和类型的模型及选择题任务。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并验证了一种基于同一模型8位与低位量化副本输出分歧的无训练、无采样错误检测分数，用于选择性弃权、升级或重问。
analysis.method: 使用按组缩放的舍入到最近量化（3-6位，组大小32-256）在Qwen3-0.6B和Qwen3-1.7B上模拟，对8,398道选择题（ARC-Easy、ARC-Challenge、MMLU、HellaSwag子集）进行评分，并用AUROC、风险-覆盖率曲线和ECE评估，配以成对自助法置信区间。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究同一模型不同精度副本之间的分歧是否可作为语言模型选择题的逐题错误检测分数。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于模型量化在语言模型错误检测中的应用，不涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作-世界建模。其独立研究的量化-分歧错误检测思想可能为高效机器人模型推理中的不确定性估计提供借鉴，但摘要未建立直接联系。

papers.abstract: The reduced availability of medical datasets represents an important challenge in the development of predictive models for remote healthcare solutions, especially when the available data are imbalanced or difficult to extend through traditional methods. Small Language Models (SLMs) have become a promising alternative to Large Language Models (LLMs) for addressing these limitations due to their lower computational requirements and adaptability to specialized tasks. However, their performance remains highly dependent on the quality and representativeness of the available training data. In this paper, we propose a method for clinical data augmentation based on a fine-tuned Microsoft Phi-2 model that is used to generate synthetic instances, with the purpose of improving deep learning-based model for predicting remotely monitored vital signs. The Phi-2 model was adapted to the medical domain through supervised fine-tuning on the MedQuad dataset, through a Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA)-based method and by applying few-shot prompting techniques. The resulting model was used afterwards in the augmentation of a small-sized dataset, composed of vital sign values and labels associated with pathological and physiological states. The experimental results demonstrate that fine-tuned SLMs improved the performance on medical domain, achieving higher scores for both lexical (ROUGE) and semantic (BERTScore) evaluation metrics compared to the pretrained model. Moreover, the fine-tuned SLM is effective for generating structured synthetic clinical data. When used for data augmentation, the generated dataset improved the performance of a LSTM predictive model, increasing the classification accuracy from 89.0% to 93.7% and showing consistent improvements in precision, recall, and F1-score.

analysis.key_results: 精调后的SLM在ROUGE和BERTScore指标上优于预训练模型；生成的数据增强使LSTM分类准确率从89.0%提高到93.7%，精度、召回率和F1分数也一致提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种基于QLoRA精调Microsoft Phi-2模型进行临床数据增强的方法，生成合成实例以改善远程监测生命体征预测模型。
analysis.method: 在MedQuad数据集上对Phi-2进行监督式QLoRA微调，并使用少样本提示策略，随后用于生成合成生命体征及其病理/生理状态标签，通过数据增强训练LSTM预测模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出通过QLoRA精调Phi-2小语言模型生成合成临床数据，以增强数据不足的小型数据集，并提升LSTM模型对远程监测生命体征的预测性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文聚焦于医疗领域的模型量化与数据增强，不直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人技术。其QLoRA量化微调方法对本站高效的模型推理主题具有方法论参考价值，但与VLA/WAM无直接联系。

papers.abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces the memory footprint and inference cost of large language models (LLMs), yet accurate FP4 quantization remains challenging. Practical formats such as MXFP4, NVFP4, and HiF4 pair a 4-bit floating-point payload with block-wise or hierarchical scale codes, making accuracy highly sensitive to how each local distribution is scaled. Default maximum-absolute-value scaling preserves dynamic range, but can spend scarce FP4 levels on rarely occupied outlier regions and leave dense tensor values poorly resolved. Existing scale-search methods minimize local element-wise reconstruction error, optimizing tensor fidelity rather than layer-output fidelity. We propose SoScale, a second-order weight scale-code search method for hierarchical FP4 quantization. SoScale searches hardware-valid scale codes under a Hessian-aware layer reconstruction objective and couples this search with GPTQ-style error recovery, selecting scales by their impact on layer outputs. Across Qwen3 models, SoScale consistently reduces downstream quantization degradation under MXFP4, NVFP4, and HiF4.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3模型上，SoScale在MXFP4、NVFP4和HiF4格式下一致地减少了量化引起的下游性能下降。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SoScale，一种用于分层FP4量化的二阶权重缩放码搜索方法，在硬件有效的缩放码下进行Hessian感知的层重建，并与GPTQ式误差恢复耦合。
analysis.method: 在分层FP4量化中，基于Hessian感知的层重建目标，搜索硬件有效的缩放码，并结合GPTQ式误差恢复。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SoScale提出一种面向分层FP4量化的二阶权重缩放码搜索方法，通过Hessian感知的层次重建目标来减少量化误差。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于LLM的低比特量化，与VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或WAM（世界-动作模型）无直接关系，但其高效推理方法可能对资源受限的机器人策略部署具有潜在参考价值。

papers.abstract: Physical AI aims to learn transferable physical knowledge from real-world experience to understand, predict, and act in the physical world. Internet videos and embodied demonstrations provide complementary observations of motion, interaction, and state evolution. A foundational data challenge is to measure and preserve this physical information as training supervision. In video-language pretraining, captions express observed processes in language, yet a semantically correct description can omit the interactions and transitions that define those processes. Rich physical experience in video does not automatically translate into sufficient language supervision. This gap calls for a yardstick to assess annotation quality, compare captioning strategies, and guide training-data refinement. Motivated by our data construction for world-model pretraining, we introduce PhysCapBench, to our knowledge the first unified physical-caption benchmark spanning all three domains: third-person scenes, egocentric manipulation, and handheld-gripper demonstrations. It provides human-verified annotations for 1,500 video sequences and evaluates accuracy and coverage through seven physical dimensions. We examine downstream utility through video reconstruction and manipulation-policy fine-tuning. Physical captions reduce reconstruction LPIPS by 8.6-9.5% on third-person videos and 26.9-30.9% on egocentric videos relative to metadata captions. Training-instruction enrichment improves both PhysCapBench scores and policy success, including a 7.5-percentage-point gain for pi0.5 on a RoboTwin 2.0 subtask. PhysCapBench makes the physical content of language supervision inspectable and comparable, providing a cross-domain basis for its evaluation and improvement.

analysis.key_results: 物理描述相对元数据描述在第三方视频上将重建LPIPS降低8.6-9.5%，在第一人称视频上降低26.9-30.9%；训练指令增强同时提升PhysCapBench分数和策略成功率，在RoboTwin 2.0子任务上为pi0.5带来7.5个百分点的提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入PhysCapBench，一个覆盖三个领域（第三方场景、第一人称操作、手持夹爪演示）的物理描述基准，提供1500个视频序列的人工验证标注和七个物理维度的评估指标，并展示其在视频重建和操作策略微调中的下游效用。
analysis.method: 构建跨领域视频描述基准，通过七个物理维度评估标注的准确性和覆盖率，并结合视频重建和操作策略微调实验验证下游任务性能。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PhysCapBench是首个统一评估第三方视角、第一人称操作和手持夹爪演示视频物理描述质量的跨领域基准。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作提供面向物理世界建模的数据标注质量评估基准，主要服务于世界模型预训练和操作策略微调，但未直接涉及VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或WAM（世界-动作模型）的核心方法，属于对机器人学习数据质量的间接支持。

papers.abstract: Whole-body motion tracking lets a humanoid robot follow reference motions, but training a tracking policy for a library of motions has usually taken hours of GPU time. SuperMimic showed that the policy can instead be trained by backpropagating through a world model learned from parallel simulation, and InstantTrack added Muon updates, a residual policy around the reference and an averaged deployed policy. We build on both and present BlinkMimic, a recipe that makes this training faster. On a simulated Unitree G1, BlinkMimic trains one policy for all 40 LAFAN1 clips in 3.4 minutes on a single RTX 4090, measured until three consecutive checkpoints reach a normalized return of at least 0.82 with no failed clip (mean of three seeds). We split training time into the cost of an iteration, the iterations needed to fit the motions, and the iterations needed to remove the last failures, and assign each component, inherited or new, to one of these terms. The new components are a step size that decreases once training has progressed, resets directed by failures of the deployed policy under deployment conditions, and GPU graph capture of the whole iteration. A leave-one-out ablation with three seeds per component shows which term each component affects, and further measurements of the gradient, the update rule and the failure cases explain these effects. Code and per-seed results are available at https://github.com/fuyichen0725/blinkmimic.

analysis.key_results: 在模拟的Unitree G1上，3.4分钟内训练出覆盖40个LAFAN1片段的单一策略，三个种子平均达到归一化回报至少0.82且无失败片段。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出BlinkMimic配方，通过递减步长、基于部署条件失败重置、以及GPU图捕获整个迭代，显著加速基于世界模型的策略训练。
analysis.method: 基于世界模型的反向传播训练策略，结合递减学习率、失败驱动的重置和GPU图捕获优化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: BlinkMimic提出一种训练方法，使单张RTX 4090上训练人形机器人全身动作跟踪策略的时间缩短到3.4分钟。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作以并行仿真学习的世界模型为核心，实现了人形机器人动作跟踪策略的快速训练，与WAM主题直接相关。

papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a powerful foundation for robotic scene understanding, task planning, and language-conditioned control. A natural question follows: can these models also decode what a human operator intends while teleoperating a robot, without any explicit instruction? We formulate this as hierarchical intent prediction, jointly inferring the ongoing atomic action and the broader mission it serves from a short visual teleoperation history. To study this, we introduce VI AMO (Vision Intention Action and Mission Ongoing), a dataset of 6,600 episodes from eleven robot sources with 13,653 temporally aligned action annotations and 9,702 mission annotations. Large proprietary models struggle with this problem: on held-out episodes, GPT-4o reaches Sentence-BERT similarities of only 0.563 and 0.470 for action and mission, and GPT-5.6 Luna achieves only 0.581 and 0.554. Fine-tuning a VLM on VI AMO yields our Vision-Intention Model (VIM), which raises these scores to 0.825 and 0.821 and still reaches 0.726 and 0.717 on the 35.4% of test actions with both labels absent from training. Finally, as a downstream application, VIM's predicted mission enables a vision-language-action (VLA) policy to take over from the operator mid-task in a real-world environment unseen during VIM fine-tuning, reducing human teleoperation time by 34.6% relative to GPT-4o and 39.8% relative to GPT-5.6 Luna, while cutting intent-prediction latency by roughly 70% on average.

analysis.key_results: GPT-4o的Sentence-BERT相似度仅为动作0.563、任务0.470，GPT-5.6 Luna为0.581和0.554；VIM将两者提升至0.825和0.821，在训练中未见标签的测试动作上仍达0.726和0.717；下游任务中VIM使遥操作时间相对GPT-4o减少34.6%、相对GPT-5.6 Luna减少39.8%，意图预测延迟平均降低约70%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出VI AMO数据集（来自11个机器人源的6600个片段，含13653个动作标注和9702个任务标注）以及基于该数据集微调的VIM模型，大幅提升了动作和任务意图预测精度，并验证了预测意图能加速VLA策略接管。
analysis.method: 引入分层意图预测任务，在VI AMO数据集上微调视觉语言模型得到VIM；利用VIM预测的任务意图使VLA策略在操作中接管，以减少人类遥操作时间和意图预测延迟。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出从视觉遥操作历史中联合预测人类操作员的原子动作和更高层任务意图，并展示了该意图预测对VLA策略接管的加速效果。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文以视觉语言模型为基础，构建意图预测数据集并微调得到VIM，直接服务于VLA策略在真实环境中的任务接管，属于VLA相关研究，主要贡献在于数据集和意图预测模型，为机器人策略提供高层任务信息以加速操作。

papers.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an effective post-training approach to improving fine-grained perception in multimodal large language models by amortizing costly inference-time zooming operations into a single-pass recipe. However, vanilla OPD is inherently susceptible to linguistic momentum: the teacher can follow the student's erroneous prefixes, thus weakening corrective supervision. To address this, we propose Blink On-Policy Distillation (BlinkOPD), in which the teacher "blinks" at every token: it reads the same prefix once with its eyes open and once with its eyes closed. A first-glance gain further strengthens the correction on rollouts that conflict with the teacher. By extracting more effective supervision from each on-policy trajectory, BlinkOPD achieves state-of-the-art average performance across six fine-grained benchmarks using only 500 training images (12x less data) than existing OPD methods. Beyond fine-grained perception, BlinkOPD also demonstrates strong zero-shot improvements across ten held-out benchmarks spanning general visual perception, visual hallucination, and multimodal reasoning abilities. Code: https://github.com/Supltz/BlinkOPD

analysis.key_results: 在六个细粒度基准上，仅使用500张训练图像（比现有OPD方法少12倍数据）达到最先进平均性能；在十个保留基准上显示出强大的零样本提升，覆盖通用视觉感知、视觉幻觉和多模态推理能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Blink On-Policy Distillation (BlinkOPD)，通过在策略蒸馏中让教师对学生前缀进行两种视角的审阅，并利用first-glance gain强化纠错，从而打破语言惯性，提升细粒度多模态感知性能。
analysis.method: On-policy distillation，教师在每个token处以睁眼（正常视觉输入）和闭眼（无视觉输入）两种方式读取同一前缀，并根据冲突情况进行额外增益。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出BlinkOPD，通过让教师在每个token处分别以睁眼和闭眼方式读取前缀来打破语言惯性，从而提升多模态大模型细粒度感知的策略蒸馏效果。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文聚焦多模态大模型的细粒度感知蒸馏，不直接涉及机器人视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型或世界模型（WAM）。但其探索的高效训练和推理优化思想，可能对视觉-语言模型的性能提升有借鉴意义，与本网站关注的高效推理主题有间接关联。

papers.abstract: Navigation agents use a large language model (LLM) planner to call a vision-language-action (VLA) model. Each episode needs the LLM, adding cost and delay. We distill successful agent experience into the VLA instead of distilling the planner. The VLA then navigates alone at test time. Agent sessions are not VLA demonstrations. They include motions driven by planner tools and sub-instructions, along with detours. We present H2E, a task-level experience distillation method that converts these sessions into VLA training data. Every motion becomes a VLA action under the original task instruction, with the resulting poses as targets. H2E masks the loss on steps that move away from the goal. It labels every visited state within 1 m of the goal as a stop. We then update the VLA with low-rank adaptation. The VLA learns to stop at the goal and find goals the base model never reaches. On all 3,189 REVERIE-CE val-unseen episodes, H2E raises the success rate of an 8B VLA from 35.0% to 44.9%.

analysis.key_results: 在 REVERIE-CE val-unseen 的 3,189 个 episode 上，将 8B VLA 的成功率从 35.0% 提升到 44.9%；VLA 学会在目标处停止，并能找到基础模型从未到达过的目标。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 H2E (task-level experience distillation) 方法，将智能体会话（而非人工演示）转换为 VLA 训练数据，通过低秩适应更新，使 VLA 在测试时独立导航。
analysis.method: 将智能体会话中的每个动作映射到原始任务指令下的 VLA 动作，使用对应位姿作为目标；对远离目标步骤损失进行掩码，将目标1米内的状态标记为停止；用 LoRA 更新 VLA。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出 H2E 任务级经验蒸馏方法，将导航智能体的成功经验转换为 VLA 训练数据，使 VLA 在测试时无需 LLM 规划器即可独立导航。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文以 VLA 模型为核心，通过经验蒸馏提升其在具身导航任务中的独立执行能力，移除测试时对 LLM 规划器的依赖，属于 VLA 策略学习与高效推理的交叉应用。

papers.abstract: LiDAR point clouds exhibit scan-induced spatial regularities that are informative for geometry compression. Existing scan-aware approaches often exploit these regularities by transforming coded geometry into spherical or beam-aligned coordinate systems. However, this couples acquisition priors with geometry representation, altering spatial partitioning and quantization, and potentially preventing exact recovery of the original Cartesian geometry. We argue that acquisition priors should guide probability modeling rather than dictate the coding representation. We propose SPEM, a Scan-Prior Entropy Modeling framework that exploits LiDAR scanning regularities within the entropy model without requiring coordinate transformation. We introduce a multi-frequency spherical rotary positional encoding that captures scan-aligned spatial relationships in both backbone self-attention and decoded-context retrieval. Building upon this encoding, we develop a decoded-memory autoregressive predictor that efficiently exploits previously decoded occupancy information through reusable key/value caches. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in both lossy and lossless LiDAR geometry compression, highlighting the effectiveness of scan-prior modeling across different coordinate representations.

analysis.key_results: 在有损和无损LiDAR几何压缩中均取得最优性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SPEM框架，将采集先验用于概率建模而非坐标变换，实现LiDAR点云的有损与无损压缩。
analysis.method: 多频球面旋转位置编码与解码记忆自回归预测器，利用可重用键值缓存。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出SPEM，一种利用LiDAR扫描规律进行熵建模的点云压缩框架，无需坐标变换即可提升压缩性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于LiDAR点云压缩的熵建模，属于传感器数据压缩范畴，与VLA或WAM无直接关系，但所提扫描先验建模思想可能对压缩机器人三维观测数据有参考价值。

Each token position is mapped from Cartesian space to spherical coordinates ( r , θ , ϕ ) (r,\theta,\phi) , where r r , θ \theta , and ϕ \phi denote range, azimuth, and elevation, respectively, providing a scan-aligned spatial description for positional encoding.

papers.abstract: Industrial manipulation requires precise alignment and controlled handling of rigid, deformable, and flexible components. Yet, the benefits of pretrained visuomotor policies remain underexplored in settings where limited access to specialized hardware, components, and fixtures constrains demonstration collection and evaluation. Understanding task-specific data requirements is important for assessing their scalability across diverse processes on the factory floor. We investigate whether video pretraining can support reliable industrial manipulation with limited action data. We propose FLUX-mimic, a video-action model, motivated by the potential of video pretraining to capture motion and interaction patterns that enable sample-efficient training. FLUX-mimic is built on a backbone pretrained on large-scale web and industrial task data, and an action expert to generate robot trajectories. We train our policy by joint video-action training. Across four automotive manufacturing benchmark tasks and two bimanual robot platforms, FLUX-mimic outperforms all considered baselines on the dexterous robot platform and matches pi_{0.5}'s average success rate on the gripper-based robot platform. On a deformable part kitting task, FLUX-mimic reaches 77.5% success with as little as two hours of task-specific action-labeled demonstrations.

analysis.key_results: 在四个汽车制造基准任务和两个双臂机器人平台上，FLUX-mimic在灵巧机器人平台上优于所有基线，在夹爪机器人平台上与pi_{0.5}的平均成功率相当；在可变形零件配套任务中仅用两小时任务特定动作标注演示即可达到77.5%成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FLUX-mimic，一个结合大规模视频预训练与动作专家、通过联合视频-动作训练来实现样本高效的工业操作策略。
analysis.method: 基于在大规模网络和工业任务数据上预训练的骨干网络，结合动作专家生成机器人轨迹，并通过联合视频-动作训练来训练策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出FLUX-mimic视频-动作模型，通过视频预训练实现数据高效的工业操作，并在汽车制造基准上验证其性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接属于VLA范畴，提出视频-动作模型用于机器人操作，以视频预训练增强动作策略的样本效率，对VLA主题具有高度相关性。

The benchmark evaluation covers two robot platforms. Bars are stacked by collection source: wearable collection, Franka with dexterous hands teleoperation, and Trossen teleoperation. Both the benchmark and the additional pretraining tasks are used for video-only backbone pretraining; benchmark- task recordings are additionally used for policy training and evaluation.

papers.abstract: This work addresses the problem of finding a concealed object in an environment by unifying formalisms for partially observable environments with multi-modal priors drawn from a mix of ontologies, semantic networks, LLMs, and VLMs. We propose a concealment-adaptive mixed-observability MDP (CA-MOMDP), a Bayes-adaptive setting where uncertainty is over both object locations and which nodes can conceal them, held as a hypothesis with a bounded ontology prior and resolved only by interaction. We define a hierarchical transition system (HTS) to abstract the environment into room and object nodes that can be planned over via our CA-MOMDP. We further propose a COMBS-score: a multi-modal fusion of a human informed semantic network, LLM, and VLM, to initialize the belief over object locations, which grounds our abstractions and reduces reliance on a single model. Belief is maintained via Bayes' rule, which never lets a look rule out a closed container. We prove a present target is found in a bounded number of searches under exact perception and that its location is never ruled out given missed detection under noisy perception. We ablate each component to demonstrate their significance. Across five simulator configurations, from a gridworld to Matterport3D with a real detector, COMBS finds 92-100% of in-distribution and 92-100% of out-of-distribution targets, matches or beats the baselines in processing speed, significantly outperforms a per-step LLM policy at lower cost on the larger scenes, recovers more out-of-distribution placements than a TidyBot ranking, and matches an LLM-only prior at a fraction of its per-decision latency. COMBS is the only standalone method that can declare a target absent at a stated error level, and the per-step LLM policy offered a termination action abandons 12-22% of targets that were present, against 1.6-3.2% for COMBS on the same episodes.

analysis.key_results: 在五个仿真配置中，COMBS发现92-100%的分布内目标和92-100%的分布外目标，速度与基线相当或更快，且能声明目标不存在。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CA-MOMDP模型和COMBS评分函数，结合本体的贝叶斯自适应规划，实现隐蔽物体的高效多模态搜索，并在仿真中验证其有效性。
analysis.method: CA-MOMDP（隐蔽自适应混合可观测MDP）与分层转移系统抽象，结合COMBS多模态先验初始化和贝叶斯信念更新。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出隐蔽自适应混合可观测MDP框架，融合本体、语义网络、LLM和VLM先验，通过主动搜索高效定位被隐藏的物体。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该方法涉及视觉语言模型和本体语义先验，用于机器人主动搜索任务，与VLA中的感知、规划和决策相关，但未直接涉及世界模型或动作预测。

The policy selects the search with the highest expected detection per unit cost, and each observation that does not reveal the target updates the belief until the target is found or the absence test fires.

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong performance in robotic manipulation, yet most rely primarily on 2D visual observations and language instructions, leaving scene geometry and obstacle relationships to be inferred implicitly. This limitation is particularly problematic in cluttered environments, where small spatial errors can lead to unintended contacts or collisions. We propose MOSAIC, a modular spatial- and obstacle-aware framework that can be integrated with pretrained VLA policies to improve object-level scene understanding and action generation. Our method augments the VLA backbone with an auxiliary semantic grounding task that predicts role-specific masks for the target object, destination region, and surrounding obstacles. We further combine the target and destination masks with depth estimated from 3D scene reconstruction to construct role-specific geometric tokens that are injected directly into the action expert. In addition, we propose obstacle-aware attention supervision that emphasizes obstacles near the robot body during task execution. The resulting attention features are subsequently injected into later action-expert layers to further guide action generation. Together, these components provide explicit semantic, geometric, and obstacle-aware cues while preserving the underlying pretrained VLA architecture. We evaluate our framework on pretrained VLA model using the RoboPRO benchmark, including visual perturbation tests, and further validate it on real-world manipulation tasks. MOSAIC improves the success rate by 5.1% in cluttered scenes, and by 9.7% under visual perturbations, with gains of up to 25.0% in the most challenging environment. We will release our code and dataset upon acceptance at the following Github page: https://mmahdavian.github.io/MOSAIC/

analysis.key_results: 在RoboPRO基准上，杂乱场景成功率提升5.1%，视觉扰动下提升9.7%，最具挑战性环境提升高达25.0%。
analysis.main_contribution: MOSAIC框架，可与预训练VLA策略集成，通过辅助语义定位、角色特定掩码、深度几何标记和障碍物感知注意力注入，提升目标级场景理解和动作生成。
analysis.method: 在VLA骨干上增加辅助语义定位任务，预测目标物体、目的地区域和周围障碍物的角色特定掩码；结合深度估计构建角色特定几何标记注入动作专家；提出障碍物感知注意力监督，强调机器人附近障碍物，并将注意力特征注入后期动作专家层。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出模块化框架MOSAIC，通过语义定位、几何标记和障碍物感知注意力增强预训练VLA模型在杂乱场景中的操纵性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，通过显式空间、几何和障碍物感知增强，改进杂乱场景中的机器人操纵能力，属于VLA方法改进。

figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: MOSAIC Model Structure. (a) A vision–language backbone encodes observations, instructions, and robot state, with role tokens supporting semantic mask prediction. (b) The action expert attends to the shared prefix and produces learned attention maps. (c) Object-level depth is extracted using the VGGT- Ω \Omega combined with the predicted masks. The depth tokens are generated and injected into the action expert final layers. (d) Contact-relevant expert targets supervise attention through forward KL divergence during training. (e) Predicted attention maps are averaged, detached, and injected through residual cross-attention into late action layers. (f) Flow matching generates actions for robot execution.

papers.abstract: Self-evolving visual agents keep what they learn as skills: key frames with step notes on a task's steps and their order. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is now a popular way to train such skills into a vision-language model that matches, on its own answers, a teacher that also reads the written order. At deployment, frames often go missing or show an unusual order, as when a person or a website reorders the steps. Existing internalization methods keep any order they store in the frame-reading weights: trained on full frames, the model guesses when they are missing, and trained with frames withheld, it stores the order, so memory can override what it sees. We propose PriorSplit, which fills in missing frames from an order kept outside the model, with no training beyond OPSD. It counts which of two neighboring steps comes first in training episodes, and the model checks if both asked steps are in view: if so, it answers from the frames, and otherwise the counts answer. Extensive experiments on synthetic skills with five models and on step-tagged order questions in new episodes of seen web, cooking and egocentric tasks demonstrate that, with frames missing, PriorSplit outperforms every compared method at OPSD's training cost. With Qwen3-VL-4B on synthetic skills, it also stays close to OPSD on unusual orders, where methods that gain most by storing the order fall behind.

analysis.key_results: 在合成技能和多类别顺序问题上，PriorSplit在帧缺失的情况下优于所有比较方法，且训练成本与OPSD相同；在Qwen3-VL-4B上面对异常顺序时仍接近OPSD。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PriorSplit方法，利用训练任务中相邻步骤的出现顺序统计作为外部先验，在缺失帧时由先验回答，从而在不增加训练成本的情况下提高视觉-语言模型对缺失帧和异常顺序的鲁棒性。
analysis.method: PriorSplit：仅在OPSD训练之后，统计训练片段中相邻步骤的先后顺序计数；推理时模型检查两个步骤是否都在视野内，若是则从帧中回答，否则由先验计数回答。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出PriorSplit方法，在不额外训练的情况下通过外部存储的顺序先验填补缺失帧，提升视觉-语言模型在步骤顺序推理上的鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文方法针对视觉-语言模型智能体的步骤顺序推理，与机器人操作和视觉-语言-动作模型相关，但不涉及特定的VLA或世界模型架构，属于通用的视觉-语言推理方法。

papers.abstract: We present a training-free system for the EBMV @ ECCV 2026 challenge "Event Stream Understanding with EventBench" (General Understanding track), which evaluates vision-language models on five event-camera understanding tasks. We use none of the challenge's training data: our goal is to measure how far off-the-shelf, RGB-pretrained models can go on event data through representation and prompting alone. For four of the five categories (gesture recognition, detailed understanding, causal reasoning, and event OCR) we render event bins as red/ON, blue/OFF frames, select a category-specific subset of bins, stitch them into a single grid image, and query the same frozen Qwen3.5 9B vision-language model with a category-specific prompt for all four tasks. The fifth category, action recognition, feeds every bin directly into the organizers' EventGPT-Plus-2B. The system reaches 62.28% overall accuracy across 2,084 test questions (rank 9/27), led by action recognition and causal reasoning (80.27%, 77.22%) and limited most by gesture recognition and event OCR (54.70%, 34.57%). We visualize test samples from every category together with the exact images the model receives, score six alternative representations against the evaluation server, and analyze the full test set post hoc. That analysis shows that our bounding-box crop almost never tightened around content, so event OCR text reached the model at roughly one fifth of its horizontal resolution, and that detailed-understanding predictions are skewed toward the first two answer options.

analysis.key_results: 在2,084个测试问题上整体准确率为62.28%，排名9/27；动作识别80.27%，因果推理77.22%，手势识别54.70%，事件OCR 34.57%。
analysis.limitations: 事件OCR文本水平分辨率约为原始的五分之一，边界框裁剪几乎未收紧；详细理解预测偏向前两个答案选项。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种无训练的系统，将事件数据渲染为红/蓝帧并拼接网格图像，用冻结的Qwen3.5视觉语言模型处理EventBench的五个任务，在测试集上达到62.28%的整体准确率。
analysis.method: 将事件流渲染为红/蓝帧，选择类别特定子集拼接成网格图像，结合类别特定提示查询冻结的Qwen3.5 9B视觉语言模型；动作识别任务使用EventGPT-Plus-2B逐bin处理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文在EventBench基准上评估冻结RGB预训练视觉语言模型的事件相机理解能力，提出无训练表示和提示方法并报告性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文聚焦事件相机数据的视觉语言理解评估，不涉及VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或世界模型，与本站主题无直接关系，但其视觉-语言评估和表示方法对多模态模型在机器人数据上的应用可能具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Parameterized-action MDPs (PAMDPs) ask an agent to choose a discrete action together with continuous parameters whose meaning depends on that choice. Model-free PAMDP methods act fast but need many interactions; model-based methods are sample-efficient but plan at every decision, which makes them slow to act. We introduce HyLI (Hybrid Latent Imagination), a model-based agent that learns a hybrid policy entirely in the latent imagination of a world model and acts with a single forward pass. To address learning problems that the PAMDP structure creates, HyLI adds counterfactual mode evaluation, which gives every discrete action a learning signal at every imagined state, and success-window replay, which keeps rare successes in training. On seven standard PAMDP benchmarks, HyLI is within one published standard deviation of, or above, the published score of the strongest model-free baseline in our comparison on all 7 tasks, reaches 90% of that score with 2.4x fewer environment steps than that baseline (5.0x when its reward-free pre-training is counted), and decides 67x faster than the model-based planner DLPA at its published planner settings. It is the only method in our comparison that is both more sample-efficient than that baseline and fast enough for real-time control.

analysis.key_results: 在七个标准 PAMDP 基准上，HyLI 与最强无模型基线相当或更优，达到其90%分数时所需环境步数减少2.4倍（计入无奖励预训练时为5.0倍），决策速度比基于模型的规划器 DLPA 快67倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 HyLI，一个基于模型的智能体，在潜在想象中学习混合策略，仅需一次前向传播即可行动，并引入反事实模式评估和成功窗口回放来解决 PAMDP 结构带来的学习问题。
analysis.method: HyLI 利用世界模型的潜在想象来训练混合策略，并加入反事实模式评估为每个离散动作提供学习信号，以及成功窗口回放保留稀有成功经验。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: HyLI 是一种基于世界模型的智能体，在潜在想象中学习混合策略，用于参数化动作马尔可夫决策过程，实现快速决策和样本高效学习。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文研究参数化动作空间的基于模型的强化学习，其世界模型方法对机器人策略学习具有潜在参考价值，但不直接涉及 VLA 或机器人世界模型。

(b) Both kinds of agent roll out a learned model. A planner uses the rollouts to search for an action at every decision, during training and when acting. HyLI uses them only during training, to train a policy π \pi , and acts with one forward pass of π \pi . Times: median per decision on one CPU thread, Goal benchmark (all tasks in Table 2 ).

papers.abstract: In active object search, a robot must decide where to look and when to stop. Imperfect detection complicates both decisions: a non-detection may indicate occlusion, an out-of-view target, or a false negative, while a detection may be a false positive. This raises the question of which representations a world model needs to support reliable search under imperfect detection. We introduce Bayesian Active Miss-aware Object Search (BAMOS) to investigate how target belief, occupancy belief, and detector errors affect search decisions. Through comprehensive ablations in Isaac Sim and HSSD houses, we examine the roles of these representations and their update mechanisms across different detector configurations. Notably, target belief and its update mechanisms are critical to search performance, with their contribution generally increasing as detection errors become more prevalent. These findings highlight the importance of maintaining and updating target beliefs to support reliable active search under uncertain detector observations, providing insights into the design of world models for embodied agents. Code is available in https://github.com/gokyeongryeol/BAMOS.

analysis.key_results: 目标信念及其更新机制对搜索性能至关重要，且其贡献随着检测误差的增加而增大；占据信念的作用相对次要。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了贝叶斯主动漏检物体搜索（BAMOS）框架，并通过消融实验系统地研究了目标信念、占据信念及检测误差表示对主动物体搜索性能的影响。
analysis.method: 在 Isaac Sim 和 HSSD 场景中进行综合消融实验，比较不同检测器配置下目标信念、占据信念及其更新机制的作用。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究在检测不完美的情况下，主动物体搜索所需的世界模型表示（目标信念、占据信念和检测误差），并通过仿真实验分析其作用。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接研究世界模型中用于主动物体搜索的关键表示，为构建面向机器人操作的世界模型提供了设计指导，与本站的 WAM 和机器人学习主题高度相关。

papers.title: What World Model Does Active Object Search Need? A Study under Imperfect Detection
papers.title_zh: 主动物体搜索需要什么样的世界模型？不完美检测下的研究

papers.abstract: A quantized model is usually judged by comparing it with its BF16 original, but that comparison changes more than the weights. It often changes the serving engine, it always runs on a different server instance, it may change how requests are batched, and on some stacks the library selects a different kernel depending only on which packages import. We measure each of these sources on the same 2,400 public decisions for two of Cloudflare's decision models, Clef-flash (9B) and Clef (27B), on an NVIDIA GB10, and state every quantization effect as the excess over them. Sources that are not quantization move between 0 and 0.92% of decisions. llama.cpp restarts are bit-identical on every record for both models. vLLM restarts flip 0, 5 and 20 decisions at BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 on Clef-flash and 4, 0 and 22 on Clef; a third instance of Clef's quantized builds (exploratory) leaves FP8 at 0 and puts NVFP4 at 4 to 22, depending on which two instances are compared. An engine change at BF16 flips 6 to 16, a batch-size change 8 to 15, and the Gated DeltaNet kernel transformers selects unasked 10 to 14. Quantization inside one engine moves more: for Clef-flash and Clef, 0.88% and 1.04% at Q8_0, 2.12% and 1.62% at FP8, 5.79% and 3.50% at Q4_K_M, and 5.79% and 5.67% at NVFP4. On both models, every 4-bit interval excludes every non-quantization source. Two of our five pre-registered predictions failed, and the same two fail when the tests are rerun on the 27B: FP8 is not inside restart noise, and changing engine moves fewer decisions than 8-bit quantization does. Accuracy hides most of this. Over the full 31,275 public questions, Clef's Q4_K_M build moves accuracy by a net six questions (-0.02 points [-0.20, +0.16]) while 436 of its decisions get worse (exploratory), and NVFP4 costs Clef-flash 0.95 points and Clef 0.65. We release the code, quantization recipes, per-record outputs and the pre-registration.

analysis.key_results: 非量化来源移动 0 到 0.92% 的决策；引擎变更翻转 6 到 16 个决策，批处理大小变更翻转 8 到 15 个；量化在引擎内移动更多，Q8_0 为 0.88% 和 1.04%，FP8 为 2.12% 和 1.62%，Q4_K_M 为 5.79% 和 3.50%，NVFP4 为 5.79% 和 5.67%；在 31,275 个公共问题上，Q4_K_M 净准确率变化为 -0.02 分，但同时有 436 个决策变差，NVFP4 使准确率下降 0.95 和 0.65 分。
analysis.main_contribution: 系统测量了量化比较中非量化来源（服务引擎、重启、批处理大小、内核选择）对两个决策模型（Clef-flash 9B 和 Clef 27B）在 2400 个公共决策上的影响，并将每个量化效应报告为超出这些噪声底限的增量。
analysis.method: 在 NVIDIA GB10 上，对两个 Cloudflare 决策模型 Clef-flash 和 Clef 进行受控实验，分别改变服务引擎（llama.cpp 与 vLLM）、重启实例、批处理大小和内核选择，测量决策翻转数量，并与不同量化格式（Q8_0, FP8, Q4_K_M, NVFP4）下的变化对比。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文量化了模型量化对比中非量化因素（引擎、重启、批处理、内核选择）造成的决策变化，并将它们与8位和4位量化效果进行比较。

papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models are regarded as the cognitive foundation of embodied intelligence, but planning from instructions alone cannot make them reliable. During execution, actions deviate from intended effects, constrained by the embodiment and environment. An embodied brain must understand why execution deviates, identify what can be reliably realized, and revise decisions using interaction experience. These correspond to causal failure localization, capability-constrained adaptation, and experience-driven revision. Current embodied foundation models largely lack these capabilities. To address this, we introduce Embodied-Corrector. We construct failure-recovery data by injecting perturbations at subtask boundaries of successful trajectories, replaying affected subtasks, and keeping failures that are observable from public evidence and recoverable from the current state. We align actions, consequences, failure causes, and recoveries into Judge-Cause-Sub-Fine supervision. Training uses evaluation-first SFT: the model learns Judge and Cause first, then Sub and Fine conditioned on accurate prefixes. Since deployment uses self-generated prefixes, evaluation errors propagate into recovery planning, and response-level rewards are too coarse to locate affected planning tokens. We therefore use OPD to internalize the planning distribution under accurate prefixes into that under self-generated ones: the model generates plans from self-generated prefixes, while a contrastive forward pass with accurate prefixes compares token probabilities to reinforce or suppress planning tokens. At deployment, this branch is removed. Experiments show stronger failure analysis and corrective planning: with a frozen VLA, composite task success improves by 6.1 percentage points; with fixed GPT-5.5 execution, manipulation and navigation tasks improve by 13.9 percentage points.

analysis.key_results: 在冻结VLA条件下，复合任务成功率提升6.1个百分点；在固定GPT-5.5执行条件下，操作与导航任务提升13.9个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Embodied-Corrector框架，将动作、后果、失败原因和恢复策略对齐为Judge-Cause-Sub-Fine监督，并利用评估优先的SFT和OPD方法训练模型，使其具备因果失败定位、能力约束适应和经验驱动修正的能力。
analysis.method: 构建失败恢复数据（在成功轨迹的子任务边界注入扰动并重放），采用评估优先的监督微调（先学Judge和Cause，再学Sub和Fine），并引入离线策略蒸馏（OPD）将准确前缀下的规划分布内化到自生成前缀下的规划中。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出Embodied-Corrector框架，通过注入扰动和交互反馈训练多模态大语言模型，使其能够定位执行失败原因、适应能力约束并进行经验驱动的决策修正，从而提升具身智能体的任务成功率。

papers.abstract: Multiplayer generative world models must produce observations that agree on shared entities despite different camera motions and occlusions. Explicit world representations provide spatial control, but precise modeling of individual game maps limits scene diversity, while shared geometry alone cannot ensure consistent appearance across views. We present CoCode-World, a shared 3D proxy framework that separates structural control from visual synthesis for two-player video generation. Programmable proxies specify scene layout, motion, and occlusion, while RGB references guide character and scene appearance. To coordinate visual details across players, we concatenate paired proxy videos, appearance references, and target views in a consistent spatial layout and generate both views jointly with a pretrained video model. This formulation uses the model's native attention for cross-view communication within a single generation branch, with LoRA adaptation learning proxy adherence and appearance correspondence from paired observations. We construct a two-player GTA~V dataset that pairs synchronized RGB observations with proxy videos derived from shared map geometry and game-engine state. Experiments demonstrate appearance transfer to characters and scene styles unseen during training, with improvements in video quality and cross-view player identity over the evaluated baseline. Ablations further examine how proxy construction and cross-view communication affect generation. Project page: https://iapple233.github.io/CCW/.

analysis.key_results: 实验表明在训练期间未见的角色和场景风格上外观迁移有效，视频质量和跨视角玩家身份一致性优于基线，并通过消融研究探讨代理构建和跨视角通信的影响。
analysis.main_contribution: CoCode-World，一个共享3D代理框架，通过可编程代理指定场景布局、运动和遮挡，并使用RGB参考引导角色与场景外观，实现多玩家世界模型中的跨视角外观和身份一致性。
analysis.method: 使用共享3D代理表示，将配对代理视频、外观参考和目标视图拼接，利用预训练视频模型原生注意力进行跨视角通信，并用LoRA适配学习代理跟随和外观对应，在双人GTA V数据集上训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种共享3D代理框架，为双人视频生成分离结构控制与视觉合成，并通过联合生成实现跨视角一致性。

papers.abstract: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) impose substantial KV cache demands from both large multimodal contexts and growing reasoning traces. Low-rank KV compression has emerged as a promising paradigm that stores low-dimensional latents of KV states and can be combined with quantization. However, existing low-rank methods often induce growing predictive policy drift from the dense model when compressing reasoning KV states, resulting in reasoning failures. We identify two key causes of this degradation: calibration-state mismatch between static contexts and on-policy reasoning states, and unequal error sensitivity across KV states. To address these challenges, we propose TraceKV, a training-free low-rank KV compression framework that unifies on-policy calibration, sensitivity-aware SVD, and global rank allocation under a single policy-preserving principle, substantially reducing policy-KL divergence during reasoning. Experiments across multiple VLMs and visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate superior accuracy--memory trade-offs, achieving near-lossless reasoning accuracy with 5.64$\times$ KV cache compression when combined with quantization. Optimized low-rank attention kernels further deliver up to 1.83$\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup. Code will be available at https://github.com/AK-DREAM/TraceKV.

analysis.key_results: 在多个视觉语言模型和视觉推理基准上实现了接近无损的推理精度，结合量化时KV缓存压缩达5.64倍，优化低秩注意力内核端到端解码加速最高1.83倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TraceKV，一种无需训练的低秩KV缓存压缩框架，通过策略保持原则解决现有低秩方法在压缩推理KV状态时导致的策略漂移问题。
analysis.method: 将在线校准、敏感性感知SVD和全局秩分配统一在策略保持原则下，减少推理过程中的策略KL散度。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: TraceKV是一个无需训练的低秩KV缓存压缩框架，通过策略保持原则统一在线校准、敏感性感知SVD和全局秩分配，减少推理视觉语言模型中的策略漂移。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict chunks of future actions, and when objects move, those chunks go stale before they are executed. We study what makes a pretrained VLA reactive, using \pihalf{} on two dynamic simulation benchmarks and three real-robot tasks. We vary the prediction and execution horizons, compare synchronous and asynchronous inference, test methods that deliver actions sooner or keep successive chunks continuous, and adapt the policy with motion cues and latent-space reinforcement learning. The best prediction horizon is about one second, and the best execution horizon depends on the checkpoint. Short horizons help more with asynchronous execution, and methods that keep the trajectory continuous outperform those that only reduce latency. Adapting the policy repairs targeted failures, but on the conveyor task changing the execution horizon gained as much. Reactivity depends on the execution pipeline as much as on the policy, so both should be evaluated together.

analysis.key_results: 最佳预测时域约为1秒；最佳执行时域取决于检查点；短时域在异步执行时帮助更大；保持轨迹连续性的方法优于仅降低延迟的方法；策略适配修复了特定失败，但在传送带任务中调整执行时域收益相当。
analysis.main_contribution: 系统研究了预训练VLA模型在动态环境中的反应性，揭示了预测时域、执行时域、同步/异步推理、动作连续性保持和自适应方法等因素对性能的影响。
analysis.method: 在动态仿真和真实机器人任务中，通过改变预测与执行时域、比较同步/异步推理、采用动作加速和连续性保持方法，以及基于运动线索和隐空间强化学习对策略进行适配。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究预训练VLA模型在动态操作中的反应性，分析预测与执行策略对动作时效性的影响。

papers.abstract: Most action tokenizers for autoregressive vision language action (VLA) models compress motion into chunks that must be decoded in full before their actions become executable. We introduce ActionCodec2, a non-neural streaming tokenizer that releases actions incrementally while keeping trajectory reconstruction error within a prescribed tolerance. Its encoder quantizes each step relative to the decoder's reconstructed state, so the selected motion primitive corrects residual error rather than allowing errors from independently quantized increments to accumulate. Finding the smallest such primitive set is a geometric covering problem; we derive the exact minimum for translation and constant-factor-tight bounds for rotation. Set-BPE then losslessly merges co-occurring primitive symbols across coordinates and neighboring steps, without a fixed coordinate ordering. A universal version fitted on 20k hours of data from 24 embodiments averages 8.8 tokens per second for 15 Hz end-effector motion on this corpus. With the same VLA backbone, ActionCodec2 outperforms the compared tokenizers on three simulation benchmarks and in zero-shot real-robot evaluation. Its streaming representation allows policies to incorporate state feedback within an action chunk, substantially improving performance over open-loop execution under randomized dynamics, external disturbances, and moving objects. The same tokens also can serve as a direct control interface for VLM agents, which compose successful action sequences into reusable macros. These agent-built macros reduce control decisions and thinking-token usage across attempts and transfer to a held-out task. More results are available at https://zibindong.github.io/actioncodec2-page/

analysis.key_results: 在 24 个实施例的 20k 小时数据上平均 8.8 tokens/s（15 Hz 末端执行器运动）；在三个仿真基准和零样本真机评估中优于对比分词器；流式表示支持动作块内状态反馈，在随机动力学、外部扰动和移动物体场景下显著优于开环执行；VLM 智能体可利用这些 tokens 构建可复用的宏，减少控制决策和思考 token 使用并迁移到新任务。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 ActionCodec2，一种非神经流式动作分词器，在保持重构误差容差的同时逐步释放动作，并可与 VLA 模型结合提升闭环控制表现。
analysis.method: 编码器根据解码器重构状态对每个时间步进行量化，以校正残差；通过几何覆盖问题求解最小基元集；Set-BPE 无损合并协同出现的基元符号；在 20k 小时多实施例数据上训练通用版本。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ActionCodec2 是一种非神经流式动作分词器，能够逐步释放动作，同时将轨迹重构误差控制在指定容差内。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的动作分词环节，提出的流式分词器可提升动作预测效率与闭环控制能力，对本站 VLA 与机器人学习主题具有高度相关性。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising capabilities for robot manipulation, but their performance on accessible mobile bimanual platforms remains underexplored. We present a low-cost and reproducible mobile bimanual platform integrating two LeRobot SO-101 manipulators with a TurtleBot 4 and a LeRobot-ROS 2 software stack. Using long-horizon toilet cleaning as a case study, we collect 250 real-world demonstrations and evaluate $\pi_0$, $\pi_{0.5}$, SmolVLA, and GR00T under the same embodiment and task conditions. We further evaluate variants using SARM-derived task-progress signals and short-term MEM observation history. Among the evaluated models, $\pi_0$ performs best, achieving 60% strict and 70% relaxed autonomous success, increasing to 90% with limited human intervention. In contrast, the evaluated progress- and memory-augmented variants do not improve their corresponding baselines. Our results demonstrate the feasibility of long-horizon mobile bimanual manipulation on accessible hardware while highlighting remaining challenges in reliable VLA deployment. Project website: https://so101-turtlebot4.github.io/mobile-bimanual-cleaning/

analysis.key_results: π0表现最佳，严格自主成功率为60%，宽松成功率为70%，在有限人工干预下可达90%；基于SARM任务进度和MEM观察历史的变体未提升性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个低成本的移动双臂平台，并在长时域厕所清洁任务上系统评估多个VLA模型。
analysis.method: 集成两个LeRobot SO-101机械臂与TurtleBot 4和LeRobot-ROS 2，收集250个真实世界演示，评估π0、π0.5、SmolVLA和GR00T。
