papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models bring multimodal understanding and world knowledge to end-to-end autonomous driving. To further improve the quality of predicted trajectories, existing studies introduce candidate refinement, residual denoising, and token correction. However, these methods typically focus on unified refinement of the entire trajectory, paying limited attention to the distinct physical quantities and their interactions. We further investigate physical specialization and coordination in trajectory refinement, centering on position and heading for simpler and more intuitive correction modeling. To this end, we propose CARE-Drive (Coupled Alternating Refinement for Ego-trajectories), which decomposes trajectory refinement into waypoint residual correction and position-conditioned heading generation. Through imitation learning and a future-token auxiliary task, the backbone provides predictive representations and a base trajectory. The position expert predicts bounded metric waypoint residuals, while the heading expert reconstructs vehicle orientation from adjacent angular increments conditioned on the corrected path. With the backbone frozen, the two experts are optimized alternately through supervised initialization and reinforcement fine-tuning. This design simplifies refinement through clear physical specialization while preserving conditional coupling during prediction and optimization. On NAVSIM v1, CARE-Drive achieves 88.8 PDMS, improving by 2.4 points over the unrefined base trajectories generated by the same backbone. Ablation studies further support the effectiveness of specialized experts and staged training.

analysis.key_results: 在 NAVSIM v1 上，CARE-Drive 达到 88.8 PDMS，相比同一主干生成的未细化基础轨迹提升 2.4 分。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 CARE-Drive，将轨迹细化物理专业化分解为航点残差校正和位置条件的朝向生成，并通过交替优化实现精细轨迹预测。
analysis.method: 通过模仿学习和未来 token 辅助任务提供预测表示与基础轨迹；位置专家预测有界度量航点残差，朝向专家根据校正路径重建车辆朝向；冻结主干，两个专家通过监督初始化和强化微调交替优化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CARE-Drive 将轨迹细化分解为航点残差校正和位置条件的朝向生成，通过位置专家和朝向专家交替优化，提升 VLA 模型预测轨迹质量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文以视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为核心，针对自动驾驶轨迹预测与细化，直接涉及 VLA 的动作预测能力提升，属于机器人学习与策略优化的核心主题。

papers.abstract: Discrete diffusion generation is emerging as a competitive alternative to autoregressive generation by denoising the entire token sequence through iterative refinement. Its global planning and progressive correction capabilities are particularly well suited to autonomous driving. However, transferring this generation paradigm from general-purpose settings to driving introduces substantial domain gaps in both training and inference. To unlock its potential, we propose a multi-stage optimization pipeline for standard vision-language model architectures, without auxiliary action experts or specialized mixture-of-experts Transformer, spanning post-training and inference. During supervised fine-tuning, we optimize the representation of planning inputs to suppress hallucinations in task responses. During reinforcement learning, we introduce metric-guided diversity filtering to identify stronger learning starting points and improve policy exploration. At inference time, we propose Dynamic Autonomous Driving Decoding (DAD), which adaptively adjusts decoding modes according to scene complexity. Based on this pipeline, we develop Masked Diffusion Drive (MD-Drive), improving its performance by 29.7\% over the unoptimized model. Experiments on the NAVSIM closed loop benchmark and the nuScenes and DriveCoT open loop datasets show that MD-Drive outperforms autoregressive VLM baselines with the same architecture, while achieving a more favorable balance between performance and computational cost than systems with different architectures through discrete diffusion training and inference.

analysis.key_results: MD-Drive性能较未优化模型提升29.7%，在NAVSIM闭环基准和nuScenes、DriveCoT开环数据集上优于同架构自回归VLM基线，并实现性能与计算成本的更优平衡。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出多阶段优化流程（监督微调、强化学习、动态解码）和Masked Diffusion Drive（MD-Drive）模型，在自动驾驶视觉-语言推理中提升性能并平衡计算成本。
analysis.method: 多阶段优化：监督微调优化规划输入表示，强化学习引入指标引导的多样性过滤，推理时采用动态自动驾驶解码（DAD）根据场景复杂度调整解码模式。

papers.abstract: In robotics and embodied AI, a core challenge for world models is adapting to sudden, persistent, yet initially unknown changes in robot dynamics during interaction. For instance, when a robotic arm grasps an object with an unknown payload, the robot dynamics change suddenly. If the world model fails to adapt, its prediction errors accumulate over the open-loop rollout and ultimately mislead the robot's actions. Existing world models, however, struggle to simultaneously satisfy three critical requirements for dynamics adaptation: responsiveness, reacting promptly to sudden changes to curb prediction error accumulation; stability, distinguishing persistent changes from transient disturbances to prevent incorrect updates; and persistence, retaining the adapted dynamics without new observations so that later predictions do not revert to the old dynamics. Inspired by predictive coding in the human brain with multi-timescale adaptation, we propose AFTER-WM, a world model with Adaptive Fast-slow Timescales for Error-driven Retention, whose prediction errors drive a fast correction that fades and a slow correction that persists, while dynamically adjusting the combination weights of pre-trained experts without altering them, to overcome the trade-offs among responsiveness, stability and persistence. On five simulated robot datasets and real UAV data, AFTER-WM has a lower multi-step mean error than all ten compared models and the highest mean return in a joint-failure control task. In simulation, its multistep mean error is 16%-34% below the strongest compared model's and is also the lowest 1-4 steps after a change and under transient disturbances alone, and its step-40 error is the lowest as well, reflecting responsiveness, stability and persistence. All code (method, baselines, experiments) and datasets will be released online.

analysis.key_results: 在五个模拟机器人数据集和真实无人机数据上，AFTER-WM 的多步平均误差低于全部十种对比模型；在关节故障控制任务中获得最高平均回报；模拟中多步平均误差比最强模型低 16%-34%，变化后 1-4 步和仅瞬态扰动下的误差最低，第 40 步误差也最低。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了 AFTER-WM，一个具备自适应快慢时间尺度误差驱动保留能力的世界模型，能同时满足动力学适应所需的响应性、稳定性和持久性。
analysis.method: 预测误差驱动快速校正逐渐衰减、慢速校正持续保留，并动态调整预训练专家组合权重而不改变专家本身。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: AFTER-WM 是一种机器人世界模型，通过快慢双时间尺度的误差驱动适应机制，解决机器人动力学突变后世界模型难以兼具响应性、稳定性和持久性的问题。

papers.abstract: Quadrupedal mobile manipulators can extend their manipulation workspace by coordinating the mounted arm with the mobile base. At the task level, short-horizon end-effector (EE) trajectories provide an interface for specifying the desired manipulation motion without prescribing how it should be realized by the arm and base. However, executing such trajectories remains challenging because the controller must determine when and how the base should move, and this decision depends on the mounted-arm morphology. We therefore present PolyMorphWBC, a hierarchical controller that takes an EE trajectory as the sole task-level motion command and generates coordinated arm--base motions across four families of 6-DoF mounted arms, with extended-reach trajectories beyond the initial fixed-base reach. Within PolyMorphWBC, a trajectory-conditioned coordinator determines the base motion from previewed EE targets, while arm-specific Inverse Kinematics (IK) tracks the current target, and a frozen locomotion backend executes the resulting motion. Cross-arm reuse is enabled by a Unified Robot Description Format (URDF)-derived morphology conditioning, together with online residual-wrench feedback. We train PolyMorphWBC on procedurally generated arms and structured trajectories within and beyond fixed-base reach. In IsaacLab, it achieves 93.95% completion with 2.30cm position error and 4.81{\deg} orientation error on held-out trajectories and arm morphologies. In MuJoCo evaluation against UMI-on-Legs, PolyMorphWBC reduces EE position error by 69--72% and orientation error by 91--97% across four within- and extended-reach trajectories. On a physical Go2--ARX5 system, we demonstrate language-conditioned extended-reach pick-and-place using EE trajectories from pi_0 without vision-language-action (VLA)-generated base commands.

analysis.key_results: 在IsaacLab中，对留出轨迹和机械臂形态达到93.95%完成率，位置误差2.30cm，姿态误差4.81°；在MuJoCo中与UMI-on-Legs相比，位置误差降低69–72%，姿态误差降低91–97%；在实体Go2–ARX5上展示了语言条件扩展可达抓取。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PolyMorphWBC，一个以末端执行器轨迹为唯一任务级指令、通过轨迹条件协调器决定基座运动、并利用URDF形态条件与残余力反馈实现跨机械臂形态泛化的四足移动机械臂全身控制器。
analysis.method: 分层控制框架：轨迹条件协调器根据预瞄末端目标生成基座运动，机械臂特定逆运动学跟踪当前目标，冻结的运动后端执行运动；通过URDF派生形态条件与在线残余力反馈实现跨臂复用。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种分层全身控制器，仅以末端执行器轨迹为任务输入，即可在多种机械臂形态下实现四足移动机械臂的协调运动与扩展可达操作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作与VLA/WAM直接相关：其末端执行器轨迹可作为VLA模型输出的接口，无需VLA生成基座命令即可实现全身控制，突出表明该控制器是连接VLA高层规划与低层全身执行的桥梁。

papers.abstract: Embodied world models (WMs) are implicit learning systems that predict the next future latent state directly from observations and actions. Unique from other end-to-end learning systems, the dynamics predictor of WMs can simulate the environment's response to alternative actions without physical deployment nor pre-specifying states of the dynamical system. Current metrics focus on the quality of model outputs, e.g., clarity of reconstructions or task success, but fail to assess the fidelity of modeling consequences of counterfactual actions. Inspecting the forced response to action perturbations through sensitivity analysis is one way to audit how well WMs can predict the consequences of counterfactual actions. Deploying WMs on hardware will require new evaluation frameworks to analyze the tradeoffs between state error and accurate sensitivity prediction.

papers.abstract: Mechanistic localization does not by itself yield usable control: causal sensitivity may occupy little activation energy, an accurate local direction may fail at finite scale, and a reachable numeral target may be wrong. We introduce AROMA (Adaptive Representation-Oriented Multimodal Actuation), a frozen-VLM control framework separating where to intervene, which geometry and gain to use, how to reach a target, which target to pursue, and when to act. In Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct, four dimensions of a causally validated cross-attention head explain 89.82% of cardinality sensitivity but only 9.52% of median activation energy; magnitude-normalized causal subspace actuation converts this mismatch into finite control, improving exact-count accuracy on untouched procedural data by +8.00 pp. Iterative Minimal-Effort Actuation (MEA) reaches 81.25% of oracle targets versus 15.18% for a frozen direction under matched step budgets. With target and gate frozen before evaluation, targeted MEA improves the previous frozen policy from 34.444% to 38.730% on a new natural Stage-2 cohort (N=630; paired p=4.63e-7) and yields 65.741% versus 65.153% over all 7,992 examples while editing only 63 inputs. Prospective routing, replication across heads and models, and comparisons with attribution-steering baselines further characterize each stage, separating localization, actuation, reachability, target quality, and selective deployment as distinct control problems.

analysis.key_results: 在Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct上，大小归一化因果子空间驱动使原始程序数据上的精确计数准确率提高+8.00个百分点；MEA达到81.25%的oracle目标命中率，而冻结方向为15.18%；目标MEA在新自然Stage-2队列（N=630；配对p=4.63e-7）上从34.444%提升至38.730%，在所有7,992个示例上从65.153%提升至65.741%，仅编辑63个输入。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出AROMA框架，通过分离控制步骤（定位、几何与增益、目标达成、目标选择、何时行动）并利用因果子空间驱动，提高视觉语言模型的计数准确性。
analysis.method: 分离控制组件，使用大小归一化因果子空间驱动、迭代最小努力驱动（MEA）以及目标与门控冻结的策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出AROMA框架，在冻结的视觉语言模型中将局部化、驱动、目标达成、目标选择和选择性部署分离，以实现对模型行为的有限尺度控制。

papers.abstract: Imitation policies can perform complex manipulation, yet small execution errors can accumulate and cause failure. Refinement can correct these errors, but existing approaches often require additional on-policy learning or costly online planning. Our key insight is that a pretrained policy already supplies a useful nominal behavior: refinement can focus on predicting how small action corrections change its outcome. We therefore learn this local response in a form that is cheap to optimize. Our \textit{action-affine world model} (A\textsuperscript{2}WM) learns local action sensitivities offline from action-perturbed policy rollouts. Given interaction history and a policy proposal, it predicts task-relevant geometry as a nominal trajectory plus a linear response to corrections. It predicts the full planning horizon directly, avoiding the propagation of intermediate errors through recursive model evaluations. Quadratic penalties on predicted task errors and linear correction constraints then yield a cheap convex quadratic program (QP). Online refinement requires one model evaluation and one QP solve, while both policy and model weights remain frozen. Across four simulated manipulation tasks, our framework achieves the highest success rate among evaluated baselines, adding only 3.8 ms of mean refinement overhead per control step, excluding base-policy sampling.

analysis.key_results: 在四个模拟操作任务中达到最高成功率，每个控制步平均仅增加3.8ms修正开销（不含基础策略采样）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出动作仿射世界模型（A²WM），从动作扰动策略rollout离线学习局部动作敏感性，将任务相关几何预测为标称轨迹加线性响应，并以QP实现快速推理时修正。
analysis.method: 离线学习动作仿射世界模型，预测整个规划时域的任务相关几何，用二次罚项和线性修正约束构成凸QP，在线修正只需一次模型评估和一次QP求解。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出动作仿射世界模型（A²WM），利用预训练策略的行为敏感性在推理时通过凸QP低成本修正动作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文聚焦于机器人操纵策略的推理时修正，核心是学习可快速优化的动作-世界模型（A²WM），属于世界模型（WAM）在操纵任务中的高效推理应用，对VLA/WAM主题具有直接相关性。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose robotic manipulation. In our production setting, hundreds of VLA-powered robots are already operating in real-world environments, creating an immediate need for efficient fleet serving. We present XInfer, a production-deployed VLA serving system designed to reduce the inference infrastructure cost of large-scale robotic deployments. XInfer jointly coordinates heterogeneous VLA computation with the evolving response requirements of robotic execution. By exploiting computational parallelism while managing interference, XInfer improves GPU efficiency while protecting time-critical robotic feedback. We evaluate XInfer across three VLA models using production-derived workloads, achieving 1.26-3.75 times the effective robot capacity (ERC) of state-of-the-art systems under physical-execution constraints. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/X-Square-Robot/xinfer.

analysis.key_results: 在使用生产衍生工作负载的三个VLA模型上评估，XInfer在物理执行约束下实现了1.26-3.75倍于现有系统的有效机器人容量（ERC）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并部署XInfer，一个生产级VLA服务系统，通过联合协调异构VLA计算与机器人执行的动态响应需求，提高GPU效率并保护时间关键的机器人反馈。
analysis.method: XInfer利用计算并行性并管理干扰，在保护时间关键的机器人反馈的同时提高GPU效率。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出XInfer，一个生产部署的VLA服务系统，旨在通过协调异构VLA计算与机器人执行响应需求来降低大规模机器人部署的推理基础设施成本。

papers.abstract: Does multimodal training shape how a language model thinks, even when the input is text only? We test this with targeted causal ablations across 10 multimodal configurations from 6 model families, with matched text-only backbones and cross-family transfer controls. We contrast spatial-imagery tasks that invite mental scene construction with symbol-manipulation tasks solvable by symbolic rules alone. We identify a vision-language axis in hidden-state space and ablate its projection at inference. In Chameleon-7B, this ablation drops accuracy on BIG-Bench Hard (BBH) navigate by 27.6 pp while leaving boolean expressions intact (+5.6 pp), a 33.2 pp double dissociation. The effect is direction-specific and layer-localized, extends to mental-simulation tasks such as mental rotation, paper folding, and perspective taking, and is not explained by task difficulty, reasoning depth, or sequential update load. Together, these results reveal emergent vision-shaped thinking (EVT): text-only reasoning that causally recruits representations introduced or strengthened by vision-language training, without assuming an image-like internal format. The measured effect is spatially concentrated at 7-8B and broadens to non-spatial visual attribute binding in the tested 32B configuration. In dual-path unified models (BAGEL, Janus-Pro), the causal handle localizes to the generation pathway as a compact one-dimensional carrier. The understanding pathway also encodes spatial information in a higher-rank, probe-decodable form, but is not the causal handle. To separate decodability from causal use, we analyze concentration, alignment, and semantic location. These diagnostics explain why behavior, probing, and intervention can diverge. Multimodal training thus reshapes the geometry of text-only reasoning, not just how visual input is processed.

analysis.key_results: 在Chameleon-7B上，消融使BBH navigate准确率下降27.6个百分点，而布尔表达式性能提升5.6个百分点，产生33.2个百分点的双重分离效应；效应为方向特定、层局部化，且扩展至心理旋转、折纸、视角采择等任务。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并证实了涌现视觉化思维（EVT）现象：纯文本推理会因果地调用视觉-语言训练引入或强化的表示，并提供了行为、探针和干预差异化的几何诊断方法。
analysis.method: 在10种多模态配置（6个模型家族）中进行目标因果消融，消融视觉-语言轴的投影，并对比空间意象任务与符号规则任务。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文通过因果消融研究多模态训练对纯文本推理的影响，发现视觉-语言训练引入的表示被因果地用于空间意象任务。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文研究的视觉-语言表征对内部推理的影响与机器人领域中的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）可能相关，但摘要未涉及机器人、动作预测或世界模型等本站核心主题，因此无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Deployment of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for Edge-AI is constrained by memory and bandwidth limitations. A standard 7B parameter model consumes 14 GB Video Random Access Memory (VRAM) in half-precision (FP16), precluding co-location of vector indices and Key-Value (KV) caches. This paper presents an engineering integration and empirical evaluation of a multimodal RAG framework optimized for consumer-grade Turing hardware (e.g., NVIDIA Tesla T4). Our system-level analysis identifies a critical trade-off: while generative pre-trained transformer quantization (GPTQ) offers superior throughput (51.6 tok/s), it exhibits significant context instability at 2048+ tokens on Turing architectures. Conversely, NormalFloat 4-bit (NF4) maintains robust long-context performance with viable latency (81 ms/tok). By coupling NF4 with a decoupled Florence-2 vision integration, we achieve visual reasoning with only 430 MB VRAM overhead. Furthermore, empirical observations of prompt-induced search space pruning show that structured prompting reduces latency by 47% without altering computational intensity (1.88 GFLOPs/token). The integrated architecture maintains an 8.37 GB footprint, establishing a viable RAG pipeline for 12-16 GB GPUs. Finally, structured few-shot prompting effectively compensates for quantization-induced reasoning loss, restoring mathematical accuracy from 35.0% to 92.0% across 200 trials.

analysis.key_results: GPTQ吞吐51.6 tok/s但2048+ token上下文不稳定；NF4延迟81 ms/tok且长上下文稳健；视觉推理额外占用430 MB VRAM；结构化提示减少47%延迟且保持1.88 GFLOPs/token计算强度；总体内存8.37 GB；结构化少样本提示将数学准确率从35.0%恢复到92.0%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并评估了一个面向消费级GPU的边缘多模态RAG框架，结合NF4量化与解耦视觉集成，以8.37GB内存占用实现稳定长上下文性能，并通过结构化提示将数学准确率从35.0%恢复到92.0%。
analysis.method: 硬件感知量化（GPTQ与NF4对比）、解耦Florence-2视觉集成、结构化少样本提示。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 面向消费级GPU的边缘多模态RAG框架，通过硬件感知量化与结构化提示优化，在12–16GB显存上实现稳定推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于通用边缘多模态RAG的模型量化与高效推理，不涉及机器人VLA或世界动作模型，但对VLA/WAM在资源受限边缘设备上的量化推理与内存优化具有方法论参考价值。

papers.abstract: Many advances in ML systems came from breaking an assumption that earlier methods took for granted: speculative decoding dropped the assumption that a model needs one forward pass per token. Yet algorithms rarely state their assumptions, so experts and discovery harnesses search over programs, where one edit changes several design choices and gains are difficult to attribute. Searching over the assumptions themselves remains largely unexplored. Writing algorithms as proofs makes their assumptions explicit and turns algorithm design into a search over a small, structured space that an LLM can explore and a proof checker can audit. We formalize 89 algorithms from KV-cache eviction, weight pruning and speculative decoding as proof graphs with explicit assumptions, checked in Lean. Our harness, AutoAssumption, relaxes one assumption of a published method, re-derives and re-proves it, and generates its code. In KV-cache eviction and weight pruning, this search improved on every published algorithm we ran and produced state-of-the-art algorithms. The eviction algorithm has the highest RULER-4K score of the published methods we ran, and the pruning algorithm the lowest perplexity of thirteen on four LLaMA models. At equal budget, the harness scores within a point of OpenEvolve, an open-source implementation of AlphaEvolve, with a lower standard deviation across repeats. Future work will formalize more fields and combine them through the principal assumptions they share.

analysis.key_results: 在KV缓存淘汰和权重剪枝中，该方法改进了所有运行的已发表算法，产生了最先进的算法；淘汰算法在已运行的方法中具有最高的RULER-4K分数，剪枝算法在四个LLaMA模型上的困惑度在13个方法中最低；在同等预算下，该框架在重复实验中得分与OpenEvolve相差1分以内，且标准差更低。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种将算法形式化为带显式假设的证明图并在Lean中验证的自动化方法AutoAssumption；通过在假设空间中进行LLM驱动的搜索，发现了优于已发表算法的KV缓存淘汰和权重剪枝方法。
analysis.method: 将算法形式化为带显式假设的证明图，用Lean进行验证；AutoAssumption松弛一个已发表方法的假设，重新推导并证明它，生成代码。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出AutoAssumption方法，通过将算法形式化为带显式假设的证明图并在Lean中验证，自动松弛假设、重新推导和证明，从而在KV缓存淘汰和权重剪枝任务上改进了现有算法。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于通过自动搜索算法假设来改进KV缓存淘汰和权重剪枝，虽然提及推测解码作为形式化算法之一，但未涉及机器人视觉-语言-动作模型或世界模型，因此与VLA/WAM无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have made significant progress in general-purpose robotic manipulation. However, sampled action sequences can be ineffective, while evaluating alternatives with computationally expensive verifiers adds latency at each policy query. In this work, we propose HDH, a lightweight framework that uses hindsight from a frozen VLA's own deployments to improve action verification. The framework has three stages. First, we deploy the policy and collect its autonomous rollouts. We then train a compact action verifier to assign each action chunk a predicted task-success score. Finally, the frozen VLA generates action candidates, and the verifier selects the candidate with the highest score for execution. Across four LIBERO-10 tasks, HDH achieves an average success rate of 82.3\% and on three real-world manipulation tasks, HDH improves average success over the baseline policy by 22.6\%.

analysis.key_results: 在四个LIBERO-10任务上平均成功率为82.3%；在三个真实世界操作任务上HDH相比基线策略平均成功率提高22.6%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出HDH，一个轻量级框架，通过冻结VLA自身部署数据训练紧凑动作验证器，对生成的候选动作进行评分并选择最高分执行。
analysis.method: 三阶段方法：部署冻结VLA收集自主rollouts；训练紧凑动作验证器预测动作块的任务成功分数；冻结VLA生成动作候选，由验证器选择得分最高的候选执行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出HDH框架，利用冻结VLA自身部署经验训练轻量动作验证器，在不更新策略的情况下提升动作选择质量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文以VLA模型为核心，直接针对VLA策略的动作验证环节，通过轻量级验证器降低推理延迟并提升动作质量，对VLA在机器人操作中的高效部署和策略改进具有直接价值。

We first collect autonomous policy rollouts and use their terminal success and failure outcomes to train a compact verifier (left). At each policy query, the verifier uses the current observation and execution history to score sampled action chunks (center), and the robot executes the action of the highest-scoring candidate (right).

papers.abstract: Driving world models aim to simulate how a scene unfolds under different ego actions. This requires plausible motion of surrounding vehicles as well as precise ego-trajectory control. Learning vehicle motion from perspective video alone is challenging because motion is entangled with appearance and vehicles can be occluded. Prior work therefore conditions video generation on layouts that specify vehicle motion, providing control over surrounding vehicles but requiring their future trajectories as inputs. We introduce BirdDreams, an autoregressive driving world model that jointly generates perspective video and a schematic bird's-eye-view (BEV) video, making scene layout part of the predicted future. The BEV, rendered from scene annotations for training, depicts roads and vehicles as simple shapes at a fixed metric scale, providing a top-down view of their positions and motion with reduced occlusion between vehicles. Perspective video, by contrast, retains scene details that the BEV omits, such as traffic signals and object appearance. Joint attention between two video diffusion transformers, one per stream, lets each stream inform the other during generation. The predicted BEV also provides a geometric interface for ego control: we translate and rotate its latest frame along an input ego trajectory and use the resulting frames as a soft condition that shows how the scene would appear to move if only the ego vehicle moved. At inference, BirdDreams generates both videos from a single camera image without requiring an HD map or vehicle-state inputs. On PhysicalAI-AV and nuScenes, BirdDreams follows input ego trajectories more faithfully than prior driving world models and generates more plausible ego motion without ego-action conditioning. Human evaluation shows that BirdDreams outperforms a perspective-only baseline in generating realistic surrounding-vehicle behavior.

analysis.key_results: 在PhysicalAI-AV和nuScenes上，BirdDreams比先前驾驶世界模型更忠实地跟随输入自我轨迹，并在无自我动作条件时生成更合理的自我运动；人类评估显示它比纯透视基线在生成真实周围车辆行为方面更优。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出BirdDreams，一个自回归驾驶世界模型，联合生成透视视频和鸟瞰视频，使场景布局成为预测未来的一部分，从而无需高清地图或车辆状态输入即可实现精确的自我轨迹控制和更真实的周围车辆运动。
analysis.method: 联合训练两个视频扩散Transformer（分别对应透视和鸟瞰视角），通过相互注意力融合双流信息；鸟瞰视图作为几何接口，通过将最近帧沿输入自我轨迹平移旋转作为软条件，指导生成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出BirdDreams，一个联合生成透视视频和鸟瞰视频的自回归驾驶世界模型，通过双流扩散Transformer相互注意力实现更合理的车辆运动和精确的自我轨迹控制。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于世界模型（World Model）的核心范畴，专注于驾驶场景的未来视频预测和自我动作控制。虽然不直接涉及机器人操作（VLA/WAM），但其联合透视-鸟瞰生成、几何条件控制和自我轨迹跟随能力为机器人世界建模和基于模型的规划提供了直接的方法论启示。

papers.abstract: Memory-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) policies are meant to remember what happened. Many of them, however, fill memory by time: they sample frames uniformly across the episode and stamp each frame with its time step. Because time passes even when nothing happens, such a memory may not tell waiting from working. We show that it does not. On the counting tasks of RoboMME, we make the robot briefly pause or fidget its wrist. Such a null event changes nothing the task depends on, yet a released memory VLA counts the interval as work done and stops early. We call this failure phantom progress. It cuts success from 47 to 16 of 50 on one task and from 44 to 10 on the other. When the same frames are withheld from memory, success returns, so the cause lies in memory rather than in the interruption itself. We trace the failure to a temporal shortcut: because demonstrations proceed at a steady pace, elapsed time predicts progress. Indeed, rescaling the time stamps alone makes the policy stop early when the clock runs fast and repeat when it runs slow. Surprisingly, removing the time encoding does not cure the failure, because the frames of a null event still occupy slots of the time-sampled memory. Across RoboMME's released designs, vulnerability follows how memory is indexed. Of the fixes the diagnosis suggests, training with injected pauses does not remove the failure and impairs counting, whereas indexing memory by events recovers half or more of the loss without retraining. A memory meant to remember what happened should count events rather than clock ticks.

analysis.key_results: 注入无意义事件使成功率从 47/50 降至 16/50 和 44/50 降至 10/50；移除时间编码仍失败；按事件索引记忆无需重训练即可恢复一半以上损失。
analysis.main_contribution: 发现记忆增强型 VLA 策略中的“幻影进展”缺陷：时间采样记忆让策略将停顿事件计为有效工作，导致任务失败；并通过因果分析证明问题源于记忆而非干扰本身。
analysis.method: 在 RoboMME 计数任务中注入无意义的停顿或手腕摆动，对比有/无记忆、改变时间戳缩放、移除时间编码、注入停顿训练及按事件索引记忆等条件。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文揭示记忆增强型 VLA 策略依赖时间而非事件记忆，导致被无意义的停顿/手腕摆动欺骗而提前停止，并提出按事件索引记忆的改进方法。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接研究记忆增强型 VLA 策略的时间捷径缺陷，对机器人世界模型中的事件记忆设计具有直接指导意义，属于 VLA 鲁棒性与记忆机制的核心问题。

One PickXtimes episode of a released memory VLA (“pick up the cube and place it on the target 3 times, then press the button”), run three times along a shared axis of environment steps. Two 5 s pauses leave the world unchanged (top middle: first and last frame of the first pause). Yet when the pause frames enter memory, the policy presses the button after only 2 of 3 repetitions, at almost the same step as without pauses (dotted line), as if it had counted elapsed time rather than repetitions. We call this failure phantom progress . When the same pauses are hidden from memory (outlined boxes), the policy completes all 3. Right: successes over 50 paired episodes. papers.abstract: We describe our solution for the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge: 100 long-horizon household tasks in the OmniGibson simulator. We placed 9th on the final leaderboard, the only independent team in the top 10. The core of the solution is a single vision-language-action (VLA) model, one checkpoint for all 100 tasks, built on our 1st-place 2025 solution, which is based on $\pi_{0.5}$. On the 50 tasks shared with 2025, its Q rises from 0.260 to 0.371; across all 100 tasks it scores 0.392. Our main conclusion from 2025 was that the model was undertrained, so most of the 2026 work went into training the model for longer, optimizing some training parameters, making each training step slightly faster and reducing the gradient noise: a migration from 50 to 100 tasks (semantic stages built from the demonstrations' skill annotations, task and stage embeddings of new tasks warm-started from similar old ones, and a 21-dimensional action space matching the teleoperation controls); variance-reduced multi-sample flow matching with a simple noise-vs-compute model that picks the number of action-expert samples per observation without ablations; and a 200k-step training run, about one pass over the 211M frames of the demonstrations. A cloud evaluation infrastructure keeps a shared record with provenance, episode diagnostics and restorable simulator states, and runs six simulators on one GPU together faster than real time. On top of the learned policy, 14 tasks are routed to a GPT-6 Astra coding agent that controls the robot through observation and motion tools, starting every episode from a frozen copy of its own practice session on training instances. Across these 14 tasks, Astra's mean Q is 0.639, against 0.108 for the learned policy. The public submission included only part of the Astra results and scored 0.446 Q with 27.3% full-task success.

analysis.key_results: 在50个共享任务上Q值从0.260提升至0.371；在全部100个任务上Q值为0.392；Astra代理在14个任务上平均Q值0.639，而学习策略为0.108；公开提交得分0.446 Q，27.3%全任务成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 将单一VLA模型扩展到100个长时程家庭任务，通过延长训练、优化训练参数、减少梯度噪声、从50任务迁移到100任务以及使用GPT-6 Astra编码代理处理困难任务，在挑战赛中获得第9名。
analysis.method: 基于π0.5的视觉-语言-动作模型，采用多样本流匹配减方差、任务与阶段嵌入热启动、21维动作空间、200k步训练，以及GPT-6 Astra编码代理在14个任务上替代学习策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出了一个基于π0.5的单一体视觉-语言-动作模型，并在2026 BEHAVIOR挑战赛中在OmniGibson模拟器上完成了100项长时程家庭任务。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文核心是单一VLA模型在机器人操作任务上的扩展与训练，直接属于VLA主题，对机器人动作预测和通用机器人学习具有重要参考价值。

The task and stage embeddings also enter the expert directly through two conditioning tokens. Every attention layer of both transformers has a learnable sink. FAST tokens are used only in training.

papers.abstract: Local decoding usually fixes one weight precision for the whole generation. We study a different allocation: store 8-bit weights, decode with their top 4 bits, and redo a step at 8 bits only when the low-precision output distribution looks uncertain (entropy above a threshold or a small top-two margin). Quantization is simulated, the model is Qwen3-0.6B, and the benchmark is GSM8K. Cost is counted in weight bytes read per token. On 36724 replayed steps the entropy of the low pass ranks argmax flips with AUC 0.93. At a 15% escalation budget it catches 78% of flips and the margin gate 94%, against the 15% expected for a random gate of equal rate (a computed expectation, not a run). In 150 live problems all-high scores 64.0% and all-low 55.3% (McNemar p=0.053). An entropy gate with a 16% escalation rate scores 62.7% at 0.87 of the all-high weight bytes. Its paired difference is -1.3 (-8.0 to +5.3) points to all-high and +7.3 (+0.0 to +14.7) points to all-low (p=0.080), so the live data do not separate the gate from either end. Verified speculation reaches zero KL at similar bytes in the same cost model. A live random control, a thinking-mode phase rule, a second model and live KL were not run.

analysis.key_results: 低比特推理的熵对argmax翻转的AUC为0.93；在15%升级预算下，熵门控和边际门控分别捕获78%和94%的反转；150个实时问题中，全高精度准确率64.0%，全低精度55.3%；熵门控在16%升级率下准确率62.7%，权重字节数为全高精度的0.87倍。
analysis.limitations: 实时随机对照、思维模式阶段规则、第二个模型和实时KL散度评估未运行；实时数据未能将门控方法与全高精度或全低精度区分开。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种在不确定解码步骤上将低比特推理升级为高比特推理的按需精度策略，并通过仿真和GSM8K基准评估其效果。
analysis.method: 存储8位权重量化，解码时先使用其高4位，仅当输出分布熵高或top-two边际小时才以8位重新计算；通过记录权重字节数来衡量成本，并使用门控机制、置信度预测和与全高精度及全低精度的对比评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究在本地小模型推理中动态提升权重位宽的量化策略，以在保持生成质量的同时降低权重读取成本。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于独立于机器人任务的动态量化技术，与VLA/机器人世界模型无直接关联，但其按需精度思想可为机器人策略模型的高效推理提供参考。

papers.abstract: Local language models can save memory by storing weights in fewer bits, and they can reduce sensitivity to the order of answer options by averaging a few reorderings. We ask whether the first makes the second worse, and which is the cheaper way to spend a fixed budget. On Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B with simulated round-to-nearest weight quantization (8, 6, 4 and 3 bits, fp16 reference), read from the logits of the letters A to D on ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, MMLU and HellaSwag (300 items each), 6 bits lose no accuracy against fp16 (they score +1.8 (+1.0 to +2.5) and +0.9 (+0.3 to +1.5) points higher, which we do not explain), and 8 bits change it by -0.7 (-1.1 to -0.3) and -0.4 (-0.7 to -0.2) points. At 4 bits the answer-slot skew rises from 0.15 to 0.53 (0.6B) and from 0.07 to 0.12 (1.7B); Gaussian noise at the same weight SNR gives 0.15 and 0.37 (two draws) and 0.19 (one draw), so the control is inconclusive on whether rounding adds slot skew beyond equal-power noise. Flip rates rise but stay below an accuracy-matched baseline of independent uniform errors. Averaging four cyclic orders recovers +12.6 points at 4 bits for 0.6B (+5.3 at fp16). We price bits and passes in one machine-independent unit, weight bytes read times passes. In cost-matched pairs, extra orders beat extra bits only when the weights have 6 or more bits, and the decision table reduces to: use 6-bit weights and spend the rest of the budget on up to four orders, one pass each. Everything is simulated on two small models with the simplest quantizer; a title-level search found no earlier study of quantization together with option order.

analysis.key_results: 6比特量化比fp16准确率更高（+1.8和+0.9个百分点）；4比特时答案槽偏斜从0.15增至0.53（0.6B）和从0.07增至0.12（1.7B）；平均四个循环顺序在4比特下为0.6B恢复+12.6个百分点（fp16下+5.3）；在成本匹配对中，仅当权重大于等于6比特时，增加顺序数优于增加比特数。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by having a draft model propose multiple tokens for the target model to verify in one pass. The speedup is governed by the expected acceptance length (EAL), yet standard training objectives such as cross-entropy, KL divergence, and total variation focus only on distribution matching or single-step overlap. Recent studies instead propose block-level training objectives, aiming to optimize EAL directly. However, these objectives remain surrogates rather than exact formulations of EAL. For example, some average later acceptance over target-distributed continuations rather than the verification branches selected by accepted tokens, introducing a covariance gap that can reverse the gradient direction. We analyze this gap and derive REAL, a real EAL training loss that uses path weights for unbiased estimation and Rao-Blackwellization for variance reduction. In a controlled loss-level comparison with a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B target and a Domino drafter, REAL outperforms WTV, VSD, DBLast, and the static LK baseline on probabilistic serving acceptance length across 9 task subsets and 5 evaluation seeds. These gains require only a change to the training loss, with no modification to the drafter architecture or inference procedure, demonstrating the practicality of real EAL training. A reference implementation of the REAL loss is available at https://github.com/King-ty/speculators/tree/real-loss.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B目标模型和Domino drafter上，REAL在9个任务子集和5个评估种子上，在概率服务接受长度方面优于WTV、VSD、DBLast和静态LK基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 推导出真实EAL训练损失REAL，使用路径权重进行无偏估计并使用Rao-Blackwell化进行方差缩减，在损失级别比较中优于现有代理目标。
analysis.method: REAL损失：路径权重无偏估计 + Rao-Blackwell化方差缩减；不改变drafter架构或推理过程，仅替换训练损失。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出了REAL损失，直接优化投机解码中的真实期望接受长度（EAL），以提升推理加速效果。

papers.abstract: Many scientific and policy decisions require estimating the total number of target objects across a large image collection. Exhaustive human labeling is often infeasible, while raw model predictions can be biased, especially under domain shift. Recent human-AI estimation methods combine imperfect model predictions with limited human verification to obtain reliable collection-level estimates. However, existing work provides little guidance on how practitioners should choose among models, estimators, and adaptation strategies for a new deployment. We study these choices within a common human-in-the-loop counting framework across 12 tasks spanning biomedical microscopy, ground-level and aerial wildlife surveys, and overhead imagery of urban structures. Our results show that modern multimodal models provide a strong, training-free starting point for many tasks, while fine-tuned detectors become more advantageous at larger labeling budgets and across repeated deployments. Estimation efficiency improves further when model predictions are used to prioritize which units humans label, rather than sampling uniformly. We also find that each model's ranking quality can be estimated with a small pilot set, yielding practical guidance for selecting strategies on new counting tasks. In a field deployment on aerial pronghorn surveys, a task-specific adaptation of these methods meets the survey's $\pm 5\%$ tolerance after reviewing a median of only $3.2\%$ of collected images.

analysis.key_results: 现代多模态模型在许多任务中提供了强大的免训练起点；微调检测器在更大标注预算和重复部署中更有优势；基于模型预测的优先级采样优于均匀采样；在航拍叉角羚调查中，仅审查3.2%的图像即可满足±5%的误差容忍度。

analysis.method: 在12个任务上比较了现代多模态模型、微调检测器以及基于模型预测排序的主动采样策略，利用小规模试点集估计模型排序质量以指导策略选择。

papers.abstract: Pretrained video diffusion models (VDMs) offer a powerful foundation for World Action Models (WAMs), which jointly predict robot actions and future observations. Building such models requires injecting low-dimensional robot signals (e.g. proprioception, actions, and values) into a latent space shaped by natural videos, and a key design choice is the interface through which these signals enter: existing schemes treat it as a formatting detail, spending a separate latent frame on each signal or bolting on dedicated encoders and decoders. We argue that signal injection is instead a distribution-alignment problem: how well a representation matches the prior of the pretrained VDMs during denoising. Using the relative reconstruction error of a frozen VDM denoiser as a probe, we find that conventional spatial encodings sit far off this prior, whereas frequency-domain packing yields latents that the denoiser corrects far less. Motivated by this diagnostic result, we propose MetaWAM, which folds all robot signals into a single unified meta-frame: each signal is assigned to a disjoint frequency-domain channel band and lifted to the spatial latent by an inverse DCT, yielding a decodable interface aligned with the pretrained VDM prior without any added module or architectural change. A fixed band layout together with slot-aware routing lets the same meta-frame support policy, world-model, and value prediction over a shared set of robot variables. On RoboCasa, MetaWAM reaches 68.9% success while collapsing the per-signal frames into one and cutting inference latency by 39%, and attains 85.0% success on three real-world Franka tasks. Code and models are available at https://github.com/showlab/MetaWAM

analysis.key_results: 在RoboCasa上达到68.9%成功率，将每信号帧合并为一个元帧，推理延迟降低39%；在三个真实Franka任务上成功率达到85.0%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出MetaWAM，将多个机器人信号折叠为统一的元帧，通过频域通道带分配和逆DCT实现与预训练视频扩散模型先验对齐的潜在接口，无需额外模块。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出MetaWAM，通过频域打包将机器人信号统一注入单一元帧，使潜在表示与预训练视频扩散模型先验对齐，提升世界动作模型的效率和成功率。

papers.abstract: Recent work shows that multimodal agents increasingly self-improve without recurring human annotation. However, each self-improvement mechanism is designed and evaluated within a single scenario, leaving its preconditions unverified under cross-scenario transfer. This survey investigates the structural source of asymmetric mechanism transfer across four scenarios: multimodal reasoning, multimodal generation, GUI and Web navigation, and embodied manipulation. We first formalize the self-evolving multimodal agent by four criteria and a differentia of self-reference, and adopt the three-stage self-evolving loop of experience generation, feedback acquisition, and update consolidation as our analytical framework to position the scenarios along ceilings on rollout count and feedback fidelity. Comparing self-evolving with fixed loops within each scenario separates the limitations that the scenario imposes from those inherent in the self-evolving design. We then recast each mechanism as a trade-off that raises a scarce factor by presupposing a task-structural resource, such as output equivalence or checkable outcomes, and judge it portable, conditional, blocked, or redundant across scenarios. We attribute the asymmetry to divergent combinations of scarce factors and resources across opposite transfer directions, and identify the matched-budget measurements that could overturn these still untested verdicts.

analysis.key_results: 将机制跨场景迁移判定为可移植、有条件、受阻或冗余；将不对称性归因于相反迁移方向上稀缺因素与资源的不同组合。

papers.abstract: Deploying vision transformer models across connected and automated vehicles (CAVs) requires joint management of computation and Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) communication. Static split-inference methods use fixed partition points and cannot adapt to time-varying link bandwidth, processing load, and concurrent multi-stream traffic. This paper proposes an edge orchestration framework that jointly selects model partition points, per-layer quantization bitwidths, and execution placement across heterogeneous vehicular compute nodes. The joint partitioning and mixed-precision allocation problem is formulated as a Mixed-Integer Linear Program (MILP) that minimizes compute and communication energy subject to end-to-end latency and task-quality constraints. The framework is evaluated on Jetson Orin Nano (8~GB), Jetson Orin NX (16~GB), and Jetson AGX Orin (32~GB) nodes using OPV2V-driven multi-stream workloads with $K \in \{2,4,6,8\}$. Across the evaluated configurations, the proposed formulation reduces V2V communication energy by $33.3$--$36.0\%$ relative to a Uniform INT8 split. At $K=8$, end-to-end task completion latency is reduced by $34.0\%$ on the Orin Nano and $33.1\%$ on the Orin NX relative to the same baseline, while limiting the reduction in 3D detection accuracy to $3.1$--$4.1$ percentage points in $\mathrm{mAP}_{50}$ relative to FP16 execution.

analysis.key_results: 在Jetson Orin Nano/NX/AGX Orin上，使用OPV2V驱动的多流工作负载，所提方法相比Uniform INT8划分减少33.3%-36.0%的V2V通信能耗；K=8时，端到端时延在Orin Nano和Orin NX上分别减少34.0%和33.1%，3D检测精度mAP50相对FP16降低3.1-4.1个百分点。

analysis.method: 将联合划分与混合精度分配问题建模为MILP，以最小化计算和通信能耗，同时满足端到端时延和任务质量约束。

papers.abstract: We study how to generate diverse, physically executable robot demonstrations for dexterous vision-language-action (VLA) learning. Existing demonstration-generation methods typically rely on costly teleoperated examples. Meanwhile, human hand--object datasets provide a reusable source, but existing transfer methods mainly reproduce given interactions. Turning these interactions into VLA training data further requires coverage of different objects and manipulation locations, together with executable arm and finger actions, and visual observations. To achieve this, we present DexSeed, a framework for low-cost generation of dexterous robot data from human hand--object interactions. Our key idea is to expand human sequences while preserving their grasps and realizing the resulting motions under arm-tracking dynamics in physics simulation. Specifically, we organize source sequences by grasp mode with shared language descriptions. InteractionMesh-based retargeting and arm trajectory augmentation adapt these sequences to the robot hand, different object geometries, and pick-and-place locations while preserving local hand--object relationships. An RL finger-control policy produces executable rollouts, while the arm tracks precomputed trajectories. Rendered observations and recorded actions from successful rollouts are paired with grasp descriptions to fine-tune a VLA. Experiments show improved contact fidelity in retargeting and more reliable whole-arm execution than the evaluated baselines. Simulation evaluation and real-world deployment further demonstrate that a VLA fine-tuned solely on the generated demonstrations can execute language-specified grasps. Project page: https://robbyant-research.github.io/DexSeed/.

analysis.key_results: 实验表明所提方法在重定向接触保真度和整臂执行可靠性上优于基线；仿真和真机部署验证仅用生成演示微调的 VLA 能执行语言指定抓取。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 DexSeed 框架，低成本地将人手-物交互转化为多样化、物理可执行的机器人演示，用于 VLA 灵巧策略学习。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: DexSeed 框架利用人手-物交互数据，通过物理仿真和强化学习指尖控制策略生成可执行的机器人演示，用于微调视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型以学习语言指定的灵巧抓取。

papers.abstract: We present Sable, an argument system and single-GPU prover for the statement that a committed, integer-quantized transformer produced a given token sequence from a given prompt, bit for bit. Sable fixes an integer function F_O with no floating-point step, in which every rounding, normalization, softmax and sampling decision is determined by its inputs, and proves it with a constraint system whose relations provably never wrap modulo the 31-bit KoalaBear prime. The proof batches zerochecks and LogUp-GKR lookups into one sumcheck per domain, and commits to every witness tensor and weight in one multilinear commitment built from Reed-Solomon codes, BLAKE3 Merkle trees and a mixed-length BaseFold opening. The prover streams the model layer by layer on one GPU. On one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU, Sable proves all 64 layers of Qwen2.5-32B in 92.5 s for 4,096 tokens and 398 s for 16,384 tokens, and covers Qwen3-32B and the mixture-of-experts Qwen3-30B-A3B (4,096 tokens in 121.8 and 84.7 s). A proof costs 41 to 50 times the serving time, or 6.4 cents per 4,096-token request at public GPU prices, and 40 to 64 times less time per parameter and token than zkLLM. On WikiText-2, F_O's greedy token matches the BF16 model's at 86.3% of positions; on Qwen3, F_O is within 1.6 points of BF16 on MMLU and 1.7 points on GSM8K. A verifier with a compiled core checks a proof on one CPU core in 19 to 56 s. In the random-oracle model, the interactive proof has round-by-round soundness error 2^-103. The proof is not zero-knowledge, so the system targets open-weight models. Code: https://github.com/moonmath-ai/Sable

analysis.key_results: 在NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU上，对Qwen2.5-32B的64层进行证明：4096个令牌耗时92.5秒，16384个令牌耗时398秒；Qwen3-32B和Qwen3-30B-A3B（4096个令牌）分别耗时121.8秒和84.7秒；证明成本是服务时间的41到50倍，每4096令牌请求成本6.4美分；在WikiText-2上，F_O的贪婪令牌与BF16模型在86.3%的位置上匹配；Qwen3上，F_O在MMLU上比BF16低1.6分，在GSM8K上低1.7分；验证器在单CPU核心上19到56秒内检查证明；交互式证明在随机预言机模型下的逐轮可靠性误差为2^-103。
analysis.limitations: 该证明不是零知识的，因此系统面向开放权重模型。

papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation, endowing policies with strong capabilities for modeling temporal and physical dynamics. Existing WAMs, encompassing both video-first action prediction and joint video-action modeling, directly transfer global physical representations from world models to action generation. However, global scene representations may underemphasize local robot-object interactions, creating a mismatch between representations optimized for world evolution and those required for manipulation. To bridge this gap, we propose LaST0.5, a novel WAM that introduces an interaction-centric physical representation between world modeling and action generation. Specifically, LaST0.5 learns a compact interaction-centric latent space under the supervision of visual interaction cues between the robot and the environment. This reasoning space is instantiated as a latent expert that bridges the world expert and the action expert within a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture. Furthermore, LaST0.5 performs adaptive world-to-action transfer by jointly predicting future representations and progress values, using progress consistency to adjust action execution and trigger future resampling. Finally, we pretrain LaST0.5 on a large-scale robotic data corpus comprising over 14k hours of data, establishing interaction-centric physical reasoning as a scalable and effective paradigm. LaST0.5 achieves 99.5% on LIBERO, surpasses the previous state of the art on ten evaluated RLBench tasks, and demonstrates robust long-horizon execution and precise dexterous manipulation in real-world experiments.

analysis.key_results: 在 LIBERO 上达到 99.5%，在十个评估的 RLBench 任务上超越先前最优，并在真实世界实验中展示稳健的长时程执行和精确的灵巧操作。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 LaST0.5，一种引入交互中心物理表示的世界动作模型，在 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构中以潜在专家桥接世界专家和动作专家，并采用自适应世界到动作转移机制，将交互中心物理推理确立为可扩展有效的范式。
analysis.method: 学习一个紧凑的交互中心潜在空间，由机器人与环境之间的视觉交互线索监督；在 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构中结合世界专家、动作专家和潜在专家；联合预测未来表示和进度值，通过进度一致性调整动作执行并触发未来重采样；在超过 14k 小时的大规模机器人数据语料上预训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: LaST0.5 提出一种交互中心潜在表示的世界动作模型，通过学习机器人-环境视觉交互线索来桥接世界建模与动作生成，并在大规模机器人数据上预训练，在 LIBERO、RLBench 及真实世界操作中取得领先性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接属于 World Action Model (WAM) 主题，核心贡献是改进 WAM 中世界建模与动作生成间的表示对齐，提出交互中心潜在推理方法，对机器人操作策略学习具有直接推动作用。

papers.abstract: We present GigaEdge Spench, an open-source SDK for streaming speech enhancement on CPU servers, mobile devices, and in browsers. Applications can build enhancement channels from neural denoising, normalization and dynamics blocks, sample-rate conversion, and acoustic echo cancellation where supported. These stages can be combined, while normalization can also run without a neural model. The release includes an 8 kHz INT8 denoiser and discriminative and hybrid 48 kHz FP32 models. A shared C++ core supports ONNX Runtime and TensorFlow Lite through native interfaces, Android and iOS SDKs, and WebAssembly integration. Independent stream contexts share model resources, and consecutive frames from one stream can be processed in a single inference call. We evaluate the released models on EARS-WHAM v2 and compare their quality and processing costs with RNNoise and DPDFNet2. All tested native and Web configurations process files faster than real time, although larger chunks require more time to collect input. We also measure how many streams a shared model can process on a CPU. Our contribution is a configurable deployment system and an experimental study of how model choice, chunk size, and execution environment affect its use. All reported SDK timing uses ONNX Runtime. Index Terms: speech enhancement, streaming inference, cross-platform deployment, temporal frame grouping, computational efficiency

analysis.key_results: 所有测试的原生和Web配置均快于实时处理；较大的块需要更多时间收集输入；测量了共享模型在CPU上可处理的并发流数量。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一个可配置的部署系统，并对模型选择、块大小和执行环境如何影响其使用进行了实验研究。
analysis.method: 设计了一个共享C++核心的流式语音增强SDK，支持ONNX Runtime和TensorFlow Lite，提供原生接口、Android/iOS SDK和WebAssembly集成，并实现了流上下文共享模型资源和单次推理多帧处理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文介绍了一个用于在CPU服务器、移动设备和浏览器上进行流式语音增强的开源SDK GigaEdge Spench。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究聚焦于语音增强SDK的跨平台部署和效率，属于模型量化与高效推理范畴；与VLA、世界模型或机器人动作预测无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Deploying large language models in regulated industries requires more than picking the fastest inference engine: it requires evidence that a configuration meets contractual and legal obligations before it serves a single customer request. We describe Runway, an internal validation harness built at MasterControl that builds a governed decision pipeline around NVIDIA AIPerf. The key insight is separating concerns: AIPerf provides the trusted measurement, while Runway provides the experiment design that comes before it and the compliance, cost, and audit decisions that come after. We describe the architecture and the storage model that makes caching and audit one mechanism. We report three findings from Runway sweeps: TensorRT-LLM and vLLM rankings invert with concurrency; a newer, pricier GPU instance can be the cheaper one per request; and speculative decoding behaves differently across engines under load, so engine configuration can outweigh engine choice.

analysis.key_results: 发现TensorRT-LLM和vLLM在并发下的排名反转；较新且更贵的GPU实例可能每次请求成本更低；推测解码在不同引擎和负载下表现不同，因此引擎配置比引擎选择更重要。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个构建在NVIDIA AIPerf之上的受治理决策流水线Runway，将实验设计、合规、成本和审计决策与性能测量分离，并使用缓存和审计统一的存储模型。
analysis.method: 使用内部验证框架Runway，通过实验设计和存储模型将AIPerf的测量与合规、成本和审计决策结合。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文介绍了一个在受监管行业中构建受治理决策流水线的内部验证框架Runway，用于在LLM服务部署前提供合规、成本和审计证据。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding speeds up language models by having a lightweight drafter propose future tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash predict an entire block in one forward pass, and DDTree builds draft trees directly from their per-position distributions. Each distribution implicitly assumes that the drafter's own greedy continuation is accepted, whereas a draft tree improves over a chain only on branches that leave this greedy path. Once a path forks, the drafter's top-1 accuracy drops from 89% to 18% and its top candidates often miss the true token. Re-running the drafter from the fork token largely restores its accuracy, showing that the errors stem from conditioning on an outdated prefix rather than from limited model capacity. In this paper, we introduce DForkTree, a training-free method that re-anchors each branch on its own tokens. It adjusts the drafter's scores with pointwise mutual information from target-generated n-grams, weighted more heavily after a fork, and a layer-wise GPU search recovers the exact optimal tree under these scores. On Qwen3.5-4B and 9B, DForkTree outperforms all baselines on every benchmark, by up to 41.5% over DFlash and 15.1% over DDTree, with average speedups of up to 4.75x over autoregressive decoding.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3.5-4B和9B上，DForkTree在所有基准上均优于所有基线，比DFlash最多提高41.5%，比DDTree最多提高15.1%，平均加速比最高达到4.75倍（相对自回归解码）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出DForkTree，一种免训练的方法，通过重新锚定每个分支的上下文、利用目标模型生成的n-gram点互信息调整草稿分数，并结合逐层GPU搜索恢复最优草稿树，从而解决现有块扩散草稿树在分叉后精度下降的问题。
analysis.method: DForkTree包括：1) 重新锚定每个分支的上下文；2) 使用目标模型生成的n-gram点互信息调整草稿模型分数，并在分叉后加大权重；3) 通过逐层GPU搜索在调整后的分数下恢复最优草稿树。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: DForkTree是一种免训练方法，通过重新锚定每个分支的上下文并使用目标模型生成的n-gram点互信息来调整草稿模型分数，从而构建更优的草稿树。

papers.abstract: Quantization reduces LLM deployment costs, but effective strategies must balance model quality and storage. LLM-driven search can automate strategy design through repeated proposal and evaluation. This process must identify useful strategies within a limited evaluation budget. The key challenge is that \textit{actual quantization is expensive, while inexpensive proxies may not reflect quantized-model performance.} To address this challenge, we present AutoQS, an \textbf{Auto}mated \textbf{Q}uantization \textbf{S}trategy Design with LLMs. AutoQS keeps weight precision fixed and searches group-size allocations across layers and operators under deployment constraints. Evaluation history guides coordinated LLM proposals, while deterministic validation ensures compatible allocations. An inexpensive quality proxy evaluates candidates, and an candidate repository retains alternative allocations to inform subsequent proposals. Periodic actual quantization complements these proxy evaluations with measured quality and checkpoint storage, providing feedback for further search within the evaluation budget. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct show that AutoQS improves seven-task average accuracy over uniform-group GPTQ and AWQ by 0.70 and 1.12 percentage points, respectively, at four-bit weight precision.

analysis.key_results: 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上，四比特权重精度下，AutoQS 相比均匀组 GPTQ 和 AWQ 分别将七任务平均准确率提高0.70和1.12个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 AutoQS，一个利用大型语言模型自动设计量化策略的框架，在权重精度固定的情况下搜索组大小分配，并利用代理评估和定期实际量化反馈来指导搜索。
analysis.method: LLM 驱动的搜索，结合评估历史协调提议、确定性验证保证分配兼容、廉价代理评估候选者、候选存储库保留替代分配，以及定期实际量化提供测量质量和存储反馈。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: AutoQS 利用大型语言模型在部署约束下自动搜索跨层和算子的组大小分配，以优化量化后模型的精度与存储平衡。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models pair a vision-language backbone with an action head, but in closed-loop control the backbone sits on the control-critical path: while it computes, the robot keeps moving, so each executed action is conditioned on an increasingly stale observation. A larger backbone therefore directly blocks reactivity, especially in humanoid dexterous manipulation. We present DASH, a Decoupled Asynchronous System for Humanoids that removes this coupling. DASH splits the policy into a slow vision-language model (System 2) and a fast flow-matching action head (System 1) that run as concurrent processes over the LCM communication protocol, so the control rate is set by the action head alone, independent of backbone size. The action head fuses stale semantics from a frozen backbone with fresh vision from its own ResNet encoder, desynchronized training exposes it to the staleness it meets at deployment, and an adaptive temporal aggregator aligns overlapping action chunks under variable inference latency. On an asynchronous RoboTwin benchmark that charges inference latency in simulated time, DASH holds 20 Hz control rate from 0.8B to 8B backbones while the synchronous rate falls from 9.7 to 4.1 Hz, with higher success at every size. On a real humanoid with dexterous hands, DASH achieves clearly higher pick-and-place success than the synchronous pipeline.

analysis.key_results: 在异步RoboTwin基准上，DASH在0.8B到8B骨干间维持20 Hz控制率，而同步方法从9.7 Hz降至4.1 Hz，且所有模型规模下成功率更高；在真实人形机器人上，DASH实现了明显高于同步管线的抓取-放置成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出DASH解耦异步系统，通过分离慢速VLM骨干与快速流匹配动作头，消除骨干推理延迟对闭环控制速率的制约，实现延迟无关的VLA扩展。
analysis.method: 将策略拆分为慢速VLM（系统2）和快速流匹配动作头（系统1），两者通过LCM通信协议并发运行；动作头融合冻结骨干的延迟语义与自身ResNet编码器的新鲜视觉；采用去同步训练使其适应部署时的信息延迟；自适应时间聚合器对齐可变推理延迟下的重叠动作块。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: DASH将VLA策略解耦为慢速系统2（VLM）与快速系统1（流匹配动作头）异步运行，使控制频率独立于骨干网络规模，从而提升人形灵巧操作的反应速度。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to understand and execute complex instructions, but their autoregressive (AR) action generation introduces significant latency on resource-constrained robotic platforms. Speculative decoding can accelerate AR-based inference by parallelizing action generation and verification; however, existing approaches rely on costly draft models, which are inefficient on edge platforms. In this paper, we propose Zora, a hardware-software co-design framework for accelerating AR-based VLA inference. Specifically, Zora introduces a lightweight retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-based draft model that exploits robotic dynamics without additional neural draft models. We further reduce batch verification overhead through a kinematics-guided action-acceptance strategy and a KV-cache-sharing attention mechanism. To address the retrieval overhead introduced by RAG-based drafting, we co-design dedicated hardware support, Zora core, to address the memory irregularity in RAG-based drafting. We evaluate Zora on four VLA models with the LIBERO benchmark. Zora retains comparable accuracy while achieving up to 3.4$\times$ speedup with software-only optimization and up to 7.6$\times$ speedup with hardware support over GPUs.

analysis.key_results: 在四种VLA模型和LIBERO基准上，软件优化实现最高3.4倍加速，硬件支持下实现最高7.6倍加速，同时保持可比精度。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Zora软硬件协同设计框架，利用轻量级检索增强生成草稿模型、运动学引导的动作接受策略和KV缓存共享注意力机制，并设计专用硬件Zora core以加速VLA推理。
analysis.method: 检索增强生成（RAG）替代神经草稿模型，结合运动学引导的动作接受策略、KV缓存共享注意力机制，以及专用硬件Zora core处理RAG内存不规则性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出Zora框架，通过检索增强的轻量级草稿模型和专用硬件加速，在保持精度的同时大幅提升VLA模型推理速度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接聚焦于视觉-语言-动作模型的高效推理加速，将推测解码与VLA的机器人动作生成结合，属于VLA推理效率提升的核心工作。

papers.abstract: Weight-activation quantization can reduce the memory and compute cost of neural-network inference, but recent methods often require expensive optimization and architecture-specific propagation of basis transforms across layers. We introduce MACaQ, an MXFP4 W4A4 post-training quantization method that treats every linear layer independently. MACaQ applies a per-channel scale and a block-Hadamard transform online to each layer's activations, while absorbing the corresponding inverse transforms into its weights. Retaining these transforms online avoids cross-layer dependencies and enables a simple streaming implementation of the quantization process, in which only one layer must reside in memory at a time. To improve over round-to-nearest quantization, we introduce Flip-Refinement, a Hessian-aware coordinate-descent procedure that greedily moves individual FP4 codes to adjacent representable values. Despite executing the activation transforms at inference time, MACaQ adds only 2.3% end-to-end overhead over pure MXFP4 on Qwen3-32B in vLLM. MACaQ reaches lower perplexity than DuQuant++ and MR-GPTQ, and already matches their best perplexity on Llama-3-8B in 11 times less quantization time. We further apply MACaQ without architecture-specific modifications to an image diffusion model, illustrating the generality of its layer-local design and show quantization of a 122B parameter model in 64 minutes, using only 32.5GB GPU RAM. Code is available at https://github.com/huawei-csl/MACaQ .

analysis.key_results: MACaQ 在 Qwen3-32B 上仅增加 2.3% 端到端开销；在 Llama-3-8B 上以 11 倍更少的量化时间达到与 DuQuant++ 和 MR-GPTQ 相当的最佳困惑度；可在 64 分钟内量化 122B 参数模型，仅需 32.5GB GPU 内存；且无需架构特定修改即可应用于图像扩散模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 MACaQ，一种无需跨层依赖或架构特定修改的 MXFP4 W4A4 后训练量化方法，将激活变换在线执行并吸收到权重中，并引入 Flip-Refinement 坐标下降优化提升量化质量。
analysis.method: 对每个线性层独立应用 per-channel 缩放和在线块 Hadamard 变换，将逆变换吸收进权重；使用 Hessian 感知的 Flip-Refinement 贪心坐标下降，将 FP4 编码调整到相邻表示值。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: MACaQ 提出一种独立的逐层 W4A4 后训练量化方法，结合在线块 Hadamard 变换和 Flip-Refinement 优化，实现快速、低内存、模型无关的低精度推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于独立的后训练量化方法，未直接涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人策略；但其高效量化技术对部署大规模视觉-语言-动作模型或世界模型具有潜在实用价值。

papers.title: MACaQ: Fast, Model Agnostic Calibrated Quantization for Low-Precision Weights and Activations
papers.title_zh: MACaQ：面向低精度权重与激活的快速、模型无关校准量化

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models typically generate actions in chunks, dividing continuous robot execution into separately predicted action chunks, which can introduce discontinuities at chunk boundaries. We propose ODEAction, a chunk-free action generation paradigm that replaces action chunk prediction with Continuous Action Evolution. We use an ordinary differential equation (ODE) to describe the continuous evolution of actions, and define the vector field of this ODE as the Action Transition Field to characterize how actions evolve with respect to evolution time. During inference, the model takes the current action as the initial condition and numerically solves the ODE defined by the learned Action Transition Field, thereby recursively generating subsequent actions with explicit dependencies. ODEAction is implemented as a modular action head that can be integrated with different vision-language backbones. Experiments on LIBERO, EBench, RoboTwin, and real-robot tasks show that, compared with action-chunk-based baselines, ODEAction improves both task performance and trajectory quality, with particularly pronounced gains on fine manipulation tasks.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO、EBench、RoboTwin和真实机器人任务上的实验结果表明，与基于动作块的基线方法相比，该方法在任务性能和轨迹质量上均有提升，在精细操作任务上提升尤为显著。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一种无动作块（chunk-free）的动作生成范式，用ODE描述动作的连续演化，以避免动作块边界处的不连续性。
analysis.method: 使用常微分方程描述动作的连续演化，将ODE的向量场定义为动作转移场，推理时以当前动作为初始条件数值求解ODE，递归生成后续动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出ODEAction，一种基于常微分方程的动作演化方法，取代传统VLA模型中的动作块预测，以生成连续且无块边界的动作序列。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接针对VLA模型的动作生成方式进行了改进，属于机器人动作预测与策略学习的核心研究，不涉及WAM。

figures.caption: From action-chunk prediction to continuous action evolution. (a) Base Policy uses action-chunk prediction and is prone to abrupt action changes at chunk transitions, whereas ODEAction’s continuous evolution ensures that action trajectories are generated continuously. Comparisons of real-robot task execution and the corresponding end-effector trajectories illustrate the differences in execution smoothness and trajectory continuity between the two methods. (b) Representative results on EBench simulation and real-robot tasks: compared with Base Policy, ODEAction increases the task success rate (SR) and reduces the end-effector mean absolute jerk (EE-MAJ).
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Learning the action transition field and recursively generating actions. (a) Discrete demonstrated actions are interpolated into a continuous trajectory. Target transition vectors are constructed by combining progression along the demonstration with deviation correction, inducing a target action transition field F ∗ F^{*} in the trajectory neighborhood. (b) During training, the action transition field ( F θ F_{\theta} ) is learned through direct supervision. (c) During inference, the current action serves as the initial condition, and subsequent actions are recursively generated by numerically solving the ODE defined by the learned Action Transition Field.

papers.title: ODEAction: From Predicting Chunks to Evolving Actions
papers.title_zh: ODEAction：从预测动作块到演化动作

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models perform versatile manipulation tasks from language instructions, but their inference cost limits how fast a robot can respond in closed-loop control. Visual token pruning reduces this cost; however, prior methods estimate token redundancy from encoded visual embeddings or attention, only after the visual encoder has processed the entire observation. We propose ActPrune, a training-free token pruning method that moves the pruning decision ahead of the vision encoder by grounding it in a geometric prior derived from the robot's own action. The action chunk predicted at the previous control step is already available before the current observation is encoded, and it specifies the end-effector and camera motion between consecutive observations. The same action affects the two standard camera views asymmetrically: in the fixed third-person view, ActPrune retains patches along the projected end-effector trajectory together with semantic anchors, while in the wrist view, it prunes patches that remain unchanged after compensating for the action-induced camera motion. Extensive experiments on two simulation environments (LIBERO and VLABench) and four real-robot tasks demonstrate that ActPrune achieves up to 1.61$\times$ speedup and 59.5% FLOPs reduction with negligible degradation in success rates. The project site is http://mmai.ewha.ac.kr/actprune/.

analysis.key_results: 在两个仿真环境（LIBERO和VLABench）和四个真实机器人任务上，实现最高1.61倍加速和59.5% FLOPs减少，成功率下降可忽略。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ActPrune，一种免训练的动作引导视觉令牌剪枝方法，将剪枝决策提前到视觉编码器之前，利用几何先验减少计算量。
analysis.method: 利用上一步动作块预测末端执行器和相机运动，在固定第三人称视图中保留投影轨迹和语义锚点，在手腕视图中剪除动作补偿后不变的补丁。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ActPrune是一种免训练的动作引导视觉令牌剪枝方法，通过利用上一步预测的动作块对当前观察在编码前进行剪枝，提高VLA模型的推理效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对VLA模型的推理效率问题，与本站主题高度相关，属于将高效推理技术应用于机器人操作策略的典型案例。

figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: The overall framework of ActPrune . The previous action chunk 𝐀 t − 1 \mathbf{A}_{t-1} derives view-specific pruning signals before visual encoding. Pruned patches are compressed into context tokens, and encoder attention applies the remaining budget.

papers.title: ActPrune: Action-Grounded Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.title_zh: ActPrune：面向高效视觉-语言-动作模型的动作引导视觉令牌剪枝

papers.abstract: Recent advances in robot foundation models have highlighted the potential of in-context learning (ICL) for adapting robot behavior from demonstrations without further fine-tuning. Previous work has used retrieval-based post-training to equip pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models with the capability for ICL by teaching them to condition action predictions on retrieved visually-relevant demonstration chunks. However, the effectiveness of retrieval hinges on selecting context relevant to the current execution stage, which visual similarity alone may not capture. We introduce VICTR, a framework enabling in-context learning in VLAs via progress-informed context retrieval built around an In-Context Value Function Estimator (IC-VFE). IC-VFE conditions on a reference demonstration video, a language instruction and the current observation to estimate task-relative progress. By conditioning progress estimation on a reference demonstration, IC-VFE can align the current state with a demonstrated execution even for tasks unseen during training. VICTR uses the estimated progress to select demonstration chunks at corresponding stages of execution and supplies them to a $\pi_{0.5}$ policy post-trained for in-context action generation. On unseen out-of-domain real-world manipulation tasks, VICTR raises the success rate from 6.2% for a fine-tuned $\pi_{0.5}$ baseline to 23.8% and more than doubles the task progress rate, from 28.9% to 55.5%. Project page with code, data and videos: https://ai4ce.github.io/VICTR/

analysis.key_results: 在未见过的域外真实世界操作任务上，VICTR将微调π0.5基线的成功率从6.2%提高到23.8%，任务进度率从28.9%提高到55.5%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出VICTR框架，通过进度知情检索实现在VLA中的上下文学习，核心是上下文价值函数估计器（IC-VFE），能够估计任务相对进度并检索相关演示片段。
analysis.method: 训练IC-VFE基于参考演示视频、语言指令和当前观测来估计任务相对进度；使用估计的进度选择相应执行阶段的演示片段，提供给一个针对上下文动作生成进行后训练的π0.5策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: VICTR通过引入一个上下文价值函数估计器（IC-VFE），利用任务进度信息来选择相关演示片段，从而实现了VLA模型在未见任务上的上下文学习，显著提升了真实机器人操作的成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接聚焦于VLA模型，通过改进上下文学习来增强策略的泛化能力，属于VLA策略学习范畴。

figures.caption: Value-informed context retrieval for in-context robot learning. Given a reference demonstration, IC-VFE estimates task-relative progress, which VICTR uses to retrieve progress-aligned context for action generation. On out-of-domain tasks, VICTR improves the task progress rate from 26.8% with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 43.0% with visual-similarity-based RICL to 58.2%, without task-specific fine-tuning at deployment.

The IC-VFE ( ϕ \phi ) conditions on the reference demonstration τ ctx \tau_{\text{ctx}} , the shortest in the pool 𝒟 ℓ \mathcal{D}_{\ell} , to produce a progress estimate v ^ t \hat{v}_{t} for the current observation o t o_{t} . This is then optionally fused with visual similarity, driving retrieval of a context chunk c t c_{t} from the demonstration pool. The IC-VLA ( θ \theta ) conditions on c t c_{t} to predict the next action chunk, closing the loop without any parameter updates.

papers.title: VICTR: Value-Informed In-Context Learning for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.title_zh: VICTR：用于视觉-语言-动作模型的基于价值的上下文学习

papers.abstract: We present Meituan-Robotics-0 (MR0), a vision-language-action foundation model and embodied-agent system for stationary-base desktop manipulation. MR0 combines 147 million vision-language samples with 15,060 hours of curated robot trajectories spanning 12 embodiments. A three-stage training recipe aligns multimodal representations with robot behavior through discrete action-token pre-training, transfers these priors to continuous cross-embodiment control through flow-matching mid-training, and adapts the policy through real-world post-training. We introduce Rollback, which pairs replaced policy segments with human corrections to provide positive and negative supervision for CFG-DAgger without value learning or advantage labeling. A unified end-effector interface supports heterogeneous embodiments, while asynchronous action-chunk merging maintains smooth execution under variable inference latency. An event-driven agent maintains persistent task events and reassesses plans when progress or feasibility changes, enabling cross-task retrieval and conditional task resumption. MR0 achieves 93.6% success on RoboTwin 2.0 and ranks fifth in the RoboDojo VLA track. Under matched HG-DAgger post-training, MR0 achieves higher average success rate and progress score than $\pi_{0.5}$ across three real-robot tasks. On Ethernet insertion, CFG-DAgger trained with Rollback data reaches 70% success and a progress score of 0.90. Qualitative agent deployments demonstrate cross-task event retrieval and recovery from temporarily unsatisfied task conditions.

analysis.key_results: RoboTwin 2.0成功率93.6%；RoboDojo VLA赛道第五；HG-DAgger后训练下三个真实机器人任务平均成功率和进度分数高于π0.5；以太网插入任务CFG-DAgger训练成功率70%、进度0.90。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出MR0模型及配套训练策略，包括离散动作token预训练、连续跨具身流匹配中训练和真实世界后训练；引入Rollback数据生成方法用于CFG-DAgger，以及统一末端执行器接口和异步动作块合并。
analysis.method: 147M视觉-语言样本与15,060小时机器人轨迹联合训练；三阶段训练：离散动作token预训练、流匹配中训练、真实世界后训练；Rollback利用替换策略片段与人类纠正生成正负监督；CFG-DAgger训练；事件驱动智能体进行跨任务检索和条件任务恢复。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: MR0是一个用于固定底座桌面操作的视觉-语言-动作基础模型，通过三阶段训练和Rollback数据增强，在仿真和真实机器人任务中取得高成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接贡献VLA基础模型及其在桌面操作中的应用，提供大规模多具身数据训练方案和真实世界适应方法，对VLA研究具有核心参考价值。

papers.abstract: Whether an action-conditioned world model responds to actions is usually checked by replacing or removing the actions and measuring the loss in accuracy. Taking biological experiments as the guiding case, we show that such diagnostics report action effects where there are none: under autocorrelated designs, future actions stand in for history the model does not see. When the design law is known, a conditional randomization test written as an e-value is valid in finite samples whatever the model. A second failure arises whenever many sites share one action sequence, as in world models: the pooled score turns small model errors along the action contrast into an e-value near zero, so a valid test loses its power although the effect is real. Tempering the score changes the bet, not the validity. The log e-value is concave in the tempering factor and zero at zero, so too small a factor costs little and too large a one can cost everything; every single factor we tried, estimated or tuned, failed in some setting, and mixtures over a fixed grid never did. Our own preregistered analysis of optogenetic ERK experiments failed by pooling; a tempered statistic, registered before the data were obtained, then rejected the null on a never-opened field (E = 1.1e10). In three registered tests on models trained by others, the pooled test rejected in 0 of 96 units of a diffusion model, and reached the power bar in 10 of 26 Atari games under IRIS's token likelihood and 1 of 6 control tasks under TD-MPC2; mixtures fixed in advance reached it in 96 units, 24 games and 6 tasks. On recorded robot video with iVideoGPT the mixture rejected in 155 of 159 trajectories; the pooled test did not collapse there (143). Under exact nulls the statistics made 14 rejections in 26,664 tests.

analysis.key_results: 在 optogenetic ERK 实验中 E = 1.1e10；在扩散模型、Atari (IRIS)、TD-MPC2 及 iVideoGPT 机器人视频上混合方法均达到预设功效，而池化方法多未达标；在精确零假设下统计量有 14 次拒绝（共 26,664 次测试）。
analysis.main_contribution: 指出动作条件世界模型常见动作效应检验方法存在替身效应和池化放大问题，并提出使用条件随机化检验的 e 值及混合固定网格的方法来保证有效性。
analysis.method: 条件随机化检验写成 e 值，并通过 tempering 分数及混合固定网格来修正池化问题。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文通过生物实验类比揭示现有动作条件世界模型的动作效应诊断方法存在替身效应与池化放大问题，并提出基于条件随机化检验的修正方案。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文属于世界模型动作效应检验方法，对 VLA/WAM 的评估诊断有间接参考价值，尤其在机器人视频世界模型（如 iVideoGPT）上进行了验证。

papers.title: Stand-In Effects and Pooling Amplification: Lessons from Biological World Models for Testing Action Effects
papers.title_zh: 替身效应与池化放大：从生物世界模型看动作效应检验的教训

papers.abstract: Robot agents built on vision-language models depend on both the planner and its harness: the tools, feedback, memory, and recovery logic around it. Can improvements to a large teacher's harness be carried into a compact agent with lower inference compute cost? We present TinyAstral, a two-stage approach. We first freeze an open-weight teacher and improve its harness through recursive self-improvement (RSI): frontier LLM agents read the teacher's trajectories and propose harness edits, and each edit is accepted only if it passes a paired statistical test. We then freeze the final harness, collect teacher trajectories with reasoning and failure recovery, and distill a small student that replaces the teacher in the same harness. On RoboTwin, harness evolution raises the teacher's success from 33.4% to 63.6%; the final 4B student reaches 62.8%. Across four harness versions, distilled 4B students score close to their corresponding teachers, and later versions yield stronger students, showing that harness evolution gains carry into compact models. The harness gains also transfer to other frozen planners without retraining. On identical episodes, the final 4B student outperforms open 4B agents, the open 27B harness-RSI model SenseNova-RoboRSI, and our own teacher model placed in three competitors' harnesses. It stays close to its teacher on all three training benchmarks, and on three benchmarks never used for RSI or training it scores close to a 552B planner running the same harness. On the measured deployment episodes, it uses about one fifth of its teacher's accelerator time. Project page: https://garfield-kh.github.io/TinyAstral/

analysis.key_results: 在RoboTwin上，框架进化将教师成功率从33.4%提升至63.6%，最终4B学生成功率为62.8%；蒸馏学生性能接近各自教师；框架增益可迁移到其他冻结规划器；最终4B学生在相同情节上超过4B开放智能体、SenseNova-RoboRSI和置于三个竞争对手框架中的教师模型；在三个训练基准上与教师接近，在三个未用于RSI或训练的基准上与552B规划器接近；部署时间约为教师的五分之一。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出两阶段方法：首先冻结大型教师模型，通过递归自改进（RSI）优化其外部执行框架；然后冻结改进后的框架，将教师轨迹蒸馏到一个小型学生模型，实现低推理成本的通用操作智能体。
analysis.method: 两阶段蒸馏：第一阶段使用前沿LLM智能体对教师模型的执行框架提出修改建议，并通过配对统计检验筛选有效修改；第二阶段收集教师轨迹（包含推理和故障恢复），蒸馏一个4B学生模型替换教师。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出TinyAstral，通过先递归自改进大型视觉-语言-动作模型的执行框架（harness），再将改进后的框架和推理蒸馏到4B参数的小模型，以降低推理成本并保持性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接涉及机器人操作与视觉-语言模型，通过改进执行框架和模型蒸馏实现高效推理，属于VLA应用的效率改进，与WAM无直接关联。

(a) With teacher weights frozen, RSI improves the harness; we then freeze the final harness, collect teacher trajectories, and distill small students. (b) Harness evolution improves the teacher and other frozen planners. Students trained separately at four harness versions each approach their corresponding teacher. (c) Final students on training and unseen benchmarks. Solid/dashed lines: 4B/0.8B students; filled/hollow points: comparisons under the same constraints versus additional advantages or different protocols ( Tab. 2 ). Axes are scaled independently.

figures.caption: Overview of TinyAstral. Stage 1: humans specify the rules and budget in advance. A master of frontier LLM agents reads trajectories of the frozen teacher acting through the harness (tools, feedback, memory, recovery) and proposes harness edits, which are accepted only if a paired A/B test on selection seeds passes a pre-registered statistical gate; model weights never change. Stage 2: after evolution ends, we freeze H ∗ H^{*} and collect teacher trajectories, including reasoning and recovery branches. These are mixed with offline real-robot supervision to train tiny students (0.8B–4B), which replace the teacher in the same harness.
