papers.title: TinyAstral: Transferring Self-Evolving Harnesses to Tiny Generalist Manipulation Agents
papers.title_zh: TinyAstral：将自进化执行框架迁移到微型通用操作智能体

papers.abstract: Learning from offline datasets is limited in scalability, as collecting new experience is often costly or unsafe in the real world. World models offer an alternative way to generate new experience through a learned dynamics model, yet learning policies in latent space is limited due to compounding errors in imagined rollouts. To this end, we propose using the world model as a local transition generator, leveraging critic guidance to choose actions inside that model to generate synthetic experiences. We study action refinement methodologies, introducing Critic-Guided Synthetic Experience (CGSE) generation in world models. Specifically, CGSE augments an existing offline dataset by sampling candidate actions using an offline policy and refining each to maximize a first-order approximation of the $Q$-function within a trust region. We then use a frozen latent world model to imagine the future state given each updated action, and use the critic to choose the best one, appending this synthetic transition to the replay buffer. Our method requires no additional real-environment interaction or test-time planner, as it generates synthetic experience offline using the world model. On three OGBench manipulation tasks, CGSE improves an offline policy by a relative improvement of $7.1\%$ on the average success rate.

analysis.key_results: 在三个 OGBench 操作任务上，CGSE 使离线策略的平均成功率相对提升 7.1%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 CGSE 方法，将世界模型作为局部转移生成器，利用评论家在信任区域内细化候选动作，生成合成转移扩充离线数据集，无需额外真实环境交互或测试时规划。
analysis.method: CGSE 利用离线策略采样候选动作，在信任区域内最大化 Q 函数的一阶近似来细化动作，使用冻结的潜在世界模型想象下一状态，并由评论家选择最佳转移加入重放缓冲区。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过评论家引导的合成经验生成（CGSE），在潜在世界模型内离线增强操作数据集，提升离线策略成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究直接涉及世界模型在机器人操作中的应用，通过合成数据生成增强离线策略学习，属于世界模型辅助机器人学习范畴，与 VLA/WAM（视觉-语言-动作/世界-动作模型）主题高度相关。

Starting from an offline latent z 0 z_{0} , the fixed BC-flow actor samples N N candidate first actions and FMQ-style guidance applies a one-step trust-region critic-gradient refinement to each candidate. papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can perform diverse manipulation tasks directly from visual observations and natural language instructions, but they remain prone to mistakes and unpredictable failures. Deploying these policies without continuous human supervision will require robust runtime monitors that detect when the policy has gone off-course. Existing monitors use external foundation models, such as vision-language models (VLMs) to supervise the policy, introducing significant complexity and computational cost for monitoring at runtime. In this work, we investigate an alternate approach: \textit{can a VLA's own internal activations provide the information needed to monitor its execution?} Our method trains linear probes on policy activations from demonstrations to estimate progress, then flags executions that deviate from expected progress. In experiments with the open-source VLA $\pi_{0.5}$ and across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, this approach is competitive with or outperforms VLM-based monitors in task failure detection, as well as methods which require failure data for training. These findings suggest that simple probes of VLA internals can be used to develop reliable runtime monitors, opening a path toward building policies that can act reliably and monitor their execution without external foundation models.

analysis.key_results: 在开源VLA π0.5及模拟与真实世界操作任务中，该方法在任务失败检测上优于或媲美基于VLM的监控方法以及需要失败数据训练的方法。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并验证了一种仅利用VLA模型内部激活的轻量级运行时监控方法，无需外部视觉-语言模型或失败数据，即可在模拟与真实操作任务中达到与基于VLM的监控相当或更优的失败检测性能。
analysis.method: 在演示数据上训练线性探测器，基于策略激活估计任务进展，并标记偏离预期进展的执行过程。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该工作提出利用VLA模型自身激活训练线性探测器来估计任务进展，以实现轻量级运行时监控，避免依赖外部基础模型。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接以视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为核心研究对象，探索利用其内部表示进行运行时监控，属于VLA模型可靠性与评估方向，与本站主题高度相关。

At runtime, successful executions follow the expected progression through the task, whereas failed executions cause the decoded progress to lag or deviate from this nominal trajectory. Thus, the policy’s own representations enable us to construct a lightweight runtime monitor without failure data or an external foundation model.

papers.abstract: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires long-horizon instruction-consistent planning and short-horizon path planning grounded in the currently observed geometry. Anticipating how future observations evolve along the instructed route provides predictive guidance beyond the current field of view, motivating video-action models (VAMs) that learn representations of future visual states. However, many existing VAMs couple future visual prediction with action generation during inference, despite their distinct temporal requirements: instruction-conditioned route guidance can be reused across multiple control steps, whereas local trajectories must continuously adapt to fresh observations. To bridge this gap, we introduce HAVANA, a dual-system VAM that decouples predictive reasoning from reactive local planning. A slow system produces a compact language-conditioned latent plan from observation history, while a fast system combines the latest plan with the current observation to generate local trajectories. Their asynchronous execution enables rapid adaptation without repeated future prediction, and no future video is generated during inference. Experiments on OmniNavBench demonstrate state-of-the-art navigation performance over prior baselines, while zero-shot real-world deployments further show robust generalization to unseen environments.

analysis.key_results: 在OmniNavBench上取得最优导航性能，零样本真实世界部署展示对未见环境的鲁棒泛化。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出HAVANA，一个双系统视频-动作模型，将指令条件的潜在规划（慢系统）与基于当前观测的局部轨迹生成（快系统）解耦，实现异步执行而不在推理时生成未来视频。
analysis.method: 双系统架构：慢系统基于观测历史生成紧凑的语言条件潜在计划；快系统结合最新计划与当前观测生成局部轨迹，执行异步推理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种分层视频-动作模型，将预测性推理与反应式局部规划解耦，以实现高效且稳健的视觉-语言导航。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于视频-动作模型（VAM）在视觉-语言导航任务中的应用，通过解耦预测与动作生成，直接提升了机器人导航的推理效率与泛化能力，与VLA和WAM主题高度相关。

figures.caption: Overview of the HAVANA training pipeline. Left: The slow system processes an RGB observation history, a navigation instruction, and four learnable time-conditioned queries with a video reasoner. Its contextual and query states form the understanding (UND) stream. The query states are also decoded by a supervised MLP into four egocentric waypoints ( waypoint prediction ). A clean conditioning latent and noisy future latents form the generation (GEN) stream. UND uses causal self-attention; GEN jointly attends to both streams within each sample. Future latents are supervised by flow matching. Right: RGB, depth, and UND latents condition a 1D U-Net for flow-matching-based prediction of a 24-step trajectory.

papers.abstract: The training loss of binary and ternary neural networks, expanded as a multilinear polynomial over the discrete weights, is structurally equivalent to the energy of a hierarchical high-order Ising model. We exploit this equivalence to apply Ising solvers to discrete-weight network training, while accounting for a fundamental difference in objectives: an Ising solver seeks the ground state of a fixed energy function, whereas training seeks solutions that generalize to unseen data. Our key contribution is $\Sigma\Delta$-Sampler, an optimizer that reconciles these objectives by embedding a stochastic sampling-and-annealing step as a noisy quantizer inside a first-order $\Sigma\Delta$ noise-shaping loop. The loop pushes noise from weight quantization, high-order frustration, and mini-batch sampling out of the low-frequency adaptation band, so that discrete weight updates follow the smooth descent trajectories embedded in the rugged loss landscape. We validate the framework on a planted quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) benchmark with a known minimizer; on CIFAR-10, where a $13$M-parameter ternary model comes within $1\%$ of full-precision accuracy; on ImageNet-1k, where a ternary ResNet-18 comes within $0.4\%$ Top-5 accuracy of a ternary baseline; on class-incremental continual learning, where prior-task accuracy is preserved; and on MatMul-free language models up to $2.7$B parameters, where it outperforms a straight-through-estimator baseline under matched continued pre-training. Compared with standard quantization-aware training, $\Sigma\Delta$-Sampler reduces the training memory footprint by over $50\%$, delivers an order-of-magnitude speed-up, and reduces weight-update memory traffic by four orders of magnitude, making it attractive for on-device training and fine-tuning of large binary and ternary models.

analysis.key_results: CIFAR-10 上 13M 参数三值模型准确率差距在 1% 以内；ImageNet-1k 上三值 ResNet-18 的 Top-5 准确率与基线差距 0.4%；类增量持续学习中保持先前任务准确率；2.7B 参数 MatMul-free 语言模型上优于直通估计基线。训练内存占用减少超 50%，速度提升一个数量级，权重更新内存流量减少四个数量级。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 ΣΔ-Sampler，一种将 Ising 求解器与神经网络训练目标统一的优化器，通过噪声整形环将量化、高阶挫败和小批量采样的噪声推出低频自适应带。
analysis.method: 将随机采样和退火作为噪声量化器嵌入一阶 ΣΔ 噪声整形环中，使离散权重更新跟随平滑下降轨迹。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 ΣΔ-Sampler，通过将随机采样与退火步骤嵌入一阶 ΣΔ 噪声整形环中，实现二值和三值神经网络的可扩展训练。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于模型量化这一独立的高效推理主题，未直接涉及 VLA 或 WAM；但其提出的 ΣΔ-Sampler 方法可用于二值和三值模型的高效训练，与 VLA/WAM 中的模型量化需求有间接关联。

papers.abstract: When humans hand each other objects, they incorporate both geometric and semantic information into this process. For example, passing a knife with the handle towards the recipient, rather than the blade, is both more ergonomic and safer. Recent state-of-the-art methods for task-oriented robot-human handovers have progressed from modeling object geometry to incorporating object affordances. However, they often forgo predicting the explicit, task-specific hand poses a human selects to utilize an object. Since many objects support multiple interaction modalities, e.g., a claw hammer used to strike or pull nails, this variability must be modeled to achieve robust task-oriented handovers. To tackle this, we propose a novel approach, GENESIS-Handover (GENErative HypotheSIS), which leverages VLM image generation to produce a variety of task-specific hand-object interaction hypotheses. These hypotheses are matched in real time to the observed human hand pose, enabling inference of the most suitable handover configuration. By leveraging VLMs as priors of plausible hand-object interactions, the method produces task-conditioned handover strategies for previously unseen object-task pairs. We evaluate the standalone interaction proposal module before deploying the full system on a mobile manipulator. In a user study with 12 participants across five task-object pairs, 83.3% perceived our method to have better task understanding than the previous state of the art.

analysis.key_results: 用户研究（12名参与者，5个任务物体对）显示83.3%认为该方法比之前最先进方法具有更好的任务理解。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种新方法GENESIS-Handover，利用视觉语言模型（VLM）生成任务特定的手物交互假设，并实时匹配观察人手姿态，推断最合适的交接配置。
analysis.method: 利用VLM图像生成产生多样化任务特定手物交互假设，将假设与实时观察的人手姿态匹配，推断最佳交接配置。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出GENESIS-Handover方法，利用VLM图像生成多种任务特定手物交互假设，并实时匹配观察人手姿态，实现任务导向的机器人交接。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文与VLA高度相关，因为它利用视觉语言模型作为手物交互的先验知识，预测任务特定的人手姿态，从而实现任务导向的机器人交接。这属于使用VLM进行机器人操作和动作预测的范畴。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action policies may predict a transferable manipulation strategy yet fail to realize it reliably on the encountered object: objects compatible with the same grasp differ in geometry and compliance, and visual feedback degrades under closure occlusion. AgenticTactileVLA is presented as an execution-time supervisor that shifts part of object-specific adaptation from prediction to physical interaction. A fixed VLA provides the approach and hand targets; the supervisor decides whether to remain transparent, refine finger flexion, retain or release the corrected configuration, return control to the VLA for retry, or select a compliant hand-control regime. It uses finger-position and motor-effort feedback as proprioceptive contact evidence and requires neither tactile sensors nor VLA retraining. On a Unitree G1 with a BrainCo Revo2 hand, a randomized matched-block evaluation on five objects held out from VLA training yields 61.3% completion for the base VLA, 72.0% for unconditional close-to-stall control, and 84.0% for the supervisor under a shared budget; the gain is positive on every object and persists under moderate pose perturbations. Ablations show the gain is not explained by extended closure alone, and that selective triggering reduces correction episodes by 65.7% with no detected change in completion. A retention audit shows acceptance predicts retention in 88.9% of held-out cases, while compliant objects expose conservative false rejection. A thin-walled-cup study demonstrates contextual routing to compliant control, matching an always-compliant reference. These results suggest that contact-guided execution-time adaptation can improve the object-level generalization of a fixed VLA to held-out objects by adapting physical realization without object-specific retraining.

analysis.key_results: 基础VLA完成率61.3%，无条件接近失速控制72.0%，监督器在共享预算下84.0%；增益在每个物体上均为正，且在中度位姿扰动下持续；选择性触发减少矫正事件65.7%且完成率无显著变化；接受预测保持率88.9%；薄壁杯研究展示上下文路由到顺应控制。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出AgenticTactileVLA执行时监督器，将对象特定的适应从预测转移到物理交互，利用手指位置和电机力矩反馈决定是否调整手指屈曲、保持或释放配置、重试或选择顺应控制模式。
analysis.method: 固定VLA提供接近和手部目标；监督器基于手指位置和电机力矩反馈进行决策，在Unitree G1机器人和BrainCo Revo2手上进行实验，采用随机匹配块评估五个未见过的物体。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种执行时监督器，通过本体感觉接触证据调整固定VLA的输出，提高对未见过物体的操作泛化能力，无需触觉传感器或VLA再训练。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对固定VLA在真实物体操作中的泛化问题，通过执行时监督不修改VLA权重，提高对象级泛化能力，与VLA在机器人操作中的实际部署密切相关。

papers.abstract: World action models integrate future visual dynamics with robot action prediction, but their scalability remains limited by the need for action-annotated robot trajectories. Observation-only videos contain rich evidence about interaction dynamics, but existing approaches typically use them either to pretrain visual representations that must later be adapted for control, or to infer latent actions that are subsequently grounded to robot commands. We present NAVA-WAM, which introduces native action-prior learning by directly pretraining the action policy from observation-only videos, avoiding indirect representation-to-control transfer or a separate latent-action model. Our training consists of two stages. First, we pretrain on observation-only videos, where future-video flow-matching supervision over visual transitions is propagated through transition-structured joint attention to optimize the Action-DiT and learn action-relevant priors. Second, we use action-labeled demonstrations to post-train the Action-DiT for robot control through joint video--action flow matching, while asymmetric attention decouples the visual branch from iterative action denoising and enables efficient action-only inference. Extensive experiments show that NAVA-WAM consistently outperforms prior approaches under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, while demonstrating strong action-label efficiency and effective real-robot generalization. These results establish native action-prior learning as an effective approach to directly pretrain action policies from observation-only videos, providing a scalable path beyond action-labeled robot data.

analysis.key_results: NAVA-WAM在分布内和分布外设置下均优于先前方法，展现出强动作标签效率和有效的真实机器人泛化。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入原生动作先验学习，利用观察视频直接预训练动作策略，避免间接表征到控制的迁移或单独的潜动作模型。
analysis.method: 两阶段训练：第一阶段在观察视频上用未来视频流匹配监督通过过渡结构联合注意力优化Action-DiT；第二阶段用动作标注演示通过联合视频-动作流匹配进行后训练，同时利用非对称注意力解耦视觉分支实现仅动作的高效推理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出NAVA-WAM，通过直接从观察视频中预训练动作策略，实现原生动作先验学习，以提高世界动作模型的扩展性和数据效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接研究世界动作模型（WAM），提出从观察视频中预训练动作策略的新方法，对本站主题WAM具有核心相关性。

figures.caption: Paradigms of leveraging observation-only videos for robot policy learning. (1) Vision representation learning first learns visual representations from videos within a vision encoder and then trains an action policy on top, introducing an indirect representation-to-control transfer. (2) Latent-action learning extracts latent actions from visual transitions as intermediate supervision for policy learning, introducing an additional modeling stage and a potential representational bottleneck. (3) Native action-prior learning directly uses video dynamics to optimize the action policy, avoiding additional intermediate interfaces and representational bottlenecks.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview of NAVA-WAM . During native action-prior pre-training, the Action-DiT is optimized solely through future-video supervision, learning action-relevant priors directly from observation-only videos. During post-training, the Video-DiT and Action-DiT are jointly optimized on action-labeled robot demonstrations using video and action flow-matching objectives, adapting the pretrained Action-DiT to continuous robot control. At inference, NAVA-WAM denoises only robot actions without explicitly generating future videos, enabling efficient closed-loop control.

papers.abstract: Despite the success of discrete diffusion language models (dLMs) for fast parallel decoding, their non-smooth, high-dimensional space hinders trajectory steering for reasoning and inference acceleration. To overcome this, we present Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, the first family of large-scale (3B/8B) continuous dLMs built on steerable, low-dimensional ODE/SDE latent trajectories. Trained blockwise via likelihood optimization, Nemotron-Labs-Sigma jointly denoises Gaussian-corrupted token embeddings while learning an optimal embedding geometry, and leverages pretrained autoregressive (AR) weights for warm-starting. At inference, we identify classifier-free guidance and score temperature as essential for high-fidelity reasoning and coding. Against state-of-the-art discrete counterparts (masked dLMs and AR baselines), Nemotron-Labs-Sigma outperforms them on standard benchmarks after pretraining (e.g., GSM8K, Minerva, HumanEval, MBPP) and on challenging reasoning tasks after supervised fine-tuning (e.g., MATH-500, AIME), with the largest consistent gains on coding. Beyond accuracy, we exploit two structural properties unique to continuous dLMs. First, smooth trajectories degrade gracefully at low NFEs and enable efficient few-step distillation: distribution matching proves strongest among the methods we study, giving roughly 8x acceleration on math and 4x on coding (8 and 4 tokens per forward pass) with negligible accuracy loss and preserved diversity. In addition, the one-step speculative decoding on the (pre-SFT) distilled 8B model yields a further ~3.5x throughput gain over the AR counterpart (on GB200), outperforming masked dLM baselines. Second, embedding-space steering controls the quality--diversity trade-off, yielding strong pass@$k$ that keeps improving as $k$ grows. Together, these results establish continuous dLMs as a promising paradigm for efficient language generation.

analysis.key_results: 在标准基准（GSM8K、Minerva、HumanEval、MBPP）上超越掩码离散扩散模型和AR基线；监督微调后在MATH-500、AIME等挑战任务上取得最佳结果；分布匹配蒸馏带来约8倍（数学）和4倍（编码）加速；单步推测解码在蒸馏8B模型上相较AR基线获得约3.5倍吞吐量提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出首个大规模（3B/8B）连续离散扩散语言模型家族Nemotron-Labs-Sigma，在低维潜在轨迹上实现可操控的ODE/SDE去噪，并利用预训练AR权重进行warm-start。
analysis.method: 连续离散扩散语言模型，基于低维ODE/SDE潜在轨迹，联合去噪高斯损坏的token嵌入并学习最优嵌入几何；推理中采用无分类器引导和分数温度控制；通过分布匹配蒸馏实现少步生成，并利用单步推测解码加速。

papers.abstract: Generating useful robot-training data requires more than visually plausiblescenes: objects must support interaction, placements must remain physicallyvalid, and tasks must admit repeatable execution. We present\textbf{Awomo-SimDataEngine}, an agentic system that connects asset and scenegeneration to robot demonstration synthesis. Shared asset services providerigid and articulated objects, including structure-grounded part and jointgeneration with ISArt. Scene generation supports two complementary routes:Unravel reconstructs editable scenes from images, while SimForge buildssingle-room and multi-room environments from text. A graph-native harnesscoordinates construction, validation, andbounded repair, routing failures to the responsible module while retainingunaffected scene state. PolicyForge binds validated worlds to tasks and robotembodiments to produce replayable demonstrations. Evaluations cover assetgeometry, scene quality, and downstream policy learning. On MuJoCo-basedLIBERO-Plus, co-training with Isaac Sim demonstrations improves the overallsuccess rate of a World-Action Model (WAM) from $77.17\%$ to $89.43\%$. Goal and spatialsuccess improve by $31.66$ and $6.25$ percentage points, respectively . These results support the utility of the generated data for cross-simulatorpolicy training, with more limited gains on long-horizon tasks.

analysis.key_results: 在MuJoCo基础LIBERO-Plus上，与Isaac Sim演示共同训练世界-动作模型（WAM）的整体成功率从77.17%提升至89.43%，目标成功率和空间成功率分别提升31.66和6.25个百分点。
analysis.limitations: 长时程任务上的提升有限。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个智能体系统Awomo-SimDataEngine，连接资产和场景生成与机器人演示合成，支持从图像或文本生成可交互场景，并可将生成数据用于下游策略学习。
analysis.method: 通过共享资产服务生成刚体和关节物体（ISArt），采用Unravel从图像重建场景、SimForge从文本构建环境，图原生协调器负责构建、验证和有界修复，PolicyForge将验证后的世界绑定到任务与机器人本体以生成可回放演示。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个智能体系统Awomo-SimDataEngine，将资产生成、场景构建与机器人演示合成连接起来，用于生成机器人训练数据并提升世界-动作模型性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接涉及世界-动作模型（WAM）的训练数据生成，通过仿真生成机器人交互数据用于提升WAM策略性能，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown great promise for robotic manipulation by mapping multi-modal semantics to physical actions. However, this mapping inherently struggles to align these coarse-grained semantics with fine-grained temporal execution. It leaves VLA models with limited generalization and insufficient robustness in cluttered environments. To overcome this issue, we propose ActionUNet, an efficient multi-scale fine-tuning framework that enhances pre-trained VLA models with minimal computational cost. ActionUNet first constructs a lightweight temporal U-Net within the temporal-aligned action feature space to fuse hierarchical structural priors, effectively bridging the scale gap between semantics and temporal executions. Recognizing that multi-scale modeling can disrupt microscopic temporal continuity and cause mechanical oscillations, ActionUNet then employs a conditional SIREN as a continuous action decoder. Equipped with explicit second-order smoothness constraints, this decoder guarantees temporal continuity and reduces high-frequency motion jitter. By smoothing temporal discontinuities from multi-scale fusion, this continuous formulation reduces mechanical execution failures while preserving the base VLA model's generalization and manipulation robustness. Extensive experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks, together with real-world hard evaluations, demonstrate that ActionUNet significantly improves {\pi}0.5 success rates by absolute 9.8%, 6.1%, and 11.4%, respectively, while also generalizing to the regression-based OpenVLA-OFT backbone, highlighting its effectiveness and efficiency as a fine-tuning strategy. Code and implementation details are available at https://github.com/Di-Zhu123/ActionUNet.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboTwin 2.0和LIBERO-Plus基准以及真实世界评估中，ActionUNet将π0.5的成功率分别绝对提升9.8%、6.1%和11.4%，并可推广到基于回归的OpenVLA-OFT骨干网络。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ActionUNet，一种轻量级多尺度微调框架，通过时序U-Net融合层次结构先验，并利用带二阶平滑约束的条件SIREN确保时间连续性，减少高频抖动。
analysis.method: 在时间对齐的动作特征空间中构建轻量时序U-Net融合多尺度先验；使用条件SIREN作为连续动作解码器，加入显式二阶平滑约束保证时间连续性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出ActionUNet，一种在VLA模型中融入时序U-Net和条件SIREN的高效多尺度微调框架，以增强机器人操作的泛化性和鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接聚焦于VLA模型，旨在通过高效微调提升VLA在机器人操作中的鲁棒性和泛化能力，与本站VLA和WAM主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: An orthogonal rotation improves the distance rank correlation of two-bit Cohere codes from 0.75 to 0.91, yet increases nearest-neighbour comparison flips by 51%. We analyse quantization through the comparisons made by graph search. A comparison changes only when its quantization error exceeds its exact margin, giving a flip bound that separates close calls from large errors. Shared endpoints induce correlated distance errors that partly cancel within a comparison. An exact replay identity connects candidate-level actions to the output of neighbour selection. A Gaussian model gives coordinate-code errors in closed form, and a rare-spike construction exposes heavy tails in the population-radius error. Held-out blocks give model-free certificates for acceptance rules based on exact or quantized margins. Across 24 dataset-code configurations, calibration-estimated risk correlates with held-out ranking and pruning flips at 0.97 and 0.99, compared with 0.91 and 0.99 for a margin-to-noise summary and 0.74 and 0.05 for distance rank correlation. Paired builds of 200,000-vector graphs connect rotation, query scoring, and topology to end-to-end recall and search work.

analysis.key_results: 校准估计风险与保留块上的排序和剪枝翻转相关性分别达到0.97和0.99；正交旋转可将两比特码的距离秩相关性从0.75提升至0.91，但最近邻比较翻转增加51%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种基于量化误差与精确边距比较的翻转界限框架，并对量化对搜索决策的影响进行理论和实证分析。
analysis.method: 通过图搜索中的比较决策分析量化误差，推导翻转界限，利用高斯模型和稀有尖峰构造分析编码误差行为，并在多个数据集和编码配置上进行校准评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究低比特量化在向量搜索中对距离比较决策的影响，并提出量化误差与比较翻转之间的界限模型。

papers.abstract: Post-training VLA policies typically rely on supervised fine-tuning with costly expert demonstrations or reinforcement learning with expensive and potentially unstable real-world exploration. World models offer a promising alternative by evaluating candidate behaviors through imagined futures, yet effective post-training requires more than accurate prediction: imagination must be scheduled where it is useful, bounded within reliable horizons, and translated into trustworthy policy supervision. In robotic manipulation, the value of imagination varies substantially across execution stages, while extended rollouts can accumulate prediction errors and introduce unreliable learning signals. We introduce WISE (World-model-guided Imagination Scheduling for Efficient Post-training of Vision-Language-Action Models), a unified framework that coordinates when and how world-model imagination is used during policy refinement. WISE selectively invokes imagination at interaction-relevant states, performs bounded multi-view rollouts, evaluates candidate futures using progress and completion signals, and uses their relative outcomes to refine actions generated from real interaction contexts. Extensive experiments with both $\pi_0$ and $\pi_{0.5}$ demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse manipulation tasks while reducing GPU computation time by approximately 80% compared with full imagination. Real-world evaluations further show substantial gains in robustness and generalization under diverse real-world distribution shifts.

analysis.key_results: 在π0和π0.5两个模型上，WISE在多种操纵任务中实现一致的性能提升，并将GPU计算时间降低约80%；真实世界评估显示在分布偏移下鲁棒性和泛化性有显著提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出统一框架WISE，协调世界模型想象在VLA策略后训练中的使用时机与方式，在交互相关状态选择性调用想象、进行有界多视图推演、利用进度与完成信号评估候选未来，并用相对结果改进动作生成。
analysis.method: 使用世界模型引导的想象调度，在交互相关状态选择性调用想象、进行有界多视图推演、通过进度与完成信号评估候选未来，并用相对结果细化动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: WISE框架通过世界模型引导的想象调度，在策略细化过程中选择性使用想象、约束推理范围并利用相对结果改进动作，从而提升VLA模型后训练性能并大幅降低计算开销。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对视觉-语言-动作模型的后训练，利用世界模型想象进行高效策略改进，属于VLA与WAM交叉的核心主题。

papers.abstract: Procedural video-language models must solve heterogeneous tasks from the same visual evidence, including action recognition, forecasting, and procedure prediction. Dense transformer decoders share the same feed-forward networks across tasks, which can entangle task behavior and make controlled capability expansion difficult. Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) decoders provide conditional computation, but token-level learned routing is not naturally aligned with task-level procedural objectives. We propose MoTE (Mixture of Task Experts), a decoder architecture that converts large language model feed-forward networks into task-specific experts while keeping the multimodal backbone shared. Each example follows one sample-level task route, so active task-expert computation remains independent of the number of stored task experts. We instantiate this design as VideoLLM-MoTE and evaluate it on five COIN benchmarks using explicit task routes. The five-expert model activates ~2B LLM parameters per sample and achieves higher average top-1 accuracy than recent VideoLLM baselines. Under the same expert topology, it improves over dense all-expert activation and learned sparse-routing controls. These results show that task-structured routing provides an interpretable and compute-efficient decoder alternative for multi-task video-language learning.

analysis.key_results: 在五个COIN基准上，五专家模型每样本激活约2B LLM参数，平均top-1准确率超过近期VideoLLM基线；相同专家拓扑下优于密集全专家激活和可学习稀疏路由控制。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出MoTE（Mixture of Task Experts）解码器架构，将LLM的FFN转换为任务特定专家，共享多模态骨干，每个样本仅激活一个任务专家，实现计算高效且可解释的多任务视频语言学习。
analysis.method: MoTE架构：将大语言模型前馈网络划分为任务特定专家，每个样本遵循一条样本级任务路由，激活参数与存储专家数无关；实例化为VideoLLM-MoTE。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出MoTE架构，将大语言模型的前馈网络转化为任务特定专家，通过样本级任务路由实现多任务视频语言学习的计算高效解码。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于视频语言多任务学习的稀疏专家混合高效推理，与VLA或WAM无直接关系，但其任务结构化路由和计算高效解码思路可能对高效模型推理有方法学借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: When the weights and biases of a neural network range over a fixed finite alphabet, training the network to fit a data set exactly becomes a finite combinatorial problem, and parameterized complexity asks which structural quantities of an instance make this problem tractable. Ganian, Sommer, and Sorge (ICLR 2026) showed that training quantized networks is fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized jointly by the input dimension $\alpha$, the output dimension $\omega$, and the treewidth of the architecture, and they asked whether $\alpha+\omega$ alone suffices. We show that it does not: training binary quantized networks is W[1]-hard parameterized by $\alpha+\omega$, so it admits no algorithm with running time $f(\alpha+\omega)\cdot|I|^{O(1)}$ for any computable $f$ unless FPT = W[1]. Hardness holds already for exact fitting of $k+1$ examples whose inputs equal their targets and form a coordinatewise prefix chain, and also when all biases are fixed to zero. The proof rests on a one-flip routing equivalence. On such data, nonnegative binary weights force every neuron to switch on at most once, and a network fits the data exactly if and only if the architecture contains vertex-disjoint paths that link each changing input to the corresponding output. Every neuron therefore has one of only $k+1$ activation profiles, yet deciding whether these profiles can be realized simultaneously is as hard as disjoint-path routing. Small input and output dimensions thus limit what each neuron can do locally, but not how the architecture forces neurons to share resources globally.

analysis.key_results: 训练二进制量化网络在参数 α+ω 下是 W[1]-难的，除非 FPT=W[1]，不存在运行时间为 f(α+ω)·|I|^{O(1)} 的算法；硬度结果在偏置固定为零时依然成立。
analysis.main_contribution: 证明了二进制量化神经网络训练在参数为输入维度与输出维度之和时是 W[1]-难的，从而否定了现有固定参数可解结论仅用这两项参数的可能性。
analysis.method: 通过构造输入等于目标且形成坐标前缀链的特定数据集，并证明网络精确拟合当且仅当网络架构中存在连接每个变化输入到对应输出的顶点不相交路径（one-flip routing equivalence），从而归约到不相交路径路由问题。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文证明训练二进制量化神经网络在仅以输入和输出维度为参数时是 W[1]-难的，解决了先前工作中关于参数化复杂性的遗留问题。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究量化神经网络训练的参数化复杂度，属于独立的模型量化主题，与 VLA 或世界-动作模型无直接关系，但其结论对涉及量化机器人策略网络的效率理论分析可能具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are commonly adapted to downstream manipulation tasks via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or online reinforcement learning(RL) post-training. SFT is prone to distribution mismatch, and existing RL approaches typically optimize all trainable components within a single RL loop at a uniform update rate, although these components play distinct functional roles. We propose TEMPO, a semantic-action decoupled, two-timescale RL post-training framework for VLA models. TEMPO freezes the pretrained vision-language backbone and adapts two components with dedicated RL loops: the semantic projection layer, which produces the latent action conditioning the action expert, and the low-level action expert itself. The semantic projection layer is updated infrequently and the action expert frequently, which aims to limit latent-action drift while allowing the action expert to learn from online feedback. Our analyses show that, compared with equal update frequencies, less frequent semantic updates reduce latent-action drift and improve policy performance. Experiments on the CALVIN benchmark and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that TEMPO outperforms both pretrained state-of-the-art VLA models and the RL post-training baseline, while reaching and maintaining higher evaluation rewards on three real-world tasks.

analysis.key_results: 在CALVIN基准和真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，TEMPO优于预训练的SOTA VLA模型和RL后训练基线，并在三个真实世界任务上达到并保持更高的评估奖励。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TEMPO框架，冻结预训练视觉-语言骨干，对语义投影层和低层动作专家分别采用低频和高频强化学习更新，减少潜在动作漂移并提高策略性能。
analysis.method: 通过监督微调或在线强化学习进行后训练，采用双时间尺度训练策略：语义投影层低频更新，动作专家高频更新。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: TEMPO提出一种语义-动作解耦的双时间尺度强化学习后训练框架，通过冻结视觉-语言骨干并以不同频率更新语义投影层和低层动作专家，减少潜在动作漂移并提升VLA模型在操作任务上的性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: TEMPO直接面向VLA模型的后训练，通过分解语义和动作组件并采用双时间尺度RL，改进了VLA在机器人操作任务中的在线适应能力，与VLA主题高度相关。

papers.title: TEMPO: Semantic-Action Decoupled RL Post-Training for Vision-Language-Action Models

papers.abstract: Modern LLM deployments use a number of implementation choices and inference optimizations (e.g., batching, custom kernels, and quantization) on top of fixed weights, so two engines serving "the same model" can produce meaningfully different distributions. We study the problem of estimating the total variation (TV) distance between two length-$n$ autoregressive distributions to additive error $\varepsilon$, under three access models. (1) Under sample access, we use $\widetilde{O}(n^2 K/\varepsilon^2)$ queries, where $K$ is the maximum support of the next-token distribution. This improves upon the $\widetilde{O}(n^3 m/\varepsilon^5)$-query estimator of Meel et al. (2025), where $m \geq K$ is the total size of the token alphabet. (2) Under logit access, we use $O(n/\varepsilon^2)$ queries, and this is tight. (3) Under noisy logit access, we smoothly interpolate between the above two guarantees: if probability values are given to relative error $\sigma$, we use $\widetilde{O}((n+n^2\sigma^2)/\varepsilon^2)$ queries. We complement our theoretical results with an empirical evaluation of our algorithms, for example measuring the distance between SGLang and vLLM serving identical weights. Our experiments highlight the robustness and practicality of estimating the total variation distance, which remains estimable where the KL divergence is infinite. Our code is available at https://github.com/XunZhiyang/llm-tv-estimation.

papers.abstract: The paper presents a voice anonymization model focusing on preserving content rather than producing realistic speech. It relies on content embeddings extracted from a frozen pretrained wav2vec2 encoder. These embeddings are decoded into an anonymized signal using vector quantization and a HiFi-GAN vocoder, both trained on LibriTTS without any waveform reconstruction loss or speaker embedding mapping. The training objective enforces that embeddings of the anonymized signal match those of the original one. While training, an auxiliary speaker classification branch with a gradient reversal layer is used to discard speakerspecific information. Results show that this straightforward embedding-based approach achieves very low WER (2.53) with an anonymization performance (EER 13.39) ranking within first level for VPC. Notably, emotions are partially preserved (UAR 43.91), even without a supporting training objective, while the anonymized voice is audible without reconstruction loss.

analysis.key_results: WER 2.53，EER 13.39，情绪识别 UAR 43.91，在 VPC 中匿名化性能处于第一梯队。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种基于内容嵌入匹配的语音匿名化方法，使用向量量化和 HiFi-GAN 解码内容嵌入，训练目标为匿名信号嵌入与原始信号嵌入匹配，并通过梯度反转层去除说话人信息。
analysis.method: 利用冻结的 wav2vec2 编码器提取内容嵌入，使用向量量化和 HiFi-GAN 声码器生成匿名语音，训练时嵌入匹配损失，辅助说话人分类分支带梯度反转层。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出一种基于冻结的 wav2vec2 内容嵌入的语音匿名化模型，通过向量量化编码器与 HiFi-GAN 声码器直接重建匿名语音，无需波形重建损失或说话人映射。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 无直接关系。本文涉及向量量化用于语音匿名化，属于独立的模型量化/嵌入压缩技术，与 VLA、WAM 或机器人策略无直接联系，但其中的量化与去偏方法可为高效模型的中间特征处理提供一定参考。

papers.abstract: Water looks unchanged as it warms, then at a critical point it boils. We ask whether long-horizon language agents show an analogous transition in their ability to maintain an accurate representation of the evolving world state. In some parameter settings, a small change in a task parameter, or adding a single step to the task, leaves behavior nearly unchanged; near a critical boundary, the same small change causes a sudden collapse. We study this effect in a deterministic task family where the true world state is known at every step. A large grid search over state size, state dependency, horizon, number of available actions, observation mode, and frequency of state changes reveals a phase diagram: a low-stress region where the agent consistently succeeds, a narrow region where success drops sharply, and a high-stress region where the agent consistently fails. Step-by-step traces show the mechanism: the agent loses track of the true world before its actions become invalid, so the agent is not merely choosing a bad action; it is acting from a corrupted world. Stronger models reach the critical boundary later but do not eliminate the sharp transition. These results make world-model collapse a measurable bottleneck for long-horizon agents. Code will be made publicly available soon.

analysis.key_results: 强模型推迟了临界边界但未能消除急剧转变；智能体在动作失效前已丧失对真实世界的跟踪，即从损坏的世界模型行动。
analysis.main_contribution: 将世界模型崩塌形式化为一个可测量的相变瓶颈，并通过大规模网格搜索揭示低压力、临界和高压力区域的相图。
analysis.method: 在确定性任务家族中进行大规模网格搜索，扫描状态大小、状态依赖性、视程、可用动作数、观测模式和状态变化频率，并分析逐步轨迹。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 长程语言智能体在维持世界状态表征时会经历类似相变的临界崩塌，且该崩塌发生在动作失效之前。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接研究世界模型在长程任务中的崩塌，对WAM的可靠性与故障模式具有方法论价值，但不涉及VLA或机器人具体实施。

papers.abstract: AI sandboxes produce evidence about systems that may act through software tools, networked devices, or physical actuators. The interpretation of that evidence depends on the boundary of the experiment. We define a sandbox apparatus, distinguish five overlapping archetypes, and specify fifteen claim-relative measurement dimensions. A weakest-link licensing rule caps a deployment claim at its weakest necessary evidence dimension. We connect this rule to a threat model covering both outward harm and corruption of the evaluation apparatus, then apply it to four worked examples spanning driving, industrial control, tool-using agents, and vision-language-action manipulation. We also map the required artifacts to standards and regulatory instruments. The framework identifies which claims a bounded experiment supports, which failures its controls contain, and which assumptions require further validation before deployment.

analysis.key_results: 该框架能识别有界实验支持哪些声明、其控制措施能遏制哪些失败，以及部署前需进一步验证的假设。

papers.abstract: As autonomous vehicle capabilities advance, the safe evaluation of driving policies in long-tail scenarios remains a critical bottleneck. In closed-loop simulation, the driving policy model actively interacts with the environment, where its actions dynamically update the simulator state and directly influence the next set of generated sensor observations. While recent reconstruction-based neural simulators offer photorealism, they are fundamentally constrained by their initial captured data and struggle to generalize to highly dynamic or novel scenes. To overcome these limitations, we introduce OmniDreams, a foundation generative world model mid- and post-trained from the Cosmos diffusion model to autoregressively generate action-conditioned videos in real time. By leveraging the rich visual priors of Cosmos and mid- and post-training on 21k hours of driving scenarios, OmniDreams synthesizes complex, unobserved phenomena that are hard for traditional simulators to capture, such as extreme weather and unpredictable dynamic agent behaviors. Crucially, it autoregressively conditions its photorealistic sensor generation on past frames, the current simulator state, and immediate driving actions. Deployed in a closed-loop system with the Alpamayo 1 policy model and AlpaSim orchestrator, OmniDreams acts as a highly responsive, reactive environment, providing a scalable and comprehensive solution for training and evaluating next-generation autonomous driving policies. We additionally show preliminary results indicating that a world-action model (WAM) post-trained from OmniDreams achieves strong performance on the Physical AI Autonomous Vehicles NuRec dataset, surpassing the VLA-based Alpamayo 1.5 research policy model while using only 1/5 the total parameters. These results highlight the potential for a real-time world model like OmniDreams to also serve as a backbone for policy architectures.

analysis.key_results: OmniDreams 能合成传统模拟器难以捕捉的极端天气和不可预测动态智能体行为；由 OmniDreams 后训练得到的世界-动作模型（WAM）在 Physical AI Autonomous Vehicles NuRec 数据集上取得较强性能，仅使用 1/5 参数即超越基于 VLA 的 Alpamayo 1.5 研究策略模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了 OmniDreams，一个基础生成式世界模型，通过在大规模驾驶场景上对 Cosmos 扩散模型进行中训练和后训练，实现实时、动作条件的自回归视频生成，以支持自动驾驶策略的安全评估。
analysis.method: 利用 Cosmos 扩散模型的丰富视觉先验，在 21k 小时驾驶场景上进行中训练和后训练，自回归地以过去帧、当前模拟器状态和即时驾驶动作为条件生成逼真的传感器视频；并部署到包含 Alpamayo 1 策略模型和 AlpaSim 编排器的闭环系统中。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: OmniDreams 是一个基于 Cosmos 扩散模型构建的生成式世界模型，能够实时自回归生成动作条件的驾驶视频，并可与策略模型闭环集成用于自动驾驶训练和评估。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文核心是构建实时生成式世界模型 OmniDreams，并展示其作为世界-动作模型（WAM）骨干的潜力，属于世界模型与机器人学习范畴。其与 VLA 的关系体现在：OmniDreams 派生的 WAM 在参数效率上优于 VLA 基线 Alpamayo 1.5，表明世界模型可以作为策略架构的替代或增强，对本站关注的 VLA/WAM 主题有直接价值。

papers.abstract: INT2 KV-cache quantization is attractive for long-context LLM serving, yet making it both accurate and practical remains challenging. Data-oblivious rotations such as Hadamard transforms flatten channel outliers, but still degrade sharply at INT2 because they ignore how downstream attention queries the cache. We propose OSCAR, an ultra-low-bit KV-cache quantization method that estimates attention-aware covariance targets offline and uses them to derive fixed per-layer rotations and clipping thresholds. By aligning the quantization basis with the second-moment structures consumed by attention, OSCAR preserves attention fidelity at 2-bit precision. Beyond theoretical analysis under a frozen-error surrogate, we build a serving-ready OSCAR system with fused Triton write and decode kernels that preserve paged KV-cache layouts and prefix caching, integrating into modern serving engines such as SGLang and vLLM. We evaluate OSCAR on reasoning and coding benchmarks with generation traces of up to 32K tokens across five tasks. On Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 and Qwen3-8B, OSCAR narrows the BF16 accuracy gap to 3.78 and 1.21 points, respectively, where Hadamard-only INT2 collapses, and matches BF16 within run-to-run variance on Qwen3-32B and GLM-4.7 (358B parameters). On RULER-NIAH up to 128K tokens, OSCAR substantially outperforms QuaRot-style INT2 across context lengths. System-wise, OSCAR compresses KV-cache memory by nearly $8\times$, boosts multi-request throughput by up to $7.8\times$ at large batch sizes within the same memory budget, and accelerates batch-size-1 decoding by up to $3.1\times$ over BF16 by cutting KV memory traffic.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507和Qwen3-8B上，OSCAR将BF16精度差距分别缩小到3.78和1.21个点，而仅Hadamard的INT2量化失效；在Qwen3-32B和GLM-4.7（358B参数）上与BF16的差异在运行间方差内；在RULER-NIAH上（最长128K token）显著优于QuaRot风格INT2；系统方面，KV缓存内存压缩近8倍，大批次多请求吞吐量提升高达7.8倍，批大小为1的解码速度提升高达3.1倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出OSCAR，一种超低比特KV缓存量化方法，通过离线估计注意力感知协方差目标，推导出固定逐层旋转和裁剪阈值，在2比特精度下保持注意力保真度，并构建了集成到SGLang和vLLM中的服务就绪系统。
analysis.method: 离线估计注意力感知协方差目标，利用这些目标推导出固定的逐层旋转和裁剪阈值，使量化基与注意力消费的二阶矩结构对齐；并采用融合的Triton写入和解码内核，保留分页KV缓存布局和前缀缓存。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出OSCAR，一种利用离线估计的注意力感知协方差目标来生成固定逐层旋转和裁剪阈值的2比特KV缓存量化方法，以在长上下文LLM服务中保持注意力保真度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于通用LLM的KV缓存量化，不直接涉及VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或世界模型（WAM），但其提出的2比特KV缓存量化方法可作为高效推理技术，潜在适用于部署VLA或机器人策略模型时的内存和吞吐量优化。

papers.abstract: Quantization has become a standard tool for efficient LLM deployment, especially for local inference, where models are now routinely served at 2-3 bits per parameter. The state of the art is currently split into simple scalar quantization techniques, such as GPTQ or AWQ, which are widely deployed but plateau in accuracy at 3-4 bits per parameter (bpp), and "second-generation" vector- or trellis-quantized methods, such as QTIP, GPTVQ and AQLM, which push the accuracy frontier but are notoriously hard to implement and to scale. In this paper, we ask whether this gap is fundamental, or whether a carefully optimized $\textit{scalar}$ quantizer can recover most of it. We answer in the affirmative, by introducing GSQ (Gumbel-Softmax Quantization), a post-training scalar quantization method which jointly learns the per-coordinate grid assignments and the per-group scales using a Gumbel-Softmax relaxation of the discrete grid. GSQ matches the cardinality of the relaxation to the small number of levels available in the target bit-width regime (e.g., 3-8 levels for ternary and 3 bpp, respectively), making optimization tractable. Practically, on the standard Llama-3.1-8B/70B-Instruct models, GSQ closes most of the gap between scalar quantization and the QTIP frontier at 2 and 3 bits, while using a symmetric scalar grid with group-wise quantization, and thus remains compatible with existing scalar inference kernels. We further show that the same discrete-assignment optimization can be applied to practical GGUF K-Quant checkpoints: starting from publicly released GGUF models, GSQ improves accuracy while projecting the result back into the same deployment format. Finally, GSQ scales to trillion-scale Mixture-of-Experts models such as Kimi-K2.5, where vector-quantized methods are difficult to apply. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/IST-DASLab/GSQ.

analysis.key_results: 在Llama-3.1-8B/70B-Instruct模型上，GSQ在2和3比特下消除了标量量化与QTIP前沿之间的大部分差距；可应用于GGUF K-Quant检查点并转换回相同部署格式；扩展到万亿级MoE模型Kimi-K2.5。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GSQ（Gumbel-Softmax Quantization），一种联合学习每坐标网格分配和每组尺度的后训练标量量化方法，在2-3比特下接近矢量量化前沿精度，同时保持与现有标量推理内核兼容。
analysis.method: 使用Gumbel-Softmax松弛离散网格，匹配目标比特宽度下可用级别数量，联合优化每坐标网格分配和每组尺度。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出GSQ，一种基于Gumbel-Softmax松弛的后训练标量量化方法，可在2-3比特下显著缩小标量量化与矢量量化前沿方法之间的精度差距。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于大语言模型的标量量化，属于高效推理技术。文中未涉及VLA、世界模型或机器人策略，但其提出的GSQ方法可适用于任何大型神经网络（包括VLA/WAM），具有提升边缘部署效率的潜在价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models ground natural-language instructions in visual observations to generate actions for robotic manipulation. On long-horizon tasks, existing VLA models face structure-blind backbones, backbone-bound generalization, and flat single-objective optimization. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Neuro-Symbolic Vision-Language-Action (NS-VLA) framework. It introduces a Neuro-Symbolic Encoder that parses the instruction into a primitive plan tracked by a gated monotone stage pointer, a Neuro-Symbolic Solver that conditions a chunked VLA policy on the active sub-instruction, and Hierarchical Joint Policy Optimization, which fits the pointer on demonstration segments and refines the action policy with success-filtered online learning. Even when trained on few demonstrations, NS-VLA clearly leads on LIBERO and the held-out LIBERO-Plus (76.5% and 51.8% against 71.2% and 45.4% for its backbone), exceeds the strongest baseline by 12.7 points on long-horizon tasks, and raises real-robot success from 40.0% to 60.0%. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Zuzuzzy/NS-VLA.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO和留出集LIBERO-Plus上分别达到76.5%和51.8%，优于骨干的71.2%和45.4%；在长时程任务上比最强基线高12.7个百分点；真实机器人成功率从40.0%提升到60.0%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出NS-VLA框架，将神经符号方法融入VLA模型，引入Neuro-Symbolic Encoder、Neuro-Symbolic Solver和Hierarchical Joint Policy Optimization。
analysis.method: NS-VLA：用神经符号编码器解析指令生成原语计划并跟踪阶段指针；神经符号求解器基于活跃子指令调节分块VLA策略；分层联合策略优化在演示片段上拟合指针，并用成功过滤的在线学习优化动作策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出神经符号VLA框架，通过显式神经符号编码器、求解器和分层联合策略优化，解决长时程任务中VLA模型的结构盲目、泛化受限和优化目标单一问题。

papers.abstract: Despite remarkable progress in Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) for robot manipulation, these large pre-trained models require fine-tuning to be deployed in specific environments. These fine-tuned models are highly sensitive to camera viewpoint changes that frequently occur in unstructured environments. In this paper, we propose a zero-shot camera adaptation framework without additional demonstration data, policy fine-tuning, or architectural modification. Our key idea is to virtually adjust test-time camera observations to match the training camera configuration in real-time. For that, we use a recent feed-forward novel view synthesis model which outputs high-quality target view images, handling both extrinsic and intrinsic parameters. This plug-and-play approach preserves the pre-trained capabilities of VLAs and applies to any RGB-based policy. Through extensive experiments on the LIBERO benchmark, our method consistently outperforms baselines that use data augmentation for policy fine-tuning or additional 3D-aware features for visual input. We further validate that our approach constantly enhances viewpoint robustness in real-world robotic manipulation scenarios, including settings with varying camera extrinsics, intrinsics, and freely moving handheld cameras. Project Page: https://heo0224.github.io/AnyCamVLA/

papers.abstract: Despite advances in vision-language-action (VLA) models, they remain limited in highly dynamic game settings such as 3D open worlds and competitive player versus player (PvP) settings, where agents must efficiently extract sparse, actionable signals from dense visual input while integrating multimodal cues to track off-screen high-value targets in real time. To address this, we introduce 3A-VLA (Abstraction-Aligned Action VLA), a framework that grounds action learning in explicit intention and environment abstractions rather than superficial pattern matching. We introduce dual task-agnostic abstractions: the intention abstraction (IA), which condenses verbose instructions and reasoning into explicit semantic primitives, and the environment semantics abstraction (ESA), which structures dense visual streams into a spatial-functional affordance representation to guide grounded actions. We further propose an abstraction alignment reweighting (AAR) module that adaptively reweights the action imitation loss. A continuous intention-environment alignment signal is used to emphasize reliable action supervision when abstractions agree and reduce the influence of ambiguous demonstrations when they diverge, thereby learning a policy that balances fine-grained control and high-level reasoning without the need for manual rules. Extensive experiments show that 3A-VLA performs competitively among the evaluated baselines in both open-world (Minecraft) and competitive PvP (Game for Peace) settings. It also demonstrates zero-shot combat transfer from Game for Peace to high-fidelity games, including Valorant, CS2, GTA V, Elden Ring, and Mount & Blade.

analysis.key_results: 在Minecraft和Game for Peace中表现具有竞争力，并展示了从Game for Peace到Valorant、CS2、GTA V、Elden Ring和Mount & Blade的零样本战斗迁移能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出3A-VLA框架，将动作学习建立在明确的意图抽象和环境语义抽象上，并通过抽象对齐重加权模块自适应调整模仿损失。
analysis.method: 采用双重任务无关抽象（意图抽象IA和环境语义抽象ESA），并结合抽象对齐重加权（AAR）模块，利用连续的意图-环境对齐信号来强调可靠的动作监督。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 3A-VLA通过意图抽象和环境语义抽象对齐，提升视觉语言动作模型在3D游戏世界中的行动学习能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文属于VLA领域，聚焦于视觉语言动作模型在复杂3D环境中的动作学习与泛化，通过抽象对齐提升策略的鲁棒性和迁移能力，对机器人动作预测与世界建模具有直接参考价值。

figures.caption: Unlike previous VLA models which mapped low-level inputs directly to actions, 3A-VLA aligns action learning with intention abstraction (IA) and environment semantics abstraction (ESA) through multimodal detokenizers. As shown in a PvP scenario, 3A-VLA grounds instructions and visual scenes into high-level, interpretable concepts such as “wall” and “enemy”. (i) When trained on action sequences such as “move left, aim, shoot,” the model learns the semantic relationship between “wall” and “move left,” recognizing the object’s functional role as tactical cover rather than merely its presence. (ii) When tasked with locating off-screen enemies, the model uses the structured affordance representation from the ESA to reason about likely ambush points, such as inferring that a “wall” may serve as high-probability cover from which an opponent could emerge, thereby enabling proactive searches. In off-screen scenarios with weak IA-ESA correlation, semantic reasoning outweighs action prediction; 3A-VLA adapts by reweighting action learning to prioritize semantic grounding.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview. 3A-VLA learns abstraction-aligned actions by coupling intention abstraction (IA) and environment semantics abstraction (ESA) with abstraction alignment reweighting (AAR). During training, IA and ESA expose sparse task primitives from language and vision, while AAR reweights action supervision according to intention–environment alignment. At inference, the induced sparsity enables low-latency control by keeping only top- N N task-critical visual tokens.

papers.abstract: Early-exit (EE) LLMs let confident tokens skip a model's deep layers, but batched serving loses most of this gain. Current systems either force tokens to exit before their own ramp is confident, an error the ramp does not bound, or save almost nothing when decoding is weight-bound, because any continuing token makes a step read the deep weights. We present DREX, a batched EE serving system that never forces a token to exit. DREX introduces cross-iteration batching: tokens that continue past the exit layer wait there, and every few steps one deep pass over all waiting tokens reads the deep weights once for several steps. Its two policies differ in what such a token's request does: holding pauses it until the deep pass, and speculative holding lets it keep decoding from the exit layer's own guess, which the next deep pass verifies. Exited tokens are trusted and never verified. Using a calibrated cost model, a controller picks speculative holding where reading weights dominates a step and guesses are often right, and holding elsewhere. DREX keeps vLLM's asynchronous scheduling by planning each deep pass from exit counts of earlier steps. With synthetic exits where 90% of tokens exit at a quarter of the depth and 40% of guesses are correct, DREX achieves 2.22-2.24$\times$ decode speedup over non-EE across batch sizes on Llama-2-70B, while per-row skipping (vSkipper's design) gains at most 7.0%. On LayerSkip models, DREX adds no statistically resolved quality loss to the EE model's own. On CNN/DM at full memory, DREX with LayerSkip achieves 1.58-1.91$\times$ decode speedup while remaining within 1.4 ROUGE-2 points of the non-EE model. These speedups are 9-63% larger than EAGLE's across the evaluated model sizes, with each method measured against its own non-EE target.

analysis.key_results: 在合成退出上实现2.22-2.24倍解码加速；在LayerSkip模型上无统计显著质量损失；在CNN/DM上1.58-1.91倍加速且ROUGE-2下降在1.4以内；比EAGLE快9-63%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出DREX，一种从不强制令牌退出的批处理早退LLM服务系统，引入跨迭代批处理并保持vLLM的异步调度。
analysis.method: 跨迭代批处理；两种策略：保持暂停令牌和投机保持从退出层猜测；使用校准成本模型和控制器选择策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: DREX是一种批处理早退LLM推理系统，通过跨迭代批处理和可信退出来实现显著解码加速。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 无直接关系，但该工作聚焦于LLM的高效推断，其思想可能适用于VLA或WAM的部署优化。

papers.title: Batched Early-Exit LLM Inference Done Right with DREX

papers.abstract: Transformers replace recurrence with a memory that grows with sequence length and self-attention that enables ad-hoc lookups over past tokens. Consequently, they lack an inherent incentive to compress history into compact latent states with consistent transition rules. This often leads to learning solutions that generalize poorly. We introduce Next-Latent Prediction (NextLat), which extends standard next-token training with self-supervised predictions in the latent space. Specifically, NextLat trains a transformer to learn latent representations that are predictive of its next latent state given the next token. Theoretically, we show that these latents converge towards belief states, compressed information about the history necessary to predict the future. This simple auxiliary objective injects a recurrent inductive bias into transformers while leaving their architecture, parallel training efficiency, and inference unchanged. NextLat effectively encourages transformers to form compact internal world models with coherent belief states and transition dynamics -- crucial properties not guaranteed by standard next-token prediction alone. Empirically, across benchmarks in world modeling, reasoning, planning, and language modeling, NextLat demonstrates significant gains over standard next-token prediction and other baselines in downstream accuracy, representation compression, and lookahead planning. Furthermore, NextLat enables variable-length self-speculative decoding, accelerating inference by up to 3.3x in language modeling. NextLat offers a simple yet effective paradigm for learning compact, predictive representations in transformers that generalize better. Our code is available at https://github.com/JaydenTeoh/NextLat.

analysis.key_results: 在多个世界建模、推理、规划和语言建模基准上显著优于标准下一token预测和其他基线；推理速度最高提升3.3倍（语言建模中的可变长度自推测解码）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Next-Latent Prediction (NextLat)辅助训练目标，在标准下一token预测基础上增加隐空间自监督预测，促使Transformer学习接近信念状态的紧凑潜在表示，注入递归归纳偏置且不改变架构或训练推理效率。
analysis.method: NextLat训练Transformer预测给定下一token后的下一个潜在状态，辅助目标与标准下一token预测结合；理论上隐状态收敛于信念状态。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过下一潜在预测辅助目标，使Transformer学习紧凑的信念状态和一致转移规则，从而提升世界建模、推理和规划能力，并支持可变长度自推测解码加速。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文核心是学习Transformer的内部世界模型，与WAM（世界-行动模型）方向直接相关；所提出的NextLat可促进机器人策略学习紧凑预测性表示，并支持推测解码加速推理，对于结合高效推理与VLA/WAM具有潜在价值。

papers.abstract: 4D Gaussian Splatting has emerged as a new paradigm for dynamic scene representation, enabling real-time rendering of scenes with complex motions. However, it faces a major challenge of storage overhead, as millions of Gaussians are required for high-fidelity reconstruction. Compressing explicit 4D Gaussians is challenging because they exhibit heterogeneous redundancy across static and dynamic regions, and their temporal attributes make direct quantization unstable. In this work, we present OMG4 (Optimized Minimal 4D Gaussian Splatting), a framework that constructs a compact set of salient Gaussians capable of faithfully representing 4D Gaussian models. Our method progressively reduces Gaussians in three stages: (1) Gaussian Sampling to identify primitives critical to reconstruction fidelity, (2) Gaussian Pruning to remove redundancies, and (3) Gaussian Merging to fuse primitives with similar characteristics. In addition, we integrate implicit appearance compression and extend Sub-Vector Quantization (SVQ) to 4D representations with a staged quantization scheme, further reducing storage while preserving quality. Extensive experiments on standard benchmark datasets demonstrate that OMG4 achieves a favorable rate-distortion trade-off over recent state-of-the-art methods, reducing model sizes by over 60% while maintaining reconstruction quality. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of OMG4 as a practical framework for compact and high-fidelity 4D scene representation. Our source code is available at https://minshirley.github.io/OMG4/.

analysis.key_results: 在标准基准数据集上比现有先进方法具有更好的率失真权衡，模型尺寸减少超过60%，同时保持重建质量。
analysis.main_contribution: 构建了一个紧凑的显著性高斯集合来表示4D高斯模型，包括高斯采样、剪枝、合并以及将子向量量化扩展到4D表示的分阶段量化方案，实现了超过60%的模型尺寸缩减。
analysis.method: 三阶段渐进式减少高斯（采样、剪枝、合并），结合隐式外观压缩和分阶段的四维子向量量化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出OMG4框架，通过高斯采样、剪枝、合并和四维子向量量化来压缩4D高斯泼溅模型，在保持重建质量的同时大幅减少存储。

papers.abstract: Verifiers--functions assigning rewards to agent behavior--have been key to AI progress in math, code, and games. However, extending gains to domains without clear-cut success criteria (e.g., computer use) remains a challenge: while humans can recognize desired outcomes, translating this intuition into scalable rules is nontrivial. Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) offer a promising solution, given their world knowledge, human-preference alignment, and reasoning skills. We evaluate MLLM verifiers across web navigation, computer use, and robotics, spanning 13 models, 28 judge designs, diverse agent trajectories, and distinct downstream applications. We identify a critical limitation: a strong tendency for MLLMs to over-validate agent behavior, a phenomenon we term agreement bias. This bias is pervasive across models, is resilient to test-time scaling, and harms pipelines relying on MLLM judgments (e.g., self-improvement). We discuss principles for design and evaluation of verifiers, and introduce SGV, a method that improves verification by harnessing MLLMs' own capabilities via modulation of (un)conditional generation. First, an MLLM generates broad priors about desired behavior, independent of the data under evaluation. Then, conditioned on generated priors, it reasons over and judges a candidate trajectory. Our methods yield more human-aligned verifiers, with gains of up to 25pp in failure detection, 14pp in accuracy, and benefits extending to downstream applications. In self-improvement and online supervision, our verifiers boost task completion of a GUI specialist in OSWorld, a diffusion policy in robomimic, and a ReAct agent in VisualWebArena--surpassing the previous SOTA by 20pp. Finally, we release an updated version of VisualWebArena, featuring improved evaluators, high-fidelity environment parallelism with >10x speedups, and VWA-Lite, a 1/3-scale subset with comparable evaluation fidelity.

analysis.key_results: 在失败检测上提升高达25个百分点，准确率提升14个百分点；在自改进和在线监督中，使OSWorld中的GUI专家、robomimic中的扩散策略和VisualWebArena中的ReAct代理的任务完成率提升，超过先前SOTA 20个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 识别并缓解多模态大模型验证器中的一致偏置（agreement bias），提出Self-Grounded Verification（SGV）方法，利用模型自身的生成先验来改进验证，并在多个环境和下游任务中取得显著提升。
analysis.method: Self-Grounded Verification (SGV)：先让MLLM生成与待评估数据无关的期望行为先验，然后基于生成的先验对候选轨迹进行推理和判断。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Self-Grounded Verification (SGV)方法，通过先生成先验再条件判断，缓解多模态大模型在验证智能体行为时的一致偏置，提升验证器的对齐性和下游任务表现。

papers.abstract: Weight binarization has emerged as a promising strategy to reduce the complexity of large language models (LLMs). Existing approaches fall into post-training binarization, which is simple but causes severe performance loss, and training-aware methods, which depend on full-precision latent weights, adding complexity and limiting efficiency. We propose a novel framework that represents LLMs with multi-kernel Boolean parameters and, for the first time, enables direct finetuning LMMs in the Boolean domain, eliminating the need for latent weights. This enhances representational capacity and dramatically reduces complexity during both finetuning and inference. Extensive experiments across diverse LLMs show our method outperforms recent ultra low-bit quantization and binarization techniques.
